article.articleHeadline: 'Promising' ebola vaccine in the works
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has caused nearly 1,500 deaths; there are no vaccines or treatments for this strain. Several vaccine efforts are in play to curb the escalating outbreak; the World Health Organization regards a single-dose rVSV-based vaccine as the most promising candidate. Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories said it would advance the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine to human trials. A local organisation announced it will develop an Ebola vaccine described as the 'most promising' for this strain. Ebola is a viral haemorrhagic fever spread by close contact and infected bodily fluids. Ongoing outbreak remains a public health concern in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 1 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 「有望な」エボラワクチンが開発中
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでBundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行が継続し約1500人が死亡、ワクチン・治療法が存在しないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: Singaporeは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題はDRコンゴでの継続的なエボラ流行とワクチン開発状況。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠检测阳性率超20% 南方省份高于北方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 test positivity rate exceeds 20%; southern provinces higher than northern.
article.articleSummary: China’s CDC weekly sentinel surveillance of acute respiratory infections (Week 30, 2026) shows COVID-19 test positivity rising above 20% for July 20–26, 2026. Influenza-like illness (ILI) accounts for 4.4% of ED/outpatient visits, higher in the south (6.1%) than the north (2.8%). In ILI respiratory samples, SARS-CoV-2 positivity is 20.3%, influenza 14.5%, and enteroviruses 5.9%. Among hospitalized SARI patients, positivity is 9.5% for SARS-CoV-2, 6.4% for influenza, and 4.3% for enteroviruses. All detected pathogens are known; no unknown pathogens or new emergence. The dominant SARS-CoV-2 lineage remains NB.1.8.1, with higher positivity in southern provinces and the 15–59-year-old group. Influenza activity is at a low level, mainly B(Victoria) and A(H3N2). Rhinovirus and enterovirus positivity rates are falling, especially among ≤14-year-olds; human metapneumovirus and parainfluenza viruses also decline, mainly affecting 0–4-year-olds. Other monitored respiratory pathogens remain at low levels.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス検査陽性率が20%を超える 南部省が北部より高い
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCによる定期的な急性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体（COVID-19 NB.1.8.1系統、季節性インフルエンザ等）の季節的変動を示すもので、新規性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 定期サーベイランスレポートであり、既知病原体の季節的動向を示すのみ。重症度や医療逼迫等の情報もなく、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak 2026: DR Congo's Ebola Crisis Now Ranks as Second Worst in History
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists as the second-worst Ebola crisis in history, with no approved vaccine or treatment available. The outbreak location is predominantly eastern DRC, where dozens of armed groups operate and attacks on medical facilities disrupt response efforts. Health workers face a dangerous security environment, hindering surveillance, containment, and care delivery. Deep cuts to foreign aid funding have reduced available resources at a critical moment, exacerbating strain on response teams. The combination of a rare Ebola strain and ongoing conflict creates difficult containment conditions, delaying outbreak management and heightening transmission risk, while communities endure continued fear and disruption as authorities continue to respond in a war zone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行2026年:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機、史上2番目の深刻さに
triage.triage_reason: 承認済みワクチン・治療法がない稀なブンディブギョ株のエボラ流行が史上2番目の深刻度に達しており、武装勢力による医療施設への攻撃や資金不足が対応を妨げている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準複数該当のためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない稀な株であること、紛争地域での対応困難、資金不足による対応能力低下が重なり、史上2番目の規模に拡大している点が最大の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τα κρούσματα ξεπέρασαν τα 3.500 στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cases surpassed 3,500 in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 3,532 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo within about two and a half months, amid the 17th outbreak in the country. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, adjoining South Sudan and Uganda, where roughly 90% of cases have occurred. Transmission is mainly via contact with bodily fluids and funeral practices; healthcare workers face elevated risk. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or cure today. The outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemic has spilled into four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, whose capitals are controlled by M23 rebels. Violence in Ituri from the ADF has killed many civilians (over 30). Uganda has announced the end of its outbreak, but WHO cautions ongoing risk. A vaccine candidate from Hilleman Laboratories is in development; Oxford University’s vaccine, using similar tech to AstraZeneca, has begun in volunteers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴでの症例数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が発生し、症例3,532人・死者1,556人（致死率約44%）と深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、複数州への拡大とワクチン・治療薬未確立という点でIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 感染はウガンダ・南スーダン国境地域にも波及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済みだがWHOはリスク継続を警告。M23反政府勢力による州都支配やADFによる暴力が対応をさらに複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ταχύτατη η εξάπλωση του Εμπολα - Πάνω από 3.500 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola — over 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: By August 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling an explosive Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in its northeast Ituri province, with 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths reported over roughly two and a half months since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases, while four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, have reported transmissions; Ugandan authorities had earlier declared an end to their Ebola outbreak, though risk remains per the WHO. The epidemic is characterized by transmission during funerals and through contact with bodily fluids, in a context of fragile state authority and ongoing armed conflict, including attacks by the ADF in Ituri, killing many civilians. The strain, Bundibugyo, currently lacks a licensed vaccine or treatment. Vaccines under development include a candidate from Hilleman Laboratories and another Oxford/AstraZeneca-based vaccine; early volunteers have started dosing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの急速な拡大 - 症例数3,500超
triage.triage_reason: DRC北東部イトゥリ州で致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が3,500例超・死者1,556人と急拡大し、隣国への波及歴・武力紛争下での対応困難・ワクチン未承認という複合的リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは以前アウトブレイク終息を宣言したが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。DRC国内の複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ等）にまたがる拡大と、武力紛争（ADFによる攻撃）が対応を一層困難にしている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Second-Largest Ebola Outbreak Hits Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is battling the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant with no approved vaccines or treatments. As of July 31, 2026, the DR Congo public health ministry reports 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Bundibugyo has a 30–50% fatality rate; fruit bats are suspected reservoirs, with human transmission via contact with infected blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids. Security challenges and reduced foreign aid in eastern DR Congo hinder containment, with access and contact tracing severely limited. WHO estimates true infections may be up to four times higher than reported. In neighboring Uganda, 20 infections and 2 deaths were reported earlier, and the outbreak was declared Ebola-free on July 28.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、致死率30-50%）が流行し、3,532例確定・1,556名死亡、既にウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、また既にエボラ終息宣言済み（7月28日）。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 변종 에볼라 역대 두 번째 규모로 확산...3개월 만에 사망자 1556명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola variant in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads on the second-largest scale in history... 1,556 deaths in three months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached the second-largest outbreak on record, driven by the Bundibugyo variant. By late July, 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths have been reported, ranking behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant is rare, with a 30–50% fatality rate, and there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, and other bodily fluids; fruit bats are suspected reservoirs. In eastern DRC, armed groups and conflict hinder access, vaccine/therapy deployment, and contact tracing, straining health workers. WHO has cautioned that the true scale may be up to four times higher than official counts due to security and reporting gaps. In nearby Uganda, a separate outbreak was declared Ebola-free after 20 infections and 2 deaths, with no onward transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴの変異エボラ、史上2番目の規模で拡大…3カ月で死者1556人
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行で致死率30-50%、ワクチン未承認、紛争地域でのアクセス困難により国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブンディブギョ変異株エボラが主題。ウガンダの別流行は終息済み。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは実際の規模が公式発表の最大4倍の可能性を指摘しており、渡航・貿易制限の情報は記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: 中国第三批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组赴刚果（金）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The third batch of China's Ebola outbreak medical expert team heads for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa)
article.articleSummary: On August 1, 2026, the third batch of China’s Ebola outbreak medical expert team departed Beijing for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) to support Ebola outbreak containment. Building on the prior two batches, the team includes specialists from the National Health Commission, General Administration of Customs, Zhejiang University School of Medicine's First Affiliated Hospital, and the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention, with expertise in epidemiology, health quarantine, clinical treatment, and pathogen laboratory testing. They will conduct on-the-ground technical assistance, share prevention and control practices, and refine Ebola response procedures to strengthen local autonomous capacities. The group will work with Congo’s health authorities, medical teams, and international organizations to deepen joint prevention and sustain aid effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: 中国第三陣のエボラ対応医療専門家チーム、コンゴ民主共和国へ出発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行に対し中国が第三陣の医療専門家チームを派遣していることから、現地で継続的な深刻な公衆衛生上の対応が行われていることが示唆され、フルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は中国からの支援派遣に焦点を当てており、DRCにおけるエボラ流行そのものの詳細（症例数、致死率など）は本文に含まれていない。既存の流行への継続対応の一環と見られる。中国（Beijing, Zhejiang）は派遣元であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 珠海部署蚊媒传染病防控工作 附市民日常防护指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhuhai Deploys Mosquito-Borne Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Measures, with Daily Protective Guidelines for Citizens.
article.articleSummary: Zhuhai authorities unveiled strengthened prevention and control for Aedes-borne diseases, focusing on chikungunya fever and dengue fever, amid hot, rainy weather and heavy travel. At a July 31 municipal meeting chaired by Wu Zetong, officials urged strict implementation of the '1113' emergency-disposal protocol to rapidly detect cases, escalate responses, and cut transmission chains. The plan targets source reduction at hotspots—agricultural markets, tourist areas, construction sites, old communities, inner waterways, and vacant lots—alongside enhanced vector surveillance, sentinel medical monitoring, and coordinated actions with Hengqin and Macau. Public health education, adequate supplies, and streamlined, flattened emergency command were emphasized. Daily protective guidance for residents includes: remove standing water (weekly for water plants; wash containers), ensure ventilation and dryness, install and seal screens and nets, use approved anti-mosquito products, and observe safety when spraying indoors. Outdoors, wear light clothing and apply repellents.

triage.headline_ja: 珠海市、蚊媒介感染症の予防対策を展開　市民向け日常防護ガイドラインも発表
triage.triage_reason: 珠海市がデング熱・チクングニア熱の予防対策強化を発表した内容で、実際の症例急増や深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す具体的データは記載されていない。季節性の予防的措置であり現時点でシグナルとする根拠は弱いが、蚊媒介感染症の流行しやすさから経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は珠海市（広東省）による蚊媒介感染症の予防対策発表であり、具体的な症例数・重症度の記載がない。マカオ・横琴との連携も通常の地域協力の一環と見られる。続報で実際の症例数増加や重症化事例が確認されればPICKUPへの引き上げを検討する。

article.articleHeadline: 9 pigs in Cebu City test positive for ASF
article.articleSummary: ASF detected in Cebu City, Philippines, with nine pigs in Barangay Quiot testing positive after three of 22 died, leaving 19 tested; nine were positive. All 19 pigs were culled with the raiser’s permission, as officials aim to contain local transmission. Dr. Jessica Maribujoc, head of DVMF, said contamination is local and that the raiser is the barangay’s only hog producer, located far from the general population in a mountainous area near the barangay border. Biosecurity measures urged include cleaning and weekly disinfection of trucks and pigpens, keeping feeds away, separating other animals, washing hands, bathing and changing clothes on arriving home, footwear outside the pen, and limiting visitors and gadgets near pigs. Officials also encouraged pig registration and insurance to enable government assistance if illness occurs.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市の豚9頭がASF陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり人への健康影響はなく、局所的な発生で当局が適切に対処しているため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに感染する動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染リスクはない。地元当局により隔離・殺処分等の対応が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 广州一月子会所婴儿感染后续：防控解除日期延至8月4日
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Follow-up on infant infections at a Guangzhou postpartum confinement center: date for lifting prevention and control measures extended to August 4.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infections have been detected among several infants at Hui Ci Hu Ai Maternity Center Luxe Yuexiu Branch in Guangzhou’s Yuexiu District. Initial mild symptoms (cough, runny nose) progressed in some cases, with affected babies receiving medical care after leaving the facility. Public health authorities conducted supervision, improving ventilation and disinfection, and the center paused admitting new infants during the revision period. On July 30, the center forecast lifting prevention measures after eight days with no new cases, but on July 31 authorities extended the tentative lifting date to August 4. Access now requires appointment only; entrants undergo temperature checks, wear masks, and must not touch infants, with visits limited to up to three people and conducted via window. The event coincides with the August 1 implementation of GB/T 33855-2026, the national standard for maternal-infant health service institutions, expanding regulatory scope and mandating comprehensive infection-control records and staffing practices.

triage.headline_ja: 広州の産後ケアセンターでの乳児感染事件続報：防疫措置解除日を8月4日に延期
triage.triage_reason: 施設内の局地的なRSV集団感染であり、当局が対応中で拡大の兆候は限定的だが、続報（新基準施行や解除延期の推移）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一の産後ケア施設内での乳児RSV集団感染で、当局により管理・監督されている。国家基準（GB/T 33855-2026）の施行と同時期であり、規制強化の文脈が見られる。

article.articleHeadline: India screens nearly 11,000 travellers after Ebola emergency, no case detected
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, India has screened 10,974 international travellers arriving from Ebola-affected countries since 23 May, after the WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a PHEIC. No Ebola case has been detected in India. Affected countries cited: Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Enhanced airport screening, travel declarations, isolation facilities, expanded diagnostic capacity, and mock drills are in place; no blanket travel ban. Self Declaration Forms and the Air Suvidha 2.0 portal identify travellers with 21-day exposure. Mumbai led screenings (7,568), followed by Delhi (1,833); state totals include Gujarat (2,905) and Maharashtra (2,228). The government coordinated with NCDC, ICMR, DGHS and Civil Aviation to issue SOPs for surveillance, quarantine, lab testing, and infection prevention; expanded ICMR-NIV Pune and new BSL-3 labs; 24×7 helpline and NCDC Operations Centre activated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ緊急事態を受け、インドが約11,000人の渡航者をスクリーニング、感染者は検出されず
triage.triage_reason: WHOがBundibugyoエボラアウトブレイクをPHEICと宣言しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が既に確立されているため。ただしインド国内では症例未検出であり、渡航制限は限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドにおける渡航者スクリーニング体制の状況報告であり、インド国内でのエボラ症例は確認されていない。実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case in Delhi: BSF constable from Congo mission admitted to RML, sample sent for testing
article.articleSummary: 52-year-old BSF constable returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo on a UN peacekeeping mission in Delhi is under Ebola surveillance. Arrived July 11 and completed a 21-day quarantine at the Airport Health Organisation facility; on the 20th day he developed fever and body aches, prompting transfer to the Ebola Nursing Home at Dr Ram Manohar Lohia (RML) Hospital. A blood sample has been sent to NIV Pune for confirmatory testing; result is pending. The case is currently suspected Ebola and not yet confirmed, with the patient in strict isolation as authorities monitor potential exposure. India maintains enhanced screening and quarantine for personnel returning from Ebola-affected regions; suspected cases are isolated and samples tested at designated laboratories before diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでエボラ疑い例：コンゴ派遣任務から帰国したBSF隊員がRML病院に入院、検体は検査中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者にエボラ疑い症例が発生し隔離・検査中だが、確定診断は未了であり続報を要する。
triage.notes: 患者は21日間の検疫を完了し、症状発現後直ちに隔離。検体はNIVプネーで確認検査中で結果待ち。コンゴ民主共和国は帰国元であり、当地での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Becomes World's Second-Largest Ever
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri province Ebola outbreak has 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, with Ituri near the borders of South Sudan and Uganda and spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Infections rose from about 2,000 on July 15 to over 3,500 within weeks. This outbreak is the world's second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic, surpassed only by the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak (28,616 cases). It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists yet. Experimental vaccines show promise: a candidate from Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories and another Bundibugyo vaccine from the University of Oxford are in trials, with the first volunteer dosed last week. Ebola spreads from animals and via direct contact with infected people's bodily fluids; reporting is challenged by ongoing instability in eastern DR Congo, including M23 rebel activity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で3,500例超・死者1,556人に達し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない未曾有の規模の流行であり、国境地域での拡大や治安不安による対応困難も伴うためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による流行で、M23反乱活動による治安不安が報告・対応を困難にしている。国境地域（南スーダン、ウガンダ）への波及リスクも指摘されているが、越境感染の確定報告はサマリー中にはない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس "إيبولا" في شرق الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak confirmed in several eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the Ministry of Health in Kinshasa on August 1. Surveillance and tracing indicate ongoing transmission across eastern regions, with more than 3,500 Ebola cases recorded in the last two months, a figure that already exceeds the total cases documented between 2018 and 2020. Health teams are racing to curb spread by rapidly identifying hotspots and carrying out intensified vaccination campaigns for local populations in affected areas. The response focuses on containment of transmission foci and expanding vaccine coverage to halt the outbreak in the eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラウイルスの流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で2018-2020年の流行総数を超える3,500例以上のエボラ感染が2か月間で確認され、感染拡大が継続中であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 症例数が過去の大規模流行（2018-2020年）を上回っており、規模・重症度ともに極めて深刻。ワクチン接種キャンペーンなど国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RD Congo supera récord de casos en meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo surpasses a record number of cases in recent months.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is enduring its largest Ebola outbreak in recent years, with 3,532 confirmed cases across five provinces and 1,556 deaths. Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for about 90% of cases per WHO. The virus has been detected in four additional provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, where parts of territory and provincial capitals are under the control of armed group M23, allegedly backed by Rwanda. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; the 50-year regional death toll exceeds 15,000. The current outbreak, declared 15 May, is the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Promising vaccines are in development—Hilleman Laboratories’ candidate and an Oxford University–developed experimental vaccine; Uganda has declared its own outbreak over, though regional risk persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、ここ数カ月で症例数が記録的水準に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し3,532例・1,556死亡と大規模化、有効なワクチン・治療法が存在せず武装勢力支配地域での対応困難も伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン・ルワンダも発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文ではウガンダは終息宣言済み、他国は国境近接や関連勢力の言及にとどまり主題の発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダ(226074)、南スーダン(366755)、ルワンダ(49518)は対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo - Urdu Point.
article.articleSummary: Dateline Kinshasa, August 1, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ministry of Health confirms an Ebola outbreak in several eastern provinces. Surveillance and field investigations indicate sustained transmission across multiple eastern districts. Over the past two months, more than 3,500 Ebola cases have been recorded, a figure that exceeds the total cases documented in 2018–2020. Health teams are racing to contain the outbreak and curb further spread by conducting intensive vaccination campaigns in affected populations. The report highlights ongoing efforts to track the virus and implement public health measures; it does not provide death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identified infection sources, nor does it outline imported or exported case information. Authorities emphasize rapid vaccination and containment as critical to stopping transmission in the east.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラウイルスが流行 - ウルドゥポイント
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模流行(2ヶ月で3,500例超、過去最大規模)が複数州にまたがり持続的に発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 死亡者数、検査確認情報、感染源、輸出入症例に関する情報は記事に記載なし。過去(2018-2020)の流行を上回る規模であり、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ξεπέρασαν τα 3.500 τα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό - Ιστορικό αρνητικό ρεκόρ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 3,500 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — a historic record high.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a historic Ebola surge, with 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths in about two and a half months, making this the 17th outbreak in the country. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, where roughly 90% of cases have occurred. Transmission continues via contact with bodily fluids and funerals, with violence by armed groups in Ituri complicating response; recent days have seen over 30 civilians killed by the ADF, an ISIS-aligned group. The outbreak has spread to four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, whose capitals are controlled by M23 rebels backed by Rwanda. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or treatment. Vaccines under development include an Oxford University–based candidate (same technology as AstraZeneca) and a WHO-endorsed vaccine to be developed by Hilleman Laboratories. Uganda declared the end of its Ebola outbreak, but the WHO warns risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が3,500人を超える - 過去最悪の記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当。武装勢力の妨害下でワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が複数州に拡大しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約44%（1,556/3,532）と極めて高く、イトゥリ州を中心に武装勢力ADFによる市民虐殺が対応を妨げている。ウガンダは終息宣言済みだがWHOはリスク継続を警告。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Τα κρούσματα ξεπέρασαν τα 3.500 στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases surpassed 3,500 in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 3,500 cases in a few months, with 3,532 laboratory-confirmed infections and 1,556 deaths, marking the 17th outbreak in the country. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast (bordering South Sudan and Uganda), housing about 90% of cases per WHO. The Bundibugyo strain drives transmission, declared May 15 after a delayed recognition; no vaccine or therapy exists yet. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, with funerals contributing to spread amid weak state infrastructure. Insecurity compounds response: Ituri has suffered civilian deaths from the ADF, an armed group linked to ISIS. The outbreak has reached four other provinces, including North and South Kivu, whose capitals are controlled by the M23 movement backed by Rwanda. Uganda has declared the end of its Ebola outbreak, but WHO warns of ongoing risk. Vaccines are in development: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) advancing a candidate, and an Oxford University vaccine (AstraZeneca technology) has begun human testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ第17次流行が3,532例・1,556死亡（致死率約44%）に達し、複数州（南北キブ含む）に拡大。武装勢力による治安悪化がさらに対応を困難にしており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはSouth Sudan、Rwanda、Uganda、Singaporeが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRC国内での流行拡大であり、これら他国は対象国リストに含まれないか、あるいは主題としての発生国ではない（Ugandaは流行終息を宣言済み、Singaporeはワクチン開発企業所在地に過ぎない）ため除外した。致死率が極めて高く、ワクチン・治療法が未確立である点、また武装勢力による治安悪化が対応を困難にしている点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: [속보] "1550명 넘게 사망" 에볼라 확산 속도 너무 빨라 민주콩고 '비상'... 확진자 3500명 돌파
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Breaking News] Ebola outbreak spreads too fast; death toll exceeds 1,550 as the Democratic Republic of the Congo declares a 'state of emergency'... confirmed cases surpass 3,500.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak accelerates with 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths (case fatality 44.1%) as of 29 August 2026. 807 individuals are isolated or hospitalized; 626 recovered. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugjo/Bundibugyo variant, with fruit bats suspected as the reservoir. It has surpassed the DRC’s 2018–2020 max (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths) and is the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (about 28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths). WHO and Africa CDC warn of record-fast spread; US CDC notes 1,000 cases in 40 days, far faster than 2018. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths, with the last case discharged on 28 August and its outbreak declared over. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects; incubation 2–21 days. Early symptoms: fever, headache, sore throat, myalgia; progression to chest pain, shock; rash by days 5–7; bleeding in ~40%; potential multi-organ failure; recovery typically after 10–12 days, with possible relapse.

triage.headline_ja: 【速報】「1550人超死亡」エボラ拡大速度速すぎ、民主コンゴが非常事態宣言…感染者3500人突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模を上回るエボラ流行が発生し、致死率44.1%、感染拡大速度が過去最速でウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準複数該当・国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例・2死亡が報告されたが同流行は8/28に終息宣言済み。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーに具体的言及なく除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 国内新冠疫情上升至中流行水平 "阳了"要不要吃特效药？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic COVID-19 outbreak has risen to a moderate level of transmission; should you take antiviral drugs if you test positive?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, China’s COVID-19 activity has risen from low to moderate transmission (week 29). At Fujian Province’s Fuzhou Pulmonary Hospital, doctors Wang Xinhang and Yang Qingming caution that antiviral drugs are not universally needed and misuse offers little benefit. The hospital currently sees five to six moderate-to-severe cases daily, predominantly elderly patients with comorbidities such as lung disease, cancer, hematologic conditions, or obesity. In June, only 3 boxes of oral antivirals were used; by July 28, 56 boxes had been used. High-risk groups—ages 65+, hypertension, diabetes, COPD, chronic kidney or liver disease, obesity, immunosuppressant use, cancer, late-pregnancy, and heavy smoking—should consider early antiviral treatment under medical guidance. Most young, healthy individuals do not require antivirals and should rely on supportive care; antibiotics are ineffective against COVID-19. The optimal window is 24–48 hours, but treatment may help even after 5 days if symptoms persist; seek urgent care for persistent high fever, dyspnea, chest pain, or confusion.

triage.headline_ja: 国内新型コロナ感染が中程度の流行レベルまで上昇 「陽性」になったら特効薬を服用すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な流行水準上昇に関する通常の医療情報提供記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す要素は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり既にエンデミック化している。記事は福建省の一病院における抗ウイルス薬使用に関する医療ガイダンス記事で、通常の季節変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: सावधान! अब कीटनाशकों से लड़ना सीख गए डेंगू के मच्छर, नई स्टडी में चौंकाने वाला खुलासा - dengue mosquitoes resistant to insecticides says new study
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caution! Dengue-carrying mosquitoes have now learned to resist insecticides; a shocking revelation in a new study.
article.articleSummary: Dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes in India, particularly Delhi University’s New Delhi facility, are showing early signs of resistance to the insecticide alpha-cypermethrin. A study led by Rohit Lakhwani and Sarita Kumar, published in Frontiers in Tropical Diseases, found 97.91% mortality at the recommended dose, indicating evolving resistance traits but not permanent resistance yet. The researchers explain that detoxification enzymes and a cellular warning response are activated when mosquitoes encounter insecticides, boosting protective protein production and potentially undermining vector-control efforts. Alpha-cypermethrin remains a widely used tool globally, but the work signals a need to understand the underlying biological pathways to sustain dengue control in India. No outbreak or case counts are provided in the report, but the findings underscore the urgency of monitoring resistance development to inform future interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 注意!殺虫剤に抵抗するようになったデング熱媒介蚊、新研究で衝撃的な事実が判明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、殺虫剤耐性に関する研究結果の紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事は殺虫剤耐性に関する科学研究の紹介であり、実際の患者発生や症例数の報告はない。将来的な媒介対策への影響を示唆するのみで、現時点でのシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bipartisan senators press Rubio to unlock family planning funding for women in Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Senators Jeanne Shaheen (D-NH) and Lisa Murkowski (R-AK) urge the U.S. State Department to lift the freeze on $608 million for international family planning and release $1.7 million in purchased family planning supplies to aid women affected by the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). In a letter to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, they emphasize Ebola during pregnancy yields nearly 100% fetal loss and high maternal mortality from hemorrhage, arguing access to voluntary contraception and clinics can reduce deaths and virus transmission. They also request a humanitarian exemption to support UNFPA and restart reproductive health programming. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak has killed over 1,000 in the DRC since May; WHO reports 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, with 20 additional cases in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 超党派上院議員、エボラ流行下の女性支援のためルビオ長官に家族計画資金の凍結解除を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが3,532症例・1,556死亡と深刻化し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されている。IHR基準を複数満たし、米上院での政治的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行に対する米国内の政治的対応（家族計画資金の凍結解除要請）が主題だが、WHO報告の疫学データ（症例数・死亡数、ウガンダへの拡大）が含まれるため既存アウトブレイクの重要な続報として扱う。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Почему вспышку Эболы в Конго не удаётся остановить: мнение биолога
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the Ebola outbreak in Congo cannot be stopped: a biologist's opinion.
article.articleSummary: Second-largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, per Reuters data. The World Food Programme’s executive director called it the fastest Ebola epidemic to date. Only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) had more cases (28,616) and deaths (11,310). WHO warned the true scale could be about four times official counts. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no registered vaccine or specific treatment; vaccines exist for other strains but not this one. By confirmation, many cases had already occurred; diagnosis is time-consuming, so counts may underestimate reality. The epicenter is eastern DRC in a conflict zone; violence hampers response, fuels mistrust of hospitals, and traditional funeral rites—washing and body preparation—sustain transmission. An experimental vaccine began trials in early July; as of July 15, 20 volunteers were enrolled, with up to four months of testing.

triage.headline_ja: なぜコンゴのエボラ流行は止められないのか：生物学者の見解
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、対象株にワクチンがなく、紛争地域で対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要と判断した。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行の流行地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株には登録済みワクチンがなく、実験的ワクチンの治験が開始されたばかりである点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Cases Gradually Rising in Hanoi
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Hanoi, with weekly infections nearly doubling to 185 across 76 communes and wards, up from 96 in 49 areas the previous week. 2026 confirmed COVID-19 cases total 588; fatalities remain at zero. Officials say no new viral variants detected, with surveillance indicating the disease has become endemic and behaves like seasonal influenza; temporary spikes are expected, but outbreaks akin to the early pandemic are unlikely. Hospitals report a modest rise in visits; the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases is treating about 15–20 patients, while severe hospitalizations remain comparatively limited. Authorities also monitor dengue, hand, foot, and mouth disease, and whooping cough, anticipating seasonal increases. Preventive advice includes masking in crowded places and healthcare facilities, good hand hygiene, avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, and seeking prompt care for severe respiratory symptoms; older adults and those with underlying conditions should stay vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイでCOVID-19症例が緩やかに増加
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19はエンデミック化し季節性インフルエンザ様の挙動を示しており、死亡者ゼロ、重症化も限定的で、当局も通常の季節性増加として管理しているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 新規変異株は検出されず、当局は季節性の変動として通常監視を継続している。デング熱・手足口病・百日咳も季節的増加として言及されているが、いずれも通常の監視範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: 陸新冠陽性率首度突破20%　官方：屬週期性疫情波動
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China's COVID-19 positivity rate first exceeds 20%; Official: it is a cyclical epidemic fluctuation.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China reports COVID-19 positivity rate above 20% for the first time (week of July 20–26, 2026), with southern provinces more affected; disease remains mild overall but cyclical waves persist, similar in strength to previous two years. The 0–4, 15–59, and 60+ age groups show the highest positivity; 5–14-year-olds show higher positivity for influenza-like illness pathogens; hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections are mainly due to Mycoplasma pneumoniae and SARS-CoV-2. Influenza activity is low, with B Victoria and A(H3N2) circulating, roughly in balance among cases >4 years. Since China classed COVID-19 as a B-level respiratory disease, outbreaks are expected to cycle 1–2 times annually, with no new high-risk variants detected and no major disruption to healthcare. Elderly and chronically ill remain high-risk; targeted antivirals are effective. No need for panic.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土の新型コロナ陽性率が初めて20%を突破　当局：季節性の流行波と発表
triage.triage_reason: 陽性率上昇は例年と同程度の季節的変動であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクいずれも低く、当局も パニックの必要なしと発表しているため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: COVID-19は中国でB類感染症に分類され、年1〜2回の周期的流行が想定内とされている。新規高リスク変異株は検出されておらず、医療体制への大きな影響もないと当局は説明。マイコプラズマ肺炎やインフルエンザ（B/Victoria, A(H3N2)）も併存するが、いずれも重篤な混乱を引き起こしていない。

article.articleHeadline: ആശങ്ക ഇരട്ടിപ്പിച്ച് എലിപ്പനി മരണങ്ങൾ | ആശങ്ക ഇരട്ടിപ്പിച്ച് എലിപ്പനി മരണങ്ങൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smallpox deaths have doubled
article.articleSummary: Malappuram, Kerala: Smallpox cases surge in 2026 with 2280 cases reported up to July, including 1367 confirmed and 913 suspected; 61 deaths so far, of which 53 are suspected to be due to smallpox, yielding about a 5% case fatality. In July alone, 624 cases and 40 deaths were reported. The disease progresses rapidly, causing liver and kidney failure that can lead to death within days; key symptoms include fever, headache, severe fatigue, and muscle pain, with jaundice accompanying fever potentially indicating smallpox. Transmission is described as linked to water and soil contaminated with urine from animals such as foxes, jackals, cats, dogs, and cattle, with higher incidence among workers in rainy-season muddy or stagnant water. Health authorities urge prompt treatment and caution against delays. The article notes an ongoing outbreak in the state but provides no details on laboratory methods or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エリップニ（レプトスピラ症）による死亡者数増加で懸念拡大
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州マラプラムでレプトスピラ症の症例・死亡者数が増加しており（2280例、61死亡、CFR約5%）、重症度が高くWPRO基準に該当し社会的関心も高いため。ただしBluedotの疾患名『Smallpox』は誤分類であり、実際は現地語の『エリップニ（rat fever＝レプトスピラ症）』である点に注意。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した疾患名『Smallpox（天然痘）』は誤りで、記事内容（動物尿汚染水・泥地での感染、発熱・黄疸・腎肝不全等）から実際はレプトスピラ症（rat fever、マラヤーラム語でエリップニ）のアウトブレイクである。天然痘は1980年に根絶済みのため、この点は要修正・要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola RD Kongo Diduga Ada Sejak Januari, Jauh Sebelum Terdeteksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo suspected to have existed since January, long before it was detected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is suspected to have begun in January, possibly earlier, in Mongbwalu, eastern Ituri province, according to a Science report. Researchers interviewed about 100 residents, healthcare workers, survivors, and mortuary staff and concluded the epidemic likely started near Mongbwalu and may have been introduced to the town by a patient seeking care. Kinshasa's health authorities identified Ebola around May; by July 31 the outbreak had more than 3,530 cases and 1,556 deaths since mid-May, surpassing numbers from the 2018–2020 outbreak. The team counted over 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. A transmission chain began with a 50-year-old woman who died January 25 after vomiting blood; her mother died six days later. Ituri remains the epicenter; the outbreak has spread to Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which no vaccine or approved specific therapy exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、発生は検出よりずっと前の1月から始まっていた可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,530例以上・死者1,556人に達する大規模エボラ流行が複数州に拡大しており、有効なワクチン・治療法もないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模で、Ituriを中心にHaut-Uele、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopoへ拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: 发热伴血小板减少综合征进入流行季 @青岛人，这份"防蜱护身指南"请收好
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome enters peak season, Qingdao residents—please keep this "Tick Protection Guide".
article.articleSummary: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), caused by Dabie bandavirus, is entering peak season in Qingdao as summer heat and humidity boost tick activity. Transmission is mainly tick-bite–driven in hills, mountains, forests, grass and shrubland; possible human infection via contact with blood, body fluids, or excretions of patients or deceased cases for caregivers and healthcare workers. Incubation is typically 7–14 days. Early signs include fever (often >38°C), fatigue, nausea/vomiting, poor appetite, diarrhea, myalgia, headache, lymphadenopathy, and bleeding tendencies; labs commonly show thrombocytopenia and leukopenia. Residents near rural/forested areas, hikers, landscapers, and caretakers are at higher risk. Prevention centers on avoiding tick bites: wear long sleeves/pants, tuck clothes, use DEET repellents, perform thorough body/pet checks, wash clothes and shower after outdoors, and keep yards clear of vegetation. If bitten or febrile with thrombocytopenia, seek prompt medical evaluation and disclose exposure history; proper tick removal and infection control are advised.

article.articleHeadline: Orang tua diimbau prioritaskan cegah DBD saat anak kembali sekolah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parents Urged to Prioritize Dengue Prevention as Children Return to School
article.articleSummary: Jakarta health authorities warn dengue fever (DENV) remains a year-round threat in Indonesia as children return to school. Dr. Ikhsanuddin Qothi notes transmission is not seasonal; water containers must be closed, drained, and cleaned to prevent mosquito breeding. 2018–2025 data show the 5–14 age group has the highest dengue-related mortality, with 59% of deaths in 0–14 and 41% in 5–14 in 2025; the 15–44 age group accounts for 42% of cases. Four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) mean reinfection can occur, increasing severe dengue risk. Warning signs after fever subsides include persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, nosebleeds or bleeding gums, lethargy, restlessness, or decreased consciousness; seek care urgently. Prevention via 3M Plus—drain/close water containers, repurpose or discard water-holding items, and use bite protection. Dengue vaccination is advised for eligible children (IDAI) and adults (PAPDI). Collaboration aims for zero dengue deaths by 2030.

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh records highest Dengue mortality rate globally
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh records the highest dengue mortality rate globally amid monsoon-driven spread. In 2026, 15,153 dengue infections with 53 deaths (13 in June, 35 in July) yield a 0.49% mortality rate, the highest in South Asia, according to WHO. Sri Lanka reports 76,000 cases with 57 deaths; India 0.08%, Sri Lanka 0.06%, Pakistan 0.05% mortality. The article links the rise to new dengue serotypes, lingering measles immunity amnesia, and persistent healthcare gaps. Outside Dhaka, mosquito larvae are more prevalent; Barisal Division sees 3,308 cases, with Dhaka Division at 38% of infections, yet deaths remain high in the capital. Entomologist Kabirul Bashar cites Breteau Index measurements indicating widespread larvae both inside and outside Dhaka; expert warnings that control campaigns are insufficient year-round. Officials acknowledge gaps between recommendations and action and call for community-engaged, year-round vector control, targeting Aedes breeding grounds.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Begins Trial for Ebola Outbreak | Biotech And Pharma
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, more than 3,500 people have been infected with Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with no approved treatments or vaccines for BVD. The WHO launched enrollment for The PARTNERS trial to test MBP-134 (a monoclonal antibody from Mapp Biopharmaceutical funded by BARDA), remdesivir, or their combination to improve survival in laboratory-confirmed BVD patients. All MBP-134 doses are donated by BARDA/HHS, and Gilead Sciences is donating remdesivir for the study. The WHO Technical Advisory Group selected these therapies after reviewing preclinical and prior outbreak data. Enrolled patients of all ages receive close follow-up for at least 28 days. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus noted that safe and effective therapeutics could save many lives in this outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Pourquoi une ascension si rapide de cas confirmés d'Ebola en RDC?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why such a rapid rise in confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri with the Bundibugyo strain, has infected over 3,360 people and killed about 1,487 in roughly two-and-a-half months, a pace unseen in prior outbreaks. At least 3,000 confirmed cases were reached far faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa and 2018-2020 DRC outbreaks. While part of the surge reflects a tenfold rise in testing capacity (200 to 2,000 per day in July), a substantial portion is real transmission: Bundibugyo causes slower symptom onset, delaying care and extending contagious periods (“the Ebola that walks”), with a 30–40% fatality. Deep-seated mistrust, attacks on treatment centers, healthcare worker strikes, and chronic insecurity across five provinces hinder response. About 80% of new cases have unknown transmission sources; contact tracing yields 70–80% success. 123 health workers are infected, 37 have died. Despite no approved Bundibugyo vaccine, rapid scientific and operational responses are under way.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak becomes world's second-largest ever
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo’s ongoing Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, as of 1 August 2026. It is the world’s second-largest Ebola epidemic and the fastest-spreading on record; mortality has been five times higher in its first three months than in comparable early stages of prior outbreaks. The Bundibugjo-ry strain is involved, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Experimental vaccines offer hope: a Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories candidate and an Oxford-developed contender are in trials, with the first volunteer dosed last week. Confirmed infections rose from about 2,000 on 15 July to over 3,500 within weeks, and the virus has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu amid eastern DR Congo instability and M23 activity. Ebola transmits from animals and via contact with infected bodily fluids.

article.articleHeadline: China envía más expertos médicos para apoyar lucha contra ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends more medical experts to assist in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: China dispatched a third group of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support Ebola prevention and control, continuing help from two prior missions. The team, drawn from the National Health Commission, the General Administration of Customs, the First Hospital Affiliated with Zhejiang University, and the Chinese CDC, covers epidemiology, health quarantine, clinical care, and laboratory diagnostics. They will follow up on earlier brigades, strengthen response in local communities, share prevention experiences, refine outbreak procedures, and help build local capacity to confront the disease. The mission will work alongside the existing Chinese medical team in the DRC and deepen cooperation with health authorities and international organizations. The DRC Ebola outbreak has reported more than 3,500 cases in recent months, with Ituri province in the northeast concentrating about 90% of cases near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, per WHO.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%), with 807 isolated or hospitalized and 626 recovered, as of August 1, 2026. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. It is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC by confirmed cases, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths); globally it is second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases, ~11,000 deaths). WHO and CDC warn of unusually rapid spread. The UN WFP deputy director notes it is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak seen. In eastern DRC, armed groups, security constraints, and reduced aid impede access, with Karitas reporting widespread community transmission and continued use of traditional healers; health workers are fatigued. WHO cautions actual infections could be up to four times higher.

Cross-border spillover is noted, with Uganda reporting 20 confirmed cases and two deaths imported from the DRC. The analysis emphasizes that vaccines and treatments must reach remote care centers to alter transmission, while stressing logistical, funding, and supply challenges that could undermine scientific advances against the Bundibugyo Ebola variant.

article.articleHeadline: US, Philippines forge P42B partnership to combat HIV, tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-01, the United States Embassy in the Philippines and the Department of Health signed a five-year, P42 billion Health Strategic Objective Agreement to enhance the Philippines’ capacity to detect, treat, and prevent HIV and tuberculosis (TB). Finalized on July 22, the partnership is a co-investment: the Philippines commits over P30 billion and the United States contributes more than P11.8 billion over the next five years. The goal is to bolster health systems and disease control for HIV and TB, including surveillance, diagnostics, treatment, and prevention. US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton described the signing as elevating bilateral cooperation. Location of the agreement is Manila, Philippines, with a five-year duration and a total funding mix of P42B (Philippines >P30B, US >P11.8B).

triage.headline_ja: 米国とフィリピン、HIV・結核対策で420億ペソの協力協定を締結

article.articleHeadline: BPKP DIY Laksanakan Evaluasi Program Hasil Terbaik Cepat (PHTC) Cek Kesehatan Gratis dan Penuntasan Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DIY BPKP Conducts Evaluation of the Rapid Best Results Program (PHTC), Free Health Checks, and Tuberculosis Elimination.
article.articleSummary: On 30 July 2026 in Kebumen, the Regional Representative of BPKP for Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta conducted an evaluation of the Rapid Best Results Program (PHTC), including Free Health Checks (CKG) and Tuberculosis (TB) Elimination. The assessment, intended to verify program effectiveness and guide improvements to meet government priorities, covers CKG as a proactive health screening that detects risks across all Indonesians—from infants to the elderly and links detected cases to follow-up care and treatment. TB Elimination is evaluated as part of national efforts to accelerate TB elimination in Indonesia. Findings show both components align with policy, but require strengthened coordination, data quality, monitoring, and enhanced community education to maximize benefits. The DI Yogyakarta BPKP team commits to ongoing, high-quality oversight for more effective, accountable public health outcomes.

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases climb across Delhi-NCR: Doctors explain the monsoon connection
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, Delhi-NCR reports a fresh H1N1 wave linked to the monsoon and post-rainy-season conditions. Testing shows a real spike in H1N1 infections, with doctors reporting about 7–10 H1N1 patients daily in OPD and a mild rise in COVID-19. Symptoms commonly include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, and high-grade fever lasting days, with joint/muscle pains and fatigue; some have nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Most infections are mild and clear within a week, but elderly people, young children, and those with diabetes, hypertension, or heart disease are at higher risk of complications. Red flags require urgent care: breathing difficulty, chest pain, dizziness, confusion, or fever beyond three days; in children, fast breathing or irritability. Emphasis on isolation, masking, and early medical evaluation while monitoring the monsoon trend in Delhi-NCR.

triage.headline_ja: デリーNCR地域でH1N1症例が増加：医師がモンスーンとの関連を説明

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)のモンスーン関連増加であり、重症患者比率や死亡者数についての具体的データは記載なし。COVID-19についても軽度の増加のみで詳細情報は不足。

article.articleHeadline: Mùa mưa đến, cảnh giác nguy cơ viêm não Nhật Bản ở trẻ em
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season arrives; beware the risk of Japanese encephalitis in children.
article.articleSummary: Rainy season (May–September) in Vietnam drives Culex mosquitoes transmitting Japanese encephalitis virus, raising risk. Hanoi reported a 13-year-old with JE who had completed three vaccine doses but missed the booster, illustrating waning immunity. Vaccines do not confer lifelong protection; an immunity gap increases infection risk. JE virus cycles among mosquitoes, birds, and pigs; most infections are asymptomatic, but CNS invasion can cause fever, severe headache, vomiting, seizures, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, and coma, with mortality about 20–30% and substantial long-term neurological deficits among survivors. No specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive. Vietnam vaccines include Imojev (two doses from 9 months to <18 years, one year apart; 18+: one dose) and Jevax (three-dose schedule from 12 months; second 1–2 weeks after first; third one year after; boosters every 3 years). Parents should track records, ensure full schedules, and combine vaccination with mosquito precautions and prompt medical care during illness.

triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで毎年恒例の雨季における日本脳炎（風土病）への注意喚起記事であり、単発の症例紹介と予防接種啓発が主内容で、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はベトナムの風土病であり、雨季ごとに繰り返される季節性の公衆衛生啓発記事。記事は予防接種の重要性を訴える教育的内容で、アウトブレイクの兆候は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 上海男泰國食生醃海鮮感染「食腦蟲」 腸道嚴重潰爛出血休克險死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai man in Thailand contracts brain-eating worm after eating raw salted seafood; severe intestinal ulcers with bleeding and shock, nearly dies.
article.articleSummary: Shanghai man Xu contracted Entamoeba histolytica amoebic dysentery in Thailand after consuming raw salted seafood, leading to massive intestinal ulcers, recurrent heavy bleeding, and septic shock upon his return to China. He underwent multiple surgeries as his condition deteriorated, with hemoglobin dropping below 6 g/dL, and spent more than 30 days receiving continuous, personalized care at Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center, ultimately stabilizing and surviving. Entamoeba histolytica, common in tropical/subtropical regions, can cause fulminant amoebic colitis with extensive bowel necrosis, bleeding, perforation risk, and may disseminate to the liver causing abscess. Mild cases are often misdiagnosed as gastroenteritis, delaying therapy. Travelers are urged to maintain strict food and water hygiene in tropical areas and seek urgent medical care for abdominal pain, diarrhea, or vomiting to avoid delays; this represents an imported case in Shanghai from Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 上海の男性、タイで生の塩漬け海鮮を食べて「脳を食う虫」に感染 腸が重度に潰瘍・出血しショックで危篤

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: More than 3,500 Ebola cases were recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the past two months, surpassing totals seen during the 2018–2020 period. Health authorities say the outbreak is spreading across several eastern provinces, an area beset by conflict for more than 30 years. Ebola, transmitted through contact with body fluids, causes hemorrhagic fever. Over the last five decades, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa. The article notes ongoing transmission and does not provide specific laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases, as of 2026-08-01. Given the multisite spread and regional conflict, public health measures and vaccination campaigns may be challenged.

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진 3500명 돌파⋯역대 두 번째 규모 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: confirmed cases surpass 3,500, the second-largest outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 3,500 confirmed cases, reaching 3,532 as of July 29, 2026, with 1,556 deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%). Currently 807 individuals are in isolation or hospitalized, and 626 have recovered. This outbreak is the second-largest on record, behind the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths), and second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (about 28,000 cases, over 11,000 deaths) globally. WHO and Africa CDC warn that the spread is accelerating faster than at any previous time. Uganda declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15, 2026, reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths; the last patient was discharged on May 16, and the outbreak was declared over on May 28, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس "إيبولا" في عدد من مناطق الكونغو

The Ministry of Health reports more than 3,500 Ebola cases diagnosed in the past two months, a figure that surpasses the total cases recorded between 2018 and 2020. Medical teams are racing to prevent further spread, conducting rapid surveillance and tracing transmission chains while expanding vaccination campaigns targeted at affected populations to contain virus hotspots. The report underscores a sharp escalation in cases, highlighting the urgency of sustained public health measures, community engagement, and vaccination to curb the expanding outbreak in the eastern regions.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo steigt auf mehr als 3.500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo has risen to more than 3,500.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 3,500 infections and 1,556 deaths since the official declaration on May 15, spanning five conflict-affected provinces. The numbers surpass the country’s previously worst Ebola epidemic from 2018 to 2020. The situation is characterized by rapid growth in registered cases, a reported case fatality rate of 44%, and a likely high dark figure, implying months of undetected transmission. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy in the global health toolkit. Ebola, a disease transmitted via body fluids, remains deadly and difficult to control amid ongoing violence. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the history of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

article.articleHeadline: Kampf gegen Dengue in Brasilien: 190 Millionen Fabrikmücken pro Woche
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight Against Dengue in Brazil: 190 Million Factory-Bred Mosquitoes per Week
article.articleSummary: Brazil is combatting dengue, transmitted by the yellow fever mosquito Aedes aegypti, by mass-rearing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes. The Wolbachia bacterium lowers dengue virus replication in the mosquito, acting like a vaccine. In Campinas near São Paulo, the Flyttr facility can breed up to 190 million Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes weekly; eggs are shipped nationwide and abroad for on-site hatching. A public lab in Curitiba also produces over 100 million per week. Since trials began in 2012 in multiple cities, Wolbachia release around Rio de Janeiro reduced dengue cases by 60–70%, with declines in Zika and Chikungunya. Brazil logged over six million probable dengue cases in 2024. The approach aims to replace wild mosquitoes with Wolbachia-carrying ones over time, reducing disease without insecticides.

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τα κρούσματα στο Κονγκό ξεπέρασαν τα 3.500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Ebola cases in Congo surpassed 3,500.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 3,500 confirmed cases, with 1,556 deaths among 3,532 lab-confirmed infections in roughly two-and-a-half months. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak centers on Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with the epicenter in Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, where about 90% of cases have occurred. Transmission is by contact with bodily fluids and often during funerals, challenging an already fragile health system amid ongoing armed conflict. The outbreak has spread to four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, whose capitals are controlled by the M23 movement backed by Rwanda. Uganda has declared an end to its outbreak, but WHO warns the risk remains. There is no vaccine or cure for Bundibugyo; efforts include a WHO-promoted vaccine by Hilleman Laboratories and an Oxford-developed platform using similar technology to AstraZeneca.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴでの症例が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が3,500例超・死者1,556人と深刻化し、複数州へ拡大、紛争地域でワクチン・治療薬もなくIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAに進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: China reports COVID-19 activity at moderate level
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity in China is at a moderate level after a recent rise, per the China CDC. For the week beginning July 20, the COVID-19 positivity rate among influenza-like illness cases at sentinel hospitals reached 20.3%, up four percentage points from the previous week and the highest among respiratory diseases under surveillance. The positivity rate was higher in southern provinces than in northern regions, with the most affected age group being 15–59 years. The China CDC said COVID-19 has become a common respiratory illness with about one to two epidemic fluctuations each year; the current uptick is a normal periodic fluctuation, with intensity similar to the previous two years. Most infections are mild; the elderly and those with chronic conditions remain at higher risk for severe illness, but targeted therapies are available. No variant strains posing significant public health risk detected, and wider medical care has not been affected.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、COVID-19の活動レベルが中程度に上昇と報告
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCは季節的な通常の変動と説明しており、新規変異株の検出もなく、重症度・異常性ともに低いためピックアップ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCは例年通りの周期的変動と説明し、重症例の増加や新規変異株の検出はないと明言している。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm gan A, B, C, D, E lây nhiễm và hại cơ thể thế nào
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How do Hepatitis A, B, C, D, and E spread and affect the body?
article.articleSummary: Five hepatitis viruses—A, B, C, D, and E—are distinct pathogens that all damage the liver but differ in transmission, progression, and prevention. In Vietnam's public health guidance, misconceptions are addressed: A and E spread mainly via the fecal-oral route through contaminated food or water; A is typically acute with full recovery, while E is usually acute but can be severe in pregnancy, preexisting liver disease, or immunocompromise. B and C spread primarily through blood and body fluids; B can be transmitted mother-to-child, sexually, or via blood, and may become chronic, while C is mainly blood-borne and often chronic with risks of cirrhosis, liver failure, and cancer. D only infects people with B and worsens liver damage; preventing B also prevents D. Vaccines exist for A and B; C has no vaccine; E prevention relies on hygiene and safe water. Those at risk should seek evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: A型、B型、C型、D型、E型肝炎はどのように感染し、身体に害を及ぼすのか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、肝炎の一般的な医学解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染発生事例を報じるものではなく、肝炎ウイルスの種類・感染経路・予防法に関する一般的な健康啓発記事である。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠感染率超20%　呈上升趨勢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: COVID-19 infection rate exceeds 20% and shows an upward trend.
article.articleSummary: China CDC reports COVID-19 infection rate exceeding 20% with an upward trend, during Week 30 sentinel surveillance (July 20–26, 2026). Among outpatient influenza-like illness, SARS-CoV-2 positivity reached 20.3%, ahead of influenza 14.5% and enteroviruses 5.9%. For hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections, the top detected pathogens were SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and human metapneumovirus (HMPV). All detected pathogens were known, with no novel agents identified. The prevailing SARS-CoV-2 strain belongs to NB.1.8.1 lineage, with the 15–59 age group showing the highest positivity. Southern provinces report higher ILI positivity than northern regions. COVID-19 is described as a common, recurring respiratory infection in China, typically with 1–2 waves annually; the current upsurge mirrors previous years and is largely mild. Public health measures and personal hygiene are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター：新型コロナウイルス感染率が20%を超え上昇傾向
triage.triage_reason: 新型コロナ感染率上昇は認められるが、既知病原体で例年通りの季節性流行とされ、症状は軽度と報告されているためPICKUP基準には満たないが、感染率の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 中国疾病予防管理センターによる定点監視（第30週、2026年7月20日〜26日）の報告。新型コロナはNB.1.8.1系統が主流で、既知病原体のみ検出され新規病原体は確認されていない。例年の年1〜2回の流行パターンと一致し、軽症が中心とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Latest medical team leaves China to fight DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: China dispatches its third five-member medical team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist the Ebola outbreak response in five provinces. Departing Beijing, the team includes experts from the National Health Commission, the customs authority, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine, and the Chinese CDC. The team will engage in policy coordination, epidemic assessment, screening/testing, clinical treatment, and laboratory capacity building. As of 2026-07-28, DRC reported 3,360 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,487 related deaths across five provinces. WHO says the public health risk remains high in the DRC and neighboring countries, though the global risk level is low. China’s first two Ebola-fighting teams are already working with local health departments and international partners, providing training for hospitals, China-funded enterprises, and overseas Chinese communities, while boosting scientific research cooperation. China has 44 foreign medical aid teams across 43 African countries aiding the broader response.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、DRCのエボラ出血熱対応支援のため最新の医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,360例・1,487人死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、WHOも高リスクと評価しているため、フルリスク評価の対象とすべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 中国とザンビアの地名は医療チームの派遣元・経由地であり、実際の発生地域はDRCのみ。中国本土での感染事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 치료제 없는 '죽음의 에볼라' 1500명 사망..."최악의 속도로 확산 중
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No-treatment 'Deadly Ebola': 1,500 dead as it spreads at the fastest rate.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola virus disease is spreading in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with confirmed cases surpassing 3,500 and deaths exceeding 1,500 as of Aug 31, 2026. The DRC health ministry tallies 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 fatalities, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). WHO warns the true scope may be up to four times higher than official counts, and the outbreak is spreading at the fastest rate observed. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines; if any exist, deployment locally could take months. Response is hampered by security instability from armed groups in eastern DRC and shrinking aid. Funding gaps are severe: Africa CDC/WHO cite a $1.4 billion need for June–August, with only about $21.39 million secured. Communities rely on traditional healers, sustaining transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 治療薬のない「死のエボラ」1500人死亡…「最悪のスピードで拡散中」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上2番目の規模で拡大しており、致死率が高く治療薬・ワクチンもないため、国際的公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項である。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の西アフリカエピデミックとの比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。資金不足（必要14億ドルに対し確保約2139万ドル）と治安不安が対応を著しく困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Resistente muggen: 2,29 procent van Aedes aegypti overleeft het belangrijkste insecticide in India
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Resistant mosquitoes: 2.29 percent of Aedes aegypti survive the main insecticide in India.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, India reports that 2.29% of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes survive exposure to the main insecticide alpha-cypermethrin, with 97.71% mortality observed. This rapid resistance could spread to offspring given the species’ fast reproduction, undermining control of dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. Lead author Sarita Kuma calls for quick study of the biological mechanisms enabling survival at an early resistance stage to inform countermeasures. The findings imply revision of vector-control strategies in tropical and subtropical regions, advocating combining chemical methods with non-chemical measures to slow transmission before resistance becomes entrenched.

triage.headline_ja: 耐性蚊:インドでネッタイシマカの2.29%が主要殺虫剤に耐性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 殺虫剤耐性という将来的な媒介対策への懸念を示す研究報告だが、現時点で症例増加や公衆衛生への具体的影響は報告されておらず、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事は殺虫剤耐性に関する研究報告であり、実際の症例数や流行状況についての情報は含まれていない。将来的な媒介対策への影響を示唆するため、続報（耐性拡大や症例増加の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 3,500 in DR Congo as Africa CDC warns of worsening outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths. The outbreak has spread across five eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. There are 807 patients in isolation or hospital care, while 626 have recovered. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) warns of mounting operational constraints hampering the response, even as it commends Uganda for successfully containing the outbreak. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya called the outbreak 'the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded' and noted it is now the second-largest by total confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が3,500人を超える、アフリカCDCは流行悪化を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州に拡大し、死亡率も高く、Africa CDCが「史上最速の拡大」「過去2番目の規模」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事内で流行の封じ込めに成功した国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率は約44%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Qui la paura è uscire in un sacco bianco": il racconto di un'operatrice MSF dentro il centro Ebola in RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Here the fear is leaving in a white body bag": the story of an MSF field worker inside the Ebola treatment center in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with official deaths surpassing 1,500 in under three months and nearly 3,000 confirmed infections, concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast, accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases and over 80% of national deaths. MSF field workers inside a treatment center in Ituri describe meticulous, slow-paced care to prevent transmission, since Ebola spreads through bodily fluids. The human toll is stark: entire families arrive infected—grandfather, daughters, granddaughters—after a grandmother unknowingly transmitted the virus; a pregnant woman in her second trimester dies from hemorrhage, followed by a dignified and safe burial. Fear marks every temperature check and admission, with many fearing entering or leaving the center in a white body bag. The piece emphasizes that saving lives requires precise, careful actions rather than speed, amid an ongoing Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 「ここでは白い遺体袋で運び出されることが恐怖だ」：コンゴ民主共和国エボラ治療センター内のMSFスタッフの証言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCイトゥリ州で大規模流行しており、死者1,500人超・感染者約3,000人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: MSF(国境なき医師団)による現地報告記事。致死率が高く、家族内感染や妊婦の死亡例が報告されており、既存の大規模流行の継続的な深刻性を示す内容。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي لـ"الإيبولا" في الكونغو: أكثر من 3500 إصابة جديدة خلال أشهر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: more than 3,500 new cases over the past few months.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports more than 3,500 Ebola infections in recent months, far exceeding the country’s previous worst outbreak (2018–2020). Authorities’ data cited by AFP indicate a surge that stands as the most significant Ebola transmission event in the DRC in recent memory. Ebola spreads through close contact and body fluids and causes viral hemorrhagic fever. Across Africa, outbreaks over the last five decades have claimed more than 15,000 lives. The 2018–2020 DRC outbreak remains the deadliest on record, with about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. The article does not provide current mortality numbers for the ongoing surge, but underscores the escalating public health threat and the need for sustained surveillance and outbreak response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が流行:過去数ヶ月で3,500人以上の新規感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,500例超のエボラ感染が報告され、過去最悪であった2018-2020年の流行(約3,500例、2,300人死亡)を上回る規模とされており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は感染者数の急増を報じているが、現在の死亡者数や具体的な発生地域(州)、国際的な渡航制限の有無については言及がなく不明。続報での死亡率・地理的拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 3500 إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية جراء تفش غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 3,500 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC faces an unprecedented Ebola outbreak, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces in about two-and-a-half months. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine or cure exists for this strain. Ituri province in northeast DRC along the border with South Sudan and Uganda accounts for roughly 90% of cases, amid conflict-affected health systems where funeral rites fuel transmission. Other provinces affected include North Kivu, South Kivu, and four more, with M23 rebels controlling capitals and large areas, complicating containment. Uganda has ended its own outbreak, but cross-border risk persists. WHO warns of ongoing threat. Vaccine development includes Hilleman Labs of Singapore pursuing a vaccine, and Oxford University's candidate (using AstraZeneca tech) in early human trials, with the first dose given to a volunteer.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のないエボラ出血熱の流行、感染者3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で前例のない規模(3,532例、死者1,556人)のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率も高くワクチン・治療法未確立、紛争地域で対応困難なため国際的拡大リスクも高い。IHR基準を複数満たしPICKUP判定とする。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国のアウトブレイクを終息させたと記載されているが、越境リスクは継続。スーダン国境地域という記載はあるがスーダン国内での症例発生は言及されていないため対象国リストにない。ワクチン開発の話題(シンガポール、英国)は流行発生地ではなく研究開発拠点のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congos Ebola Outbreak Becoms Second-largest On Record
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola outbreak in several eastern provinces, with surveillance confirming spread across multiple eastern districts. Medical teams are rapidly pursuing containment through intensive vaccination campaigns targeting local residents. As of Aug 1, 2026, this outbreak is the world’s second-largest on record, totaling 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths. Officials describe transmission as fast-spreading and outpacing containment efforts, prompting strengthened vaccination and surveillance. The UN World Food Programme warns of the epidemic’s rapid growth and urges heightened international attention. The report provides no details on symptoms, infection sources, or imported/exported cases; vaccination is ongoing in affected eastern regions of the DRC to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、記録上2番目の大規模流行に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数の東部州に拡大し、史上2番目の規模（3,532症例、1,556死亡）に達しており、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準双方に該当する。
