article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы стала крупнейшей для ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak becomes the largest in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths as of August 1, 2026. This represents the largest and fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in DRC history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (about 3,500 cases and ~2,300 deaths). The surge involves five of 26 provinces, with the epicenter in Ituri province near the borders with Uganda and South Sudan. Poverty and ongoing armed conflict hinder containment, and burial practices lacking protection have fueled transmission, according to MSF. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; the country’s worst previous surge was West Africa 2014–2016 (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行であり、死者数・症例数ともに深刻で、ワクチン未承認の稀な変異株による国際的拡大リスクも高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Sudan、Angolaが含まれるが、記事本文では流行地はDRCのイトゥリ州が中心であり、国境近接の言及のみで実際の感染確認は記載されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Sepelekan, 4 Penyakit Menular Ini Bisa Mengintai Anda Saat Berenang di Kolam Umum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Underestimate These Four Infectious Diseases That Could Lurk While You Swim in a Public Pool
article.articleSummary: Public swimming pools can transmit infections when sanitation and disinfection are not regularly maintained. Even swallowing a small amount of contaminated pool water can introduce pathogens, putting vulnerable groups—children, pregnant women, and the elderly—at risk of dehydration and skin rashes. The article highlights diarrhea and Legionnaires’ disease as waterborne risks. Pathogens implicated in pool-related diarrhea include Cryptosporidium, Giardia, Shigella, norovirus, and pathogenic E. coli, with Cryptosporidium being the most common and able to persist for days despite chlorine. Public pools typically require pre-swim showers to reduce transmission. Avoid entering pools if recently ill, and steer clear of unmonitored lakes or rivers where animals can spread contaminants. Diarrhea from pool water can last up to two weeks and may lead to severe dehydration; seek medical care promptly if symptoms occur.

triage.headline_ja: 軽視は禁物、公共プールで泳ぐ際に潜む可能性のある4つの感染症
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、公共プールでの感染リスクに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、実際のアウトブレイクや具体的な症例報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、特定の国での実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 378 Warga Terdampak Debu Pengolahan Batu Kapur di Bandung Barat Suspek TB |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 378 Residents Affected by Limestone Processing Dust in Bandung Barat Regency Suspected TB
article.articleSummary: West Java, Indonesia: Bandung Barat Regency health authorities screened residents near limestone processing sites in Cipatat and Padalarang from July 25–31, 2026 for tuberculosis (TB) due to dust exposure. Of 2,974 health-service visits, 2,870 (96.5%) participated in Free Health Check (CKG). Chest radiographs were performed on 1,772 participants (61.7%). Initial screening identified 378 individuals (13.2%) as TB suspects; among them, 304 (80.4%) underwent the Molecular Rapid Test (TCM) for further testing. Laboratory results to confirm TB status were pending at the time of reporting. No final TB confirmations were provided in the article. This active case-finding effort underscores occupational exposure concerns and ongoing TB screening in Cipatat and Padalarang within Bandung Barat Regency, West Java.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州バンドン・バラット県の石灰石加工粉塵で住民378人が結核疑い
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の職業曝露に関する能動的スクリーニングの結果報告であり、確定診断は未了。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、続報（確定検査結果）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は職業性粉塵曝露に関連した能動的症例探索の結果報告。確定検査結果待ちのため、続報での確定数を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fastest-Growing Ebola Outbreak in History Becomes More Challenging
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo—the fastest-growing on record—has 1,031 confirmed deaths, driven primarily by Bundibugyo virus. The epicenter is Ituri province (about 90% of cases), with confirmed infections in Kisangani, Goma, and across five provinces. The outbreak’s origin remains unknown, and most new infections arise from transmission chains not yet traced. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and sometimes bleeding; lab confirmation has been delayed by misidentification with more common Ebola types. Strikes by unpaid health-center workers threaten containment in a volatile region with armed groups. A treatment study is enrolling local participants at an Ituri center, testing remdesivir and MBP134 (antibody therapy) versus standard of care, in random assignments; determining efficacy could take months and involve up to 1,000 participants.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最も急速に拡大するエボラ流行、さらに困難な局面に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者1,031人）で、感染経路不明の伝播が続き複数州に拡大、医療従事者ストライキや武装勢力による治安不安も重なり、国際的拡大リスクと管理困難性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus型による過去最大級のエボラ流行。感染源不明の伝播チェーンが継続、医療従事者ストライキと武装勢力の存在が対応を困難化。治療薬の臨床試験も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 42 дни в кома и загуба на паметта: Ухапване от кърлеж в Гърция промени живота на британка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 42 days in a coma and memory loss: A tick bite in Greece changed a British woman's life.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne encephalitis from a Greece tick bite left British woman Victoria Stell of Anglesey in a 42-day artificial coma and now with memory loss, seizures, and daily 18 medications. In 2019, during a vacation on the Greek island Syros, she developed flu-like symptoms. Back in the UK, nocturnal seizures prompted MRI and transfer by helicopter to Walton Hospital in Liverpool, where she was placed in an induced coma for 42 days. Later diagnosis identified tick-borne encephalitis virus. She now struggles with memory impairment, cannot recall names of colleagues and pupils, and lost her job as a hospitality worker and as a teaching assistant for children with special needs. NHS says TBE is transmitted by ticks in Europe, Russia, parts of China and Japan; UK risk is very low. Vaccination before travel is advised; Wales reports no local cases; England/Scotland have a few locally acquired cases since 2019.

triage.headline_ja: 昏睡状態42日間と記憶喪失：ギリシャでのマダニ咬傷が英国人女性の人生を変えた
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に発生した個人の症例に関する回顧的な記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規性や緊急性はない。中国・日本・ロシア等はTBEの一般的な流行地域として言及されているだけで、実際の発生国はギリシャ（対象国リスト外）である。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年の既往症例を扱った個人的な体験談であり、新規の公衆衛生イベントではない。中国・日本・ロシアはTBE流行地域として一般論的に言及されているのみで、記事の主題である発生国はギリシャ（対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: Το Κονγκό αντιμέτωπο με την πιο φονική επιδημία Έμπολα της ιστορίας του - Πάνω από 3.500 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo faces the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history — over 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus. By 2026-08-01, laboratory-confirmed cases reached 3,532 with 1,556 deaths within about two and a half months since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, where roughly 90% of cases have occurred; four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, have reported infections. The response is hindered by fragile state infrastructure and ongoing armed conflict, with groups such as the ADF conducting attacks in Ituri. Ebola’s broader African toll exceeds 15,000 deaths over 50 years, and the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused 2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet; a candidate vaccine is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore, and Oxford/AstraZeneca-style vaccines are in trials. Uganda has declared the end to its Ebola outbreak, but WHO warns of ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが史上最も致死的なエボラ流行に直面 — 症例数3,500件超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ(Bundibugyoウイルス)流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、武力紛争により対応が困難であり、複数州・国境地域に拡大している。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済み。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo種であり、武力紛争(ADF)による対応の困難さがリスクを増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: Australia backs fight against drug-resistant tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Australia backs regional capacity-building to fight drug-resistant tuberculosis (DR-TB) in Southeast Asia. Four-day PeerLINC-led training in Makati City, Philippines, gathered delegates from Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and the Philippines. Organized by PeerLINC Knowledge Hub with TB Alliance and Tropical Disease Foundation, and funded by AusAID, the program emphasizes peer-to-peer learning and adapting newer, shorter, patient-centered regimens (BPaLM/BPaL) to local health systems. Field visits to health facilities in Makati and Pasay allowed evaluation of facility accessibility, testing availability, and feasibility of implementing DR-TB care in the Philippines. The event concluded with country-specific action plans for the coming year covering diagnostics, clinical care, patient support, and program management. Australia frames this as development cooperation that builds regional networks to address cross-border health challenges.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア、薬剤耐性結核対策の地域協力を支援
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染症発生や急な公衆衛生上の脅威を報じるものではなく、既存の薬剤耐性結核対策に関する地域研修・能力構築プログラムについての記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はフィリピン・マカティ市で開催された薬剤耐性結核（DR-TB）対策の地域研修イベント（PeerLINC主催、オーストラリア支援）を報じるもので、新規発生や症例急増の報告ではない。既存の慢性疾患対策プログラムに関する内容のため、シグナルとして識別しない。

article.articleHeadline: 內地新冠病毒檢測陽性率突破20%　官方：屬周期性波動 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China COVID-19 test positivity rate surpasses 20%; Officials say it is a cyclical fluctuation.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 test positivity rate in Mainland China surpasses 20% for the first time; officials describe the rise as cyclical fluctuation. The National Center for Disease Control and Prevention, in its weekly sentinel surveillance for acute respiratory infections (Week 30, 2026), reports July 20–26 positivity rose above 20%, up 4 percentage points from the prior week, with a predominance of mild cases and higher positivity in southern provinces. Positivity is highest among 0–4, 15–59, and 60+ age groups. Among 5–14-year-olds, influenza-like illness is mainly driven by influenza virus. Hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection cases involve Mycoplasma pneumoniae and SARS-CoV-2. Influenza activity remains low, with co-circulation of B/Victoria and A(H3N2). No high-risk SARS-CoV-2 variants detected. Since China shifted to Category B management, COVID-19 is a common respiratory disease with cyclical waves; severity unchanged, elderly and chronically ill remain high-risk, and antivirals are effective. Surveillance finds no major public health threat or healthcare disruption.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土の新型コロナウイルス検査陽性率が20%を突破　当局は「周期的変動」と説明
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19陽性率が20%を超え急上昇し公式コメントも出ているため社会的関心があり、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）にも該当するためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 中国国家疾病予防管理局の週次サーベイランスに基づく報告で、軽症が中心・重症度は変化なしとされているが、陽性率の急上昇と季節性呼吸器感染症（マイコプラズマ・インフルエンザ）との共流行が続報で注視すべき点。

article.articleHeadline: Fastest-Growing Ebola Outbreak Becomes More Challenging
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is the fastest-growing in history, with 1,031 deaths confirmed. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri province, which accounts for about 90% of cases, with confirmed cases also in five provinces including Kisangani, one of Congo’s largest cities. This Ebola type has no approved treatment or vaccine. Containment is hindered by strikes by unpaid health-center workers, weak infrastructure, rebel threats, and widespread misinformation that the virus is not real. The situation underscores severe ongoing public health challenges in remote regions and urban centers as authorities mobilize resources and coordinate security measures to reach affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ流行、対応がさらに困難に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が1,031人の死者を出し、都市部を含む複数州に拡大、治療・ワクチンもなくIHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないタイプのエボラであり、ストライキ、反乱軍の脅威、誤情報の蔓延など対応を阻害する要因が多い。大都市キサンガニを含む5州に拡大しており、国際的な拡大・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تُسجل تفشياً غير مسبوق لـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records an unprecedented Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an unprecedented Ebola outbreak with 3,532 infections and 1,556 deaths across five eastern provinces in about 2.5 months since it was declared on May 15. The seventh outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has no licensed vaccine or treatment yet. The epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda, where roughly 90% of cases have occurred amid fragile health systems and ongoing conflict; infections also span North Kivu and South Kivu, with other eastern provinces affected. Attacks by Allied Democratic Forces rebels have intensified civilian deaths in Ituri. Uganda has ended its own Ebola outbreak, but risk remains per WHO. Vaccine development is underway: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) will pursue a candidate, and Oxford University is testing another vaccine—the first dose was administered last week using the same platform as AstraZeneca’s COVID vaccine. The outbreak could persist for months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、前例のないエボラ出血熱の流行を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で前例のない規模のエボラ流行（感染3,532例、死亡1,556例）が発生し、紛争地域での拡大・ワクチン未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行（第7次、Bundibugyo株）が主題。ウガンダは既に流行終息、スーダン・シンガポールはワクチン開発関連の言及のみで発生地域ではないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Vacanță dramatică în Grecia. O femeie a stat 42 de zile în comă după ce a fost mușcată de o căpușă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dramatic vacation in Greece. A woman spent 42 days in a coma after being bitten by a tick.
article.articleSummary: British Victoria Stellas developed tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) after a 2019 vacation on Syros, Greece, with flu-like symptoms that progressed to seizures. Following an MRI, she was flown to Walton Centre in Liverpool and placed in a coma for 42 days; the diagnosis was TBE, a viral brain inflammation transmitted by ticks in Europe, Russia, and parts of China and Japan. About six months elapsed from hospital admission to completion of treatment. She survived but with lasting deficits, notably memory loss that cost her jobs as a pub worker and as an educational assistant for children with needs; she now takes 15–18 medications daily and has adapted strategies for daily tasks. NHS notes the risk of severe disease from tick bites is small but vaccination is advised for travelers to endemic areas, ideally at least one month before travel. Victoria speaks annually to Bangor University students to raise awareness.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャでの悲劇的な休暇。女性がダニに刺された後42日間昏睡状態に
triage.triage_reason: 2019年の英国人女性の個人的な症例報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年にギリシャで発生した個人の症例（ダニ媒介性脳炎）の回顧的な体験談であり、中国・日本は病気の一般的な流行地域として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではない。対象国リストに含まれる実際のイベント発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 寄生虫潜伏期可达几十年！爱吃生腌海鲜的要注意了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parasite incubation periods can last for decades! Those who love raw and marinated seafood should beware.
article.articleSummary: Raw-marinated seafood presents health risks from viral and bacterial infections. The practice of marinating fresh seafood (shrimp, crabs, shellfish) in mixtures such as white wine, soy sauce, garlic, and chili, then consuming without thorough cooking, can expose consumers to pathogens. Even high-alcohol marinades do not reliably sterilize foods; ethanol at typical culinary strengths (around 50–75%) may not kill certain viruses like norovirus and hepatitis B virus. Potential bacterial threats include Vibrio parahaemolyticus, Vibrio vulnificus, and Salmonella, which can cause diarrhea, abdominal pain, bloating, vomiting, and nausea, with rare progression to bacteremia and life-threatening illness. The article highlights summer-season risks and cautions that marination cannot guarantee safety, though some processing may reduce risks. No outbreak data, laboratory confirmation, or case counts are provided, and no locations are specified.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫潜伏期は数十年に及ぶことも！生腌海鮮好きは要注意

triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、生腌海鮮（生の海鮮マリネ）摂取に伴う一般的な健康リスクについての啓発記事。具体的な発生地域、症例数、アウトブレイクデータは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Becomes World's Second Largest on Record: 3,532 Cases and 1,556 Deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health confirms an Ebola outbreak in several eastern provinces. Surveillance and epidemiological investigations have confirmed the virus's spread in multiple eastern areas, with medical teams racing to prevent further transmission. The response centers on intensive vaccination campaigns targeting local residents, alongside ongoing containment measures in affected communities. The outbreak has grown to 3,532 reported cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the world's second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. Officials, including Carl Skau, Acting Head of the UN World Food Programme, warn that transmission is accelerating and that the world must pay greater attention. The article notes the outbreak's rapid spread and the urgent need for sustained vaccination and public health interventions to curb further loss of life.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、史上世界第2位の規模に：症例数3,532例、死者1,556人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が拡大中で死亡者数も多く、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性が高い。IHR基準に複数該当し、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、致死率も高い（約44%）。国連WFP幹部が国際的な注意喚起を発しており、ワクチン接種キャンペーンなど封じ込め対策が進行中。続報で症例数・死亡者数の推移、国際支援の状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: টিকা আসার আগেই দুশ্চিন্তা, ডেঙ্গির চার প্রজাতির তাণ্ডব দেশে, কতটা মারাত্মক রূপ নিচ্ছে ভাইরাস?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worries ahead of the vaccine's arrival: The four dengue serotypes wreak havoc in the country—how deadly is the virus becoming?
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Indian Council of Medical Research reports simultaneous circulation of all four dengue serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4) across at least eight states and union territories. DENV-2 and DENV-4 are linked to higher severity, and some patients harbor co-infections with multiple serotypes. A dengue vaccine has been approved, but its rollout remains delayed. Dengue transmission is not confined to the monsoon; climate variability can sustain or expand outbreaks year‑round as Aedes aegypti breeding accelerates. Clinical presentations are widening: many patients experience abdominal pain before fever, abdominal distension, indigestion, loss of appetite, and repeated vomiting or diarrhea, with liver, heart, gallbladder, and digestive tract involvement. This can progress to multi‑organ failure and respiratory compromise. NS1 antigen testing should be performed first, along with IgM and IgG testing to identify serotypes.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン登場前の懸念:デング熱の4血清型がインド国内で猛威、ウイルスはどれほど深刻化しているのか?
triage.triage_reason: インドの少なくとも8州でデング熱4血清型すべてが同時流行し、重症化・多臓器不全の症例が報告されており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ICMR（インド医学研究評議会）主導の調査で、デング熱4血清型（DENV-1〜4）が同時に複数州で循環していることが確認され、特にDENV-2・DENV-4で重症化リスクが高いとされる。ワクチンは承認済みだが導入が遅延しており、年間を通じた媒介蚊対策の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Special Report: Karnataka HIV Cases Rise | 7,000 College Students Reportedly Affected
article.articleSummary: 7,000 college students in Karnataka are reportedly affected as HIV cases rise among youth. The State AIDS Control Society will organize HIV testing and counselling camps across colleges, conducted with students’ consent to promote early detection, awareness, and safe practices. Health experts reiterate that HIV is manageable with timely diagnosis and treatment, and that sustained awareness and regular testing are essential to prevent new infections. The initiative aims to bolster public health, reduce stigma, and expand routine screening among college populations. The report provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. This government-led response reflects Karnataka’s efforts to address rising youth HIV prevalence in India, as of August 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 特別レポート：カルナタカ州でHIV感染者増加、大学生7,000人が影響を受けたと報告

triage.notes: 記事は『reportedly』との表現があり、7,000人という数字の出典・確認状況が不明。State AIDS Control Societyによる検査・カウンセリングキャンペーンが計画されている段階であり、緊急性の高い公衆衛生事象というよりは既存の慢性感染症対策プログラムの一環と見られる。続報で確定症例数や感染経路の詳細が判明次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل أكثر من 3500 إصابة بإيبولا وتتجاوز الحصيلة...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo reports more than 3,500 Ebola cases and surpasses the tally.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo reports the seventeenth Ebola wave spiraling out of control, with over 3,500 infections and 1,556 deaths recorded in roughly two and a half months, surpassing the deadliest previous wave (2018–2020). The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a variant with no vaccine or approved therapy available to date, intensifying the crisis in eastern regions. About 90% of cases are centered in Ituri, in the northeast near Uganda and South Sudan, with spread to four other provinces including North and South Kivu. Humanitarian teams face severe obstacles in organizing safe burials as transmission occurs through body fluids and contact with the deceased. The region endures decades of armed conflict, complicating response efforts. Although neighboring Uganda reports an end to its outbreak, international agencies warn of ongoing cross-border transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染者3500人超を記録し、過去最悪の被害を更新

triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda・Sudanが含まれるが、記事の主題は主にDRCでの流行であり、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは流行終息を報告済みとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 3500 إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية جراء تفشٍّ غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 3,500 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ripping through eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in an unprecedented outbreak. More than 3,500 cases have been recorded in about 2.5 months, including 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces as of August 1, 2026. The epicenter is Ituri province in northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, accounting for about 90% of cases; the virus has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and four other provinces amid conflict and weak health infrastructure. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact and bodily fluids, with funerary rites implicated; health workers and humanitarian actors are attempting safe burials. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, though Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) plans a vaccine deemed promising, and Oxford University/AstraZeneca’s platform-based vaccine has begun testing in volunteers. Uganda reports ending its outbreak, but WHO cautions ongoing cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない流行によりエボラ感染者3,500人超

triage.notes: ウガンダは自国の流行終息を報告しているが、WHOは越境リスクを警告。シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo bệnh Whitmore dễ mắc trong mùa mưa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Melioidosis is easily contracted during the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Whitmore), caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is a dangerous bacterial infection endemic to soil, mud, and contaminated water in tropical regions such as Vietnam. Transmission is environmental rather than person-to-person, increasing during the rainy season when the bacterium thrives in wet soil and water. The disease presents variably and can mimic pneumonia or other infections, potentially progressing to septicemia and multi-organ failure if untreated. In Phu Tho Province General Hospital, a 60-year-old man presented with swelling and pain near the right ear. A parotid gland abscess was drained; culture identified Burkholderia pseudomallei, initiating targeted antibiotics. The patient recovered. Another case in Quang Ninh involved a 43-year-old woman with septic shock and multi-organ dysfunction, rescued with VA-ECMO. Preventive measures include protective clothing, wound care, hand hygiene, drinking clean water, and managing chronic diseases; there is no vaccine yet.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に感染しやすいメリオイドーシス（類鼻疽）に注意
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで毎年雨季に見られる風土病（類鼻疽）に関する啓発記事であり、個別症例の紹介にとどまる。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 3500 إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية جراء تفشٍّ غير مسبوق - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 3,500 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an unprecedented outbreak - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an unprecedented Ebola virus disease outbreak. The seventeenth Ebola outbreak wave was declared on May 15. In roughly two and a half months, the country documented 3,532 infections across five provinces, with 1,556 deaths. The rapid surge marks an unusually fast-spreading and lethal pattern for this disease. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or travel-linked cases. The information is attributed to Kinshasa-based sources via Urdu Point / Saudi Press Agency. No further clinical details are given, but the figures underscore a major public health emergency in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のないエボラ流行により3,500人以上が感染

article.articleHeadline: बैक्टीरिया वाला पानी? भोपाल के बड़े तालाब से लेकर सप्लाई में मिले सीवेज कीटाणु
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria-laden water? Sewage pathogens found in the supply—from Bhopal's Big Lake.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-01, Bhopal's drinking water from the Big Lake was found to be heavily contaminated with sewage-linked fecal coliform bacteria. In city-wide sampling, 63 water samples collected from various areas; 43 (about 68%) tested positive for fecal coliform bacteria. Specifically, 42 Big Lake–linked samples showed 38 contaminated (about 90%), while 16 samples from the Kolaar area had 4 contaminated (25%). The health department identified 19 settlements at highest risk based on 30 years of records and directed municipal and water-supply authorities to take corrective action. Potential illnesses include diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, typhoid, jaundice, and other infections, especially among children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. Residents are advised to boil or filter water before drinking until supplies are deemed safe.

triage.headline_ja: 細菌汚染水？ボパールの大きな湖から給水まで下水系病原菌が検出

triage.notes: 記事は水質汚染とその健康リスク（チフス含む）の可能性を報告するもので、実際の症例発生数や集団発生の確証はない。保健当局が是正措置を指示済み。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 3500 إصابة بإيبولا في تفشٍ غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 3,500 Ebola cases in an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has produced more than 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces in about two and a half months, the largest on record and surpassing the worst outbreak from 2018–2020. The 17th outbreak, declared May 15, largely affects Ituri Province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda, where about 90% of infections occur. Ongoing conflict and weak health infrastructure hinder containment in Ituri and adjacent North Kivu and South Kivu. Hilleman Laboratories, Singapore-based, began developing a vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while a volunteer recently received the first dose of an Oxford University vaccine; no licensed vaccine or therapy exists yet for this strain. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes severe hemorrhagic fever; the disease has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、前例のない流行でエボラ感染者3500人以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行（3500例超、死者1556人）で、紛争地域における医療インフラの脆弱性から封じ込めが困難であり、国際的な支援や注視が必要な深刻な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・スーダン・シンガポールは記事中でワクチン開発拠点や隣接国として言及されているが、実際の流行発生国はDRCのみであるため、対象国リストにはDRCのみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: بـ 3500 إصابة.."إيبولا" يحطم أرقاماً قياسية في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 3,500 cases, Ebola shatters records in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 3,500 cases, with 3,532 infections and 1,556 deaths across five provinces in about two-and-a-half months since 17th outbreak was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine or treatment. The epicenter is Ituri in eastern DRC, accounting for about 90% of cases near borders with South Sudan and Uganda; four other provinces, including North and South Kivu, are affected amid conflict and weak health systems. Transmission occurs through close contact and body fluids, with unsafe funeral rites fueling spread; safe-burial efforts are underway. Civilians in Ituri have faced attacks by Allied Democratic Forces rebels; M23 militants operate in North and South Kivu with Rwanda support. Uganda has declared the outbreak over, but WHO warns the risk remains. Vaccines: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) developing an Ebola vaccine; Oxford University is testing one using AstraZeneca technology.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者3,500人超、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が記録的規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が3,500例・1,556死亡と過去最大規模に拡大し、有効なワクチン・治療薬がなく、紛争地域での医療体制の脆弱性や国境地域への拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済みだがWHOはリスク継続を警告。ルワンダ・南スーダン・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株には現時点でライセンス済みワクチン・治療薬がない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Covid in Cina, nuovo picco di casi a luglio 2026: sintomi lievi e nessuna variante pericolosa secondo le autorità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in China, new peak in cases in July 2026: mild symptoms and no dangerous variant according to authorities.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China reached a July 2026 peak, with SARS-CoV-2 again leading influenza-like illnesses, overtaking seasonal flu. Official data show test positivity among symptomatic patients rose from 16.3% in July 13–19 to 20.3% in July 20 onwards, higher in southern provinces; the 15–59 age group is most affected. The Chinese CDC reports most cases are mild and viral activity is now moderate after the uptick. The predominant lineage is NB.1.8.1, with authorities describing COVID-19 as a common respiratory disease prone to one or two seasonal waves annually. Older adults and individuals with chronic diseases remain at higher risk for severe disease, but targeted therapies are available. No variants presenting significant public health risk were identified, and health services have not been stressed. Virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco emphasizes vigilance, not alarm, as SARS-CoV-2 circulates globally.

triage.headline_ja: 中国での新型コロナウイルス感染症、2026年7月に新たなピーク：症状は軽度で危険な変異株は確認されず、当局発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の流行拡大であり、重症化率や医療逼迫の増加、危険な変異株の出現は確認されておらず、当局も「警戒は必要だが過度な懸念は不要」としているため。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株NB.1.8.1による季節性の感染増加で、重症例や医療負荷の増加は報告されていない。COVID-19は既に風土病化しており新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: اعتصاب کادر درمان کنگو در اوج شیوع مرگبار ابولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo healthcare workers strike at the height of the deadly Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease outbreaks centered in Ituri province have reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths through end-July, marking the second-largest global outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis. Weak surveillance and diagnostic shortages raise concerns about undercounting. Healthcare workers—including doctors, nurses, lab staff, and support personnel—began a strike in early July over two months of unpaid salaries and back bonuses, disrupting case identification, contact tracing, and inpatient care. Analysts warn that interruptions could accelerate transmission and endanger thousands. The government says payments are being processed electronically, but frontline reports of nonpayment persist. Structural challenges—funding gaps, armed conflict in eastern DRC, personnel shortages, and no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain—complicate control, with WHO and Africa CDC urging increased resources and support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの医療従事者、致死的なエボラ流行のピーク時にストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イツリ州で3,532例・1,556人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、医療従事者ストライキにより症例特定・接触者追跡・入院治療が中断し、感染拡大リスクが高まっている。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による流行であり、武力紛争や資金不足、医療従事者ストライキが対応を著しく複雑化させている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يجتاح الكونغو الديمقراطية.. أكثر من 3500 إصابة في أشهر قليلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo... more than 3,500 cases in a few months.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 3,500 Ebola infections in a few months, eclipsing the worst 2018–2020 wave which caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. The current outbreak, the 17th in the DRC, was declared on May 15 and is unfolding at an unprecedented pace, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces in roughly two and a half months, per authorities on Friday, July 31. The circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no available vaccine or treatment. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in the past 50 years. The reported figures come from official data released on July 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を席巻…数か月で3500人以上が感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模を上回るエボラ出血熱の流行が発生し、致死率が高くワクチン・治療法もない状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる第17次流行で、5州にまたがり急速に拡大中。ワクチン・治療法が未整備であり、国際的な支援が必要とされる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго бушевала с января: власти молчали четыре месяца
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo raged since January: authorities were silent for four months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo began earlier than government acknowledged, with the first cases identified on the outskirts of Mongbvalu in January; officials did not announce it publicly until mid-May. From January through May, more than 500 suspected infections were recorded before the flare became a full-scale epidemic. Thirteen health workers—including nurses and Red Cross personnel—died, while 42 survived; local cemeteries reported up to 20 deaths on peak days. By mid-May the outbreak had reached about 3,360 cases and 1,487 deaths. The World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency in May for Congo and Uganda. The disease is caused by ebolaviruses; this outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus subtype, which has no approved vaccine or specific therapy, underscoring severe clinical risk and the need for containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は1月から猛威を振るっていた：当局は4カ月間沈黙していた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(3,360症例、1,487死亡)でWHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文にはウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ(226074)は含まれないため除外。当局の隠蔽・報告遅延が指摘されており、透明性・情報公開の問題も含む重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案。ボツリンブジョ・エボラウイルス亜型はワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認である点も重症化リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke falls sick, vomits at public gathering days after revealing typhoid diagnosis | Today News
article.articleSummary: On 1 August 2026, in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke fell sick during a public encounter in the parking area of his residence around 11:45 AM, appearing restless and vomiting near the rear of his home as doctors were called and he retreated indoors. This illness follows his disclosed typhoid diagnosis, revealed during the Jantar Mantar protests in Delhi on 25 July, when he said he was undergoing treatment. The report does not provide any new case counts or fatalities, nor does it mention laboratory confirmation in this piece. The incident occurs days after his public admission of typhoid, tying the episode to the prior diagnosis. No infection source or exposure details are given beyond the existing typhoid context. The focus is on a symptomatic event amid an ongoing health condition.

triage.headline_ja: CJP創設者アビジート・ディプケ氏、腸チフス診断公表数日後に公の場で体調不良・嘔吐
triage.triage_reason: 特定個人の既往（腸チフス）に伴う体調不良を報じる記事であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や新規感染拡大を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 個人の健康状態に関する報道であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての疫学的情報（症例数、感染源、拡大状況等）は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo steigt auf mehr als 3.500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: the number of Ebola cases in the Congo has risen to more than 3,500.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak, the largest since 2018–2020, has reported over 3,500 infections and 1,556 deaths (about a 44% case-fatality rate). Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the Bundibugyo variant has spread across five violence-weary provinces. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Africa CDC estimates containment funding at $1.4 billion, but pledges so far are only a fraction, highlighting gaps in global crisis response. Uganda reports the end of a smaller concurrent outbreak. Transmission occurs via body fluids, and the disease often follows a severe, fatal course. The Congo outbreak underscores Ebola’s enduring public health emergency in Africa over the past five decades. (As of August 1, 2026.)

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：コンゴのエボラ感染者数が3,500人以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が2018-2020年以来最大規模のアウトブレイクとなり、致死率約44%、3,500人超の感染・1,556人の死亡が確認され、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認かつ資金不足で国際支援が必要な深刻な状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの小規模な同時発生アウトブレイクは終息と報告されているため、verified_locationsには含めていない。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में बेकाबू हुआ इबोला: इतिहास का सबसे तेज फैलता प्रकोप, मृतकों की संख्या हजार के पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in the DRC: history's fastest-spreading outbreak, death toll over a thousand
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-spreading on record. As of August 1, 2026, 3,442 confirmed infections and 1,521 deaths (about 45% fatality) have been reported, with transmission now in five eastern provinces. The government declared the outbreak on May 15, and this Bundibugyo strain is spreading faster than all 16 prior outbreaks, nearing the 2018–2020 total of 3,470 cases. The UN warns cases double roughly every 20 days, worsening a severe humanitarian crisis. Authorities have strengthened surveillance and established more than 20 treatment centers and local diagnostic laboratories; communities are urged to seek care for even mild Ebola-like symptoms to interrupt transmission. A July trial of a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine began, with ~20 volunteers by July 15 and about four months to completion. Uganda, which recently declared its outbreak ended, sent experts to assist Congo at border areas Touchomia and Kaseni.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラが制御不能に：史上最速の流行拡大、死者数が1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の急速拡大（症例倍加約20日）、致死率約45%、5州に拡大という重大かつ異常な事態であり、IHR基準複数該当・国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは支援国として言及されているのみで、発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダのアウトブレイクは既に終息宣言済みのため対象国リストからは除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: "A tick bite changed my life": Welsh woman was in coma for six weeks after Syros holiday - ProtoThema English
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) followed a tick bite on Syros in 2019, leaving Victoria Stellas in a 42-day induced coma and about six months of treatment at the Walton Centre in Liverpool. The 51-year-old Welsh-Greek woman developed severe brain inflammation with seizures and now has memory problems, nocturnal seizures, and takes 15–18 tablets daily; she had to quit her job as a pub worker and a teaching assistant at a special-needs school, unable to recall pupils’ or colleagues’ names. TBE is a viral infection transmitted by ticks; early symptoms are flu-like, but CNS involvement can cause encephalitis. Ticks carrying TBE are found across much of Europe and Russia, with parts of China and Japan also affected. NHS recommends vaccination for travelers to high-risk areas, ideally at least a month before trips. Experts note TBE is rare but serious; about 97% have no serious complications, ~3% develop encephalitis, and there is no specific antiviral treatment—prevention is key.

triage.headline_ja: 「ダニに刺されて人生が変わった」:ウェールズ人女性、シロス島旅行後に6週間の昏睡状態に - ProtoThema English
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に発生した単一個人の症例に関する回顧的報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や新規のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。対象国での実際の発生事例も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年にギリシャ・シロス島で発生した個人のダニ媒介性脳炎(TBE)症例に関する人間的興味記事。日本・中国はTBEの分布域として一般的に言及されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Why is Kerala facing high leptospirosis mortality?
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Kerala, India, caused by pathogenic Leptospira, has been endemic since 1989 and now represents the state’s highest-mortality communicable disease. Cases surge with the Southwest monsoon; heavy rains, floods, and sustained humidity sustain bacteria in soil and water, exposing paddy workers, agricultural and construction laborers, and others handling contaminated water. Over the past three years Kerala records about 5,000 cases and nearly 400 deaths annually (confirmed and probable). In July this year the state reported ~50 deaths. Symptoms range from fever, myalgia, conjunctival suffusion and GI issues to rapid progression of pulmonary hemorrhage and multi-organ failure within 4.5–5 days. Late diagnosis and limited 24/7 emergency care heighten mortality; serology (ELISA) is often non-confirmatory in the acute phase, though PCR exists but is unevenly available. Doxycycline prophylaxis (200 mg twice weekly) targets high-risk groups, though compliance is poor. 2025 deaths: manual laborers 36.75%, agricultural 10.94%, homemakers gardening 10.16%.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州はなぜレプトスピラ症による死亡率が高いのか
triage.triage_reason: 1989年以降ケララ州で流行が続く既知の風土病であり新規性・異常性は乏しいが、死亡率の高さや職業曝露の継続性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は1989年以降ケララ州の風土病であり、モンスーン期の環境曝露による職業関連感染が主体。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、年間死亡者数（約400人）は高水準であり継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में बेकाबू हुआ इबोला इतिहास का सबसे तेज फैलता प्रकोप, मृतकों की संख्या हजार के पार | Bunia: Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, Ebola: the fastest-spreading outbreak in history has spiraled out of control; death toll surpasses 1,000 | Bunia: Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. As of August 1, 2026, there are 3,442 confirmed infections and 1,521 deaths (case fatality ~45%), with transmission now in five eastern provinces amid ongoing conflict stressing health services. The government declared the outbreak on May 15. Case counts are nearing the 2018-20 crisis (3,470 infections). The United Nations says cases double roughly every 20 days. Authorities have strengthened surveillance, established over 20 Ebola treatment centers, and set up local laboratories; communities are urged to seek care for even mild symptoms to interrupt transmission. In Bunia and Ravampara health zones, weekly new infections total 100–150. A vaccine for Bundibugyo began clinical trials in July, with about 20 volunteers enrolled by July 15 and completion expected in ~4 months. Uganda has dispatched experts to border areas Touchomia and Kaseni to assist.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラが制御不能に、史上最速で拡大する流行、死者数が1000人を突破 | ブニア：コンゴのエボラ流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が発生し、感染者3,442人・死者1,521人（致死率約45%）、5州に拡大中で紛争下の医療体制にも影響しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda・Nepalが含まれるが、記事はUgandaが国境地帯に専門家を派遣した支援国としての言及のみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。Nepalは記事内容と無関係の可能性が高い（座標がネパール付近のKaseniはDRC国境の地名の可能性）。

article.articleHeadline: ثاني أكبر تفشٍ لفيروس إيبولا في التاريخ.. الكونجو الديمقراطية تواجه انتشارًا يفوق جهود المكافحة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second-largest Ebola virus outbreak in history... The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an outbreak that surpasses containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths nationwide. WFP's Karl Skau described it as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak seen and urged greater global attention. Africa CDC notes that, within three months of onset, the outbreak has killed five times more people than previous waves. The WHO lists the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak as the largest, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Angel Gabiu of Caritas in Bunia, North Kivu, says awareness campaigns are failing and front-line workers are exhausted and traumatized. Helman Laboratories are developing an Ebola vaccine, viewed as the most promising. The outbreak is entrenched in communities, with ongoing transmission as people seek traditional healers. In June, Africa CDC estimated containment funding at $1.4 billion, triple earlier estimates.

triage.headline_ja: 史上2番目に大きいエボラウイルスの流行…コンゴ民主共和国は封じ込め努力を上回る拡大に直面
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目規模のエボラ流行で3,532症例・1,556死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、急速な拡大と国際的支援要請が確認されるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSierra Leone、Angola、Liberia、Guineaが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較で言及されているのみで、現在のイベントの主題国はDRCのみである。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: O infecție rară după o mușcătură de căpușă în Grecia: 42 de zile de comă și sechele
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare infection after a tick bite in Greece: 42 days in a coma and sequelae.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) caused a 42-day coma in a 51-year-old British woman after a 2019 trip to Syros, Greece. She developed flu-like symptoms that progressed after returning to the UK, culminating in nocturnal seizures and severe brain inflammation. Transfer by helicopter led to treatment at the Walton Centre in Liverpool, where clinicians induced coma and later diagnosed TBE. Recovery spanned about six months, with lasting sequelae including substantial memory loss that impaired former roles as a pub worker and educational assistant; she now takes 15–18 pills daily and uses strategies to manage daily tasks. Vaccination is advised for travelers to risk areas and should be given at least one month before travel; the NHS notes the risk is low overall but emphasizes awareness. TBE spreads in Europe, Russia, and parts of China and Japan; no antivirals exist. Victoria speaks at Bangor University to raise awareness.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャでのマダニ咬傷による稀な感染症：42日間の昏睡と後遺症
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に発生した個人症例（英国人女性）を振り返る啓発記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や対象国での発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年のギリシャ・シロス島での個人的なダニ媒介脳炎(TBE)症例を紹介する啓発目的の記事。中国・日本・ロシアはTBEの一般的な流行地域として言及されているのみで、対象国における実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश ने बढ़ाया संक्रमण, अस्पतालों में मरीजों की भीड़, कई कॉलोनियों में आ रहा दूषित पानी भी एक वजह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain has driven up infections; hospitals are crowded with patients; contaminated water in several colonies is also a reason.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, monsoon rains in Indore have driven a surge of infections: vomiting, diarrhoea, dehydration, plus viral illnesses, dengue and malaria. Hospitals report a sharp rise in kidney infections, with 40–50 patients daily at the Government Super Speciality Hospital. Many began with urinary tract infections, vomiting or diarrhoea and progressed due to delayed care or self-medication. Contaminated water is identified as the primary source, and several colonies still receive dirty supply. Residents of Scheme No. 54, Scheme No. 78, Gauri Nagar, Lasudia, Vijaynagar, Nagin Nagar, and Bhamori report persistent dirty water and ongoing complaints via 311/CM Helpline without timely remediation. People boil water or add substances to make it drinkable, underscoring a public health risk in Indore.

triage.headline_ja: 雨が感染症を増加させ、病院は患者で混雑。多くの居住区で汚染水も一因に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーンに伴う感染症（デング熱・マラリア・水系感染症）の増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない毎年恒例の公衆衛生課題である。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 3,500 إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية جراء تفشٍّ غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 3,500 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is driving an unprecedented outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 3,500 infections reported within a few months, exceeding the worst wave recorded in 2018–2020. The current surge totals 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces over roughly two and a half months. The outbreak was declared the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC on May 15, signaling a pace of transmission not seen before. In the 2018–2020 period, the country experienced about 3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths. The report underscores the gravity of the ongoing outbreak and its rapid expansion, highlighting the need for heightened surveillance, rapid case management, and continued public health response to contain spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のないエボラ流行、感染者3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで前例のない規模で拡大しており（3,532症例、1,556死亡）、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 5州にまたがる大規模流行で、2018-2020年の最悪期を上回るペースとされる。続報でWHOの正式リスク評価・対応状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: O femeie a stat în comă 42 de zile după ce a fost mușcată de o căpușă în vacanță, în Grecia. Ce diagnostic au pus medicii - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman remained in a coma for 42 days after being bitten by a tick on vacation in Greece. What diagnosis did the doctors give - ProTV News.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) diagnosed in a 51-year-old Welsh woman after a Greek vacation on Syros in 2019, who developed flu-like symptoms and nocturnal seizures. She spent 42 days in a coma at Walton Hospital, Liverpool; recovery took six months and memory problems persist. The infection source is believed to be a tick bite at a goat farm in Greece, illustrating an imported TBE case to the United Kingdom. TBE is a viral brain inflammation spread by ticks in Europe, Russia, and parts of China and Japan. Symptoms appear about a week after the bite; severe cases involve seizures, confusion, and speech or movement difficulties. Travelers to risk areas should be vaccinated at least one month before travel. In the UK, the vaccine is not free and is available only through private travel clinics. Most infections do not cause neurological complications; vaccination and prevention are essential since antivirals are not effective.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャ旅行中にダニに噛まれた女性が42日間昏睡状態に―医師の診断は
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に英国人女性がギリシャ旅行中にダニ媒介脳炎(TBE)に感染した個別の輸入症例に関する過去の医学的逸話記事であり、対象国における公衆衛生上の懸念や新規性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年のギリシャでの単一輸入症例(英国人女性)についての一般啓発記事。中国・日本はTBEの流行地域として一般的言及があるのみで、対象国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, picco di casi in Cina: a luglio è tornato al primo posto tra le infezioni respiratorie - CN24TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19, peak in cases in China: in July it returned to first place among respiratory infections
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, COVID-19 rebounds in China in July 2026, returning to first among respiratory syndromes. In the week of July 13–19, test positivity among symptomatic respiratory patients reached 16.3%, rising to 20.3% in the week of July 20. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than northern regions; ages 15–59 were most affected. The Chinese CDC reports most cases are mild, with viral activity now moderate after the uptick. The circulating lineage is NB.1.8.1. Authorities say no variants posing significant public health risk and no strain on healthcare despite the rise. Virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco notes ongoing global circulation of SARS-CoV-2 and possible summer waves, but no highly dangerous variant identified. Emphasizes vaccination, protection for elderly and chronically ill, masking when ill, and sustained epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19、中国で症例急増：7月に呼吸器感染症の首位に返り咲く
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的増加であり、当局は重症化リスクの高い変異株や医療逼迫を否定しており、通常の流行パターンの範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株NB.1.8.1による季節的増加。当局は軽症が大半で医療逼迫なしと報告。COVID-19は既に十分理解された疾患であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Cebu rising
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Cebu Province, Philippines, recorded 381 confirmed cases in July as rainfall spurs transmission. No outbreak is declared in Cebu City, but officials warn rising dengue during the rainy season and have activated dengue fast lanes in 16 Capitol-run provincial and district hospitals to speed assessment and treatment of suspected cases: immediate triage, quicker laboratory testing, closer monitoring, and early medical intervention. While PHO officials say the province has no outbreak, case numbers have grown over the past three months. Toledo City leads with 49 cases, followed by Barili (39), Talisay City (34), Consolacion (33); Carcar City and Medellin each with 19. Other areas include Cordova and Dalaguete (17), Sogod (14), Danao City (13), and Argao, Balamban, and Compostela (12 each).

triage.headline_ja: セブ州でデング熱症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ州で雨季によるデング熱症例の季節的増加が報告されているが、アウトブレイク宣言はなく、異常性・国際的拡大の根拠は乏しい。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局はアウトブレイクを否定しているが、症例数は過去3ヶ月で増加傾向。デング急送レーンを16の病院で稼働開始するなど対応強化中。死亡者数など重症度に関する情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak becoms second-largest on record
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, confirmed by the Ministry of Health in several eastern provinces, is the world's second-largest on record. As of August 1, 2026, total cases reach 3,532 with 1,556 deaths. Surveillance and epidemiological investigations have confirmed spread across eastern provinces; transmission continues to outpace containment efforts. Medical teams are racing to prevent further transmission, implementing intensive vaccination campaigns targeting local residents. The UN World Food Programme's Carl Skau called it the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic the world has seen, highlighting the urgent need for broader attention. The outbreak remains active, with authorities focusing on vaccination and surveillance to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC東部で史上2番目の規模に拡大し、封じ込めが追いついていない深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、国際的関心・支援の必要性も明白なため。
triage.notes: 致死率約44%（1556/3532）、国連関係者が史上最速の拡大速度と発言しており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Конгодағы Эбола індеті ел тарихындағы ең ірі ошаққа айналды
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has become the largest in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest on record, surpassing 2018–2020’s about 3,500 cases and ~2,300 deaths. Globally, only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was larger (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). The DRC outbreak has reached five of its 26 provinces, with the main hotspot in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan. Poverty and armed conflict hinder containment, and some families bury victims without safety measures, fueling transmission. Ebola is transmitted via direct contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain, for which no vaccine or specific therapy is currently approved.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、同国史上最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱が同国史上最大規模に達し、5州に拡大、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境近くが震源地であり、紛争・貧困により封じ込めが困難で国際的拡大リスクもあるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 発生地域には過去の流行地（ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ、南スーダン、アンゴラ、ウガンダ）も含まれるが、記事の主題は現在DRCで進行中の流行であり、他国は歴史的比較対象として言及されているのみのため除外。ウガンダ・南スーダンとの国境近接は越境拡大リスクとして言及されているが、現時点で発生国としての記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Point Santé : Ebola accélère en RDC et s'éteint en Ouganda, la pression du VIH continue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Update: Ebola accelerates in the DRC and dies out in Uganda, HIV pressure continues.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates to 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths by July 30, the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, roughly doubling every 20 days. The outbreak, centered in Ituri across 48 health zones, has reached five provinces and worsened food insecurity, with about 5 million in emergency hunger and 2.7 million in acute need (628,000 in catastrophic conditions). The World Food Programme has distributed more than 160,000 hot meals. Uganda declares the end of its Ebola outbreak on July 29 after 42 days with no new cases, tallying 20 cases and 2 deaths; 15 imported from DRC, 5 local transmissions among health workers; 836 contacts tracked; two mobile labs and two 80-bed treatment units deployed to curb cross-border spread in northeast DRC. In Sudan, cholera reaches four states (West/North Kordofan, South Darfur, Khartoum) with 1,330 cases and 114 deaths (as of July 10); Tawila records over 1,500 cases; health systems strained, 40% facilities offline, 33 million in need. HIV funding risk: since Jan 2025, US PEPFAR/USAID programs wound down; PEPFAR budget falls to $2.9B in 2026; modeling suggests up to 570,000 additional HIV infections in South Africa by 2034; SA previously received over $400M annually.

triage.headline_ja: 健康速報：エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で加速、ウガンダでは終息、HIVへの圧力は続く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行が同国史上最速のスピードで拡大しており（20日ごとに倍増）、致死率も高く、複数州に拡大している深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行、ウガンダでの終息、スーダンのコレラ、南アフリカのHIV資金問題を扱っているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nova saznanja o epidemiji ebole u Kongu: Virus se širio mjesecima prije nego što je otkriven | 6yka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New findings about the Ebola epidemic in the Congo: The virus spread for months before it was detected | 6yka
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo likely began in January 2026, possibly earlier, in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, and circulated for months before authorities formally declared the outbreak in mid-May. A Science study based on interviews with about 100 residents, health workers, survivors, and others, plus medical records and burial data, reconstructs sustained undetected transmission and points to a single case that introduced the virus from a rural area to the city. By mid-May the outbreak had exceeded 3,530 cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history after 2018–2020. The epidemic has spread to five provinces—Ituri (epicenter), Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or specific therapy exists. Early detection might have curbed spread, but by confirmation the virus was already widespread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行に関する新たな知見:ウイルスは発見される数ヶ月前から拡大していた
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行(3,530症例以上、死亡1,556人)で、5州に拡大し承認ワクチン・治療薬がないバンディブギョエボラウイルスによるものであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既に大規模流行として認識されているアウトブレイク(DRC史上2番目の規模)。本記事はその起源・拡大経緯に関する新知見を報じるもの。既存の継続事案としてフルRRAでの状況確認・更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Flu Alert! H1N1 Cases Spike Across Delhi-NCR as Monsoon Triggers Infections
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, Delhi-NCR is experiencing a monsoon-driven surge in H1N1 influenza (swine flu). Hospitals report increasing numbers of patients with high fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, and fatigue. Health experts attribute the rise to the seasonal mix of rain, humidity, fluctuating temperatures, and crowded indoor spaces that facilitate transmission. The outbreak underscores the need for early diagnosis and prompt isolation, alongside public health measures such as masking, good ventilation, and heightened precautions for high-risk groups. The report emphasizes vigilance in clinical assessment during the monsoon season, with healthcare providers advising testing and isolation when influenza-like symptoms accompany fever. No laboratory-confirmation details or case counts are provided.

triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年モンスーン期にインドで発生する既知のパターン。症例数・重症度・検査確定情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Eerste geval Afrikaanse varkenspest bij wilde zwijnen in Finland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of African swine fever in wild boars in Finland.
article.articleSummary: Africa n swine fever (ASF) detected for the first time in Finland, in three young wild boars found in Virolahti, less than 2 km from the Russian border. Protective measures implemented; the outbreak reported to WOAH, marking Finland as another European country with ASF in wild boar populations. Finland’s wild boar population is small (about 2,400), underscoring the challenge of keeping ASF out of borders; Russia is the presumed source where the disease is already present. Trade implications loom as the European Commission anticipates export pressures from outbreaks and trade barriers. EU pork exports to non-EU markets fell 2% in January–May 2026 to 1.76 million tonnes, with Spain down 19%, while Germany (+34%) and Denmark (+8%) rose; demand from South Korea and Vietnam increased, while Chinese imports waned. Dutch pig farmers face no changes to biosecurity, but a reminder to maintain strict hygiene, avoid wild boar contact, and monitor transport and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: フィンランドの野生イノシシで初のアフリカ豚熱感染例
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病であり人への健康影響はなく、発生地はフィンランドで対象国リストに含まれない。中国・ベトナムは輸出需要の文脈で言及されているのみで発生国ではない。
triage.notes: ASFは家畜・野生動物の疾病でヒトには感染しない。発生国はフィンランドであり対象国リストに該当なし。中国・ベトナムは豚肉輸出需要の増加という貿易文脈での言及のみで、疾病発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, picco casi in Cina: a luglio primo posto malattie respiratorie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Peak of cases in China; in July, respiratory diseases took first place.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 SARS-CoV-2 continues to circulate globally, with China reporting a peak of cases, and July seeing respiratory diseases ranking first. Virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco notes this is a reminder that SARS-CoV-2 can trigger new waves even in summer, though current Chinese data do not show a variant with radically different epidemiology or increased severity. The virus remains capable of adapting and spreading as population immunity wanes. Ongoing circulation is driven by Omicron sub-variants, with waves that do not strictly follow influenza-seasonality. International mobility, travel, climate-controlled indoor settings, and declining immunity may foster transmission in summer. Surveillance (epidemiological and virological) is essential to detect changes and monitor impact on vulnerable groups. Emphasized are vaccination to maintain protection and prudent behavior for those with symptoms; masking when ill or around fragile individuals remains a responsibility. China's situation underscores the need for robust international surveillance to detect emerging variant characteristics and enable rapid response, without alarmism.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ、中国で症例ピーク：7月は呼吸器疾患が首位に
triage.triage_reason: 中国でCOVID-19症例の季節外れの増加が報告されているが、新規変異株や重症度上昇の証拠はなく、専門家も過度な警戒は不要としているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のOmicron系統株による季節外の流行を扱っており、新規変異株や重症度上昇の証拠はないとされている。国際的なサーベイランスの重要性が強調されているのみで、緊急性の高い懸念は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Cockroach Party founder Abhijeet Dipke sick after typhoid diagnosis, doctors set to examine him
article.articleSummary: Typhoid diagnosis cited for Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke, who became ill in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra. Dipke felt uneasy and vomited in the parking area of his residence around 11:45 am, then retreated inside as his father, Bhagwan Dipke, said doctors were called to examine him. He had told protesters at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi on July 25 that he had typhoid and had been unwell for several days, undergoing treatment. He did not speak to media after the episode. The report ties today’s symptoms to his stated typhoid illness, with doctors to assess his condition further. The article does not provide further lab results, hospitalization details, or additional treatment steps.

triage.headline_ja: Cockroach Party創設者アビジート・ディプケ氏、腸チフス診断後に体調不良、医師団が診察予定

triage.notes: 個人の健康状態に関する報道であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての基準を満たさない。腸チフスはインドの風土病であり、単発症例は異常事象に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo : plus de 3 500 cas d'Ebola recensés lors d'une épidémie sans précédent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: more than 3,500 Ebola cases recorded during an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an unprecedented Ebola outbreak—the 17th in the country—first declared on May 15. In about two and a half months, there have been 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, with nearly 90% of cases in Ituri province in the northeast near the South Sudan and Uganda borders. The outbreak is the largest in the country’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. Ongoing insecurity and weak health infrastructure complicate control efforts, and resources are insufficient to manage transmission in violence-affected areas, notably Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：前例のないエボラ流行で3,500人以上の症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、死亡率も高く、治安不安と医療体制の脆弱性により制御が困難な状況であり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 南スーダンとウガンダとの国境付近のイツリ州で症例の約90%が発生しているが、記事では両国での症例発生は明記されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。致死率は約44%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: AVP duikt voor het eerst op bij wilde zwijnen in Finland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Swine Fever first detected in wild boars in Finland.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) has been detected for the first time in Finland in three juvenile wild boars from Virolahti, near the Russian border. The finding, confirmed and reported to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), places Finland among European countries with ASF in wild boar. Finland’s wild boar population is small, estimated at about 2,400, underscoring how difficult it is to prevent virus spread; proximity to Russia, where ASF is longstanding, suggests introduction from that direction. Biosecurity guidance for Dutch pig farmers remains unchanged, emphasizing hygiene, avoiding contact between domestic pigs and wild boar, and vigilance for transport, visitors, and materials. ASF outbreaks continue to threaten the European pork sector, with potential trade restrictions. In early 2026, EU exports to non-EU markets reached 1.76 Mt, down 2% YoY; Spain fell 19%, while Germany (+34%) and Denmark (+8%) rose, with Korea and Vietnam increasing imports despite weaker Chinese demand.

triage.headline_ja: フィンランドの野生イノシシでアフリカ豚熱（ASF）が初めて検出
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはフィンランドの野生イノシシにおけるASF初検出であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ等）のいずれにも該当せず、また動物疾病でありヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響もないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はフィンランドでのASF野生イノシシ初検出が主題であり、ベトナム・中国・韓国等は豚肉貿易統計の文脈でのみ言及されている（発生国ではない）ため、対象国リストに該当する発生地域はない。ASFは動物疾病でありヒトの公衆衛生には直接影響しないため、IHR/WPRO基準は限定的にしか該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo trở thành nơi bùng phát dịch Ebola lớn thứ hai trong lịch sử
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo becomes the site of the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the second-largest in history, driven by Bundibugyo virus. In three months since mid-May, there are over 3,500 confirmed cases and more than 1,500 deaths. It eclipses the 2018–2020 epidemic in DRC and ranks second globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu amid protracted conflict and displacement of over 1 million. Transmission via direct contact with blood, secretions, or body fluids; about two-thirds of deaths occur in the community, and tracing has reached roughly 18,000 of about 135,000 contacts. No licensed vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo. Vaccines are under development by Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India; MBP134 and Remdesivir trials are underway; an international alliance funds vaccine work. The US withdrawal from WHO complicates coordination, but cross-border spread remains unlikely due to surveillance.

article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 positivity rate rose to over 20% nationwide for the first time in week 30 (Jul 20–26, 2026), suggesting a potential shift from moderate to high transmission. The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains the dominant circulating variant, with southern provinces showing higher positivity than the north. Sentinel hospital data show outpatient respiratory samples with COVID-19 at 20.3% and influenza at 14.5%; among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections, COVID-19 accounts for 9.5%, influenza 6.4%, and human metapneumovirus 4.3%. Age distribution indicates highest COVID-19 positivity in 0–4 and 60+ groups, while influenza dominates 5–14 ILI cases. Over three weeks, outpatient COVID positivity nearly doubled from 9.6% to 20.3%. Officials caution data may be unreliable due to concealment; experts warn that surpassing 20% positivity could signal high transmission, with August travel and holidays potentially accelerating spread. Reports from Liaoning and Hunan point to renewed outbreaks.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 3,500 Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 3,532 Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths since the seventh outbreak began on 15 May, surpassing the worst 2018–2020 toll. An eastern focus: Ituri province on the Uganda–South Sudan border accounts for about 90% of cases amid prolonged conflict and weak health infrastructure. The outbreak has spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu, where the M23 armed group controls capitals and large areas with support from Rwanda. Transmission is via direct contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids, with traditional funeral practices amplifying spread. Bundibugyo Ebola virus is currently circulating; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment yet. Vaccination efforts are advancing in research, with Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore beginning vaccine work and an Oxford University–developed platform vaccine entering early human testing after a first-dose to a volunteer. Uganda reports no active outbreak domestically but warns of cross-border risk.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only dengue in the monsoon, seven diseases carry the highest risk; take these precautions during Sawan.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, during Sawan (monsoon) in India, seven diseases carry the highest risk: Jaundice and Hepatitis A from contaminated water and food; Typhoid; Diarrhea and Food Poisoning; Viral Fever (with sore throat, runny nose, cough); Malaria; Dengue; and Chikungunya. Common symptoms include jaundice (yellow eyes/urine), loss of appetite, vomiting and weakness; Typhoid with prolonged fever, headache, abdominal pain, and diarrhea or constipation; diarrhea/food poisoning with frequent loose stools, abdominal pain and dehydration; viral fever with fever and respiratory symptoms; malaria with chills followed by high fever, headache and weakness; dengue with high fever, retro-orbital or body/joint pain and possible low platelets; chikungunya with sudden fever, severe joint pain, swelling of hands/feet, and rash. Prevention emphasizes clean water, safe food, good sanitation, and mosquito protection (long sleeves, removing standing water, repellents). Vulnerable groups include children, elderly, and immunocompromised individuals.

article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness and other viral infections are rising in Delhi during the monsoon, says AIIMS physician Dr. Sanjeev Sinha. Visits show sore throat, runny nose, dry cough, high fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and malaise. High-risk groups include people over 65, children under 5, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, hypertension, heart or kidney disease, cancer, or other illnesses, who may develop severe disease. Diagnosis starts clinically; if influenza is suspected, throat or nasal swabs undergo RT-PCR to confirm influenza and identify strains such as H1N1 or H3N2. Positive cases receive antiviral treatment, plus fever relief, rest, and hydration. Infected individuals should isolate at home for 2–3 days and wear masks to prevent spread; cover coughs and avoid crowds when possible. Seek urgent care for persistent high fever, breathing trouble, low oxygen, confusion, or severe weakness to prevent pneumonia in vulnerable patients. The surge aligns with July–August monsoon in Delhi.

article.articleHeadline: Dr G.P. Talwar: How India pioneered a new leprosy vaccine
article.articleSummary: Leprosy, caused by Mycobacterium leprae, remains linked to host immune response, especially in multibacillary forms. Indian immunologist Gursaran Pran Talwar developed an immunotherapeutic vaccine from a harmless, cultivable mycobacterium—initially designated Mycobacterium w and later named Mycobacterium indicus pranii (MIP)—to train the patient’s immune system. The approach complements, not replaces, multidrug therapy (MDT); heat-killed M. w is used alongside antibiotics to boost bacterial clearance and induce immune changes such as lepromin positivity. In multibacillary leprosy, vaccinated patients showed faster bacterial clearance and reductions in bacterial indices. A landmark study in the Journal of Infectious Diseases documented improved outcomes with combined MDT and M. w vaccination. Field trials extended to endemic regions, including Uttar Pradesh, involving thousands of household contacts and patients, with protective effects observed over several years. Talwar’s work reframed leprosy treatment as a three-way interaction among pathogen, medicine, and host immunity.

article.articleHeadline: México sabrá en noviembre si pierde estatus libre de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico will know in November whether it loses its measles-free status.
article.articleSummary: Mexico and the United States will face an independent epidemiological review in November to determine if they retain measles-free status, according to Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) Director Jarbas Barbosa. The commission will analyze epidemiologic data and issue a recommendation to the director. Barbosa noted that even if either country loses the status, it can be restored through vaccination, vigilant surveillance, and outbreak control—citing Brazil and Venezuela, which lost measles-free status in 2018 and later recovered. He stressed measles' high transmissibility and that outbreaks have caused deaths among indigenous and other vulnerable communities, and that elimination requires vaccination coverage above 95 percent, uniformly across all communities, not just national averages. International travel keeps reintroduction risk. The Americas had achieved measles freedom but Canada’s criteria lapse ended that status. Barbosa also mentioned future pandemic preparedness and a One Health approach, plus Argentina and Brazil's leading mRNA vaccine projects.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Data from the China CDC: Nearly half of respiratory tract infection diagnoses in children under five are related to indoor air pollution — Viruses and pollutants are attacking babies' respiratory tracts together — China Finance Times Net
article.articleSummary: China CDC data link indoor air pollution to nearly half of acute respiratory infections (ARTI) in children under five, with over 1 million China-wide ARTI deaths annually and more than 50% attributable to indoor pollutants; risk rises 2–3x. Children are more vulnerable due to higher breathing rate, lower standing height (0.8–1.2 m) in polluted zones, and immature immunity. Dominant indoor pathogens include influenza, RSV, rhinovirus, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae, with SARS-CoV-2 positivity at 16.3% among sentinel influenza-like illness cases; pollutants such as formaldehyde, benzene, dust mites, and dampness amplify susceptibility, creating a synergistic “1+1>2” effect. Guidance distinguishes air disinfection machines (消字号备案) from ordinary purifiers; zero-ozone certification is mandatory under GB/T 4706.45-2024. The Air Fortress P3 model holds 消字号备案 FB241031-51 (XG1), CMA/CNAS, and zero ozone, reporting 99.99% disinfection for H1N1 and EV71, formaldehyde CADR 420 m³/h, PM CADR 520 m³/h, 28 dB noise, and baby-grade certifications. Takeaways: indoor air quality drives pediatric ARTI; purifiers may be insufficient; choose certified, zero-ozone air disinfection devices for nursery rooms.

The administration will review progress regularly and implement corrective actions where transmission risk remains high.
