triage.triage_reason: 既存の予防的公衆衛生キャンペーンの一環であり、異常な流行や新規の重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの一部地域で季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、本記事は定例的な予防・監視活動の報告。新規発生や異常な増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية وتسجيل أكثر من 3500 إصابة | الصحافة اليوم - يومية اخبارية جامعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 3,500 cases | Today’s Press - a general daily newspaper.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak confirmed in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with health authorities reporting more than 3,500 Ebola virus disease cases in the past two months, a figure surpassing total cases recorded between 2018 and 2020. The outbreak is concentrated in several eastern provinces where armed conflict has persisted for decades. Monitoring and investigations confirmed the spread, and medical teams are pushing intensive vaccination campaigns and containment efforts to curb transmission. Ebola remains one of Africa’s deadliest diseases; the epidemic has claimed more than 15,000 lives across the continent over the past five decades. Public health measures focus on rapid vaccination and outbreak response, even as violence in the affected regions complicates access and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が発生、3,500人以上の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患で3,500例超と過去の流行を上回る規模であり、紛争地域での対応困難も重なりIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 報告された症例数（3,500人）は2018-2020年の流行を上回るとされているが、致死率や具体的な国際的拡散事例の詳細は本文からは不明。紛争地域であることから対応・アクセスに困難があり、外部支援の必要性が高いと推測される。

article.articleHeadline: DVMF: Cebu City ASF case likely caused by backyard pig movement
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) case in Cebu City, Philippines, with laboratory confirmation of nine ASF-positive pigs among 22 at the affected backyard farm; initial mayoral figure of 20 infected later corrected. In total, 19 pigs were culled after containment within four days. DVMF attributes spread to movement of pigs among backyard raisers and weak biosecurity; possible introduction via an owner-brought pig, and sharing of pork from a previously slaughtered pig with nearby residents; tracing points to purchases from Talisay City. Measures include intensified surveillance, 24-hour border control, and border monitoring; Barangay Quiot identified as affected, with information drives in Inayawan and Cogon Pardo; urging pig registration, livestock insurance, and strict biosecurity; swill feeding discouraged. Virus can survive long in the environment: months to years in blood, manure, and frozen pork. As of 1 Aug 2026, no additional lab-confirmed cases; outbreak controlled but not yet ASF-free.

triage.headline_ja: DVMF：セブ市のASF症例は裏庭養豚の移動が原因の可能性
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱はヒトへの健康影響がなく、局地的に封じ込められているが、養豚業への継続的リスクと環境中でのウイルス残存性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 動物疾患（ASF）であり人への感染性・重症度はないが、裏庭養豚間の伝播やバイオセキュリティの弱さ、環境中でのウイルス残存性から継続的な監視が推奨される。国際的な貿易・渡航制限への影響は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spirals out of control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — no vaccine for the current strain
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled under the Bundibugyo strain. As of 1 August 2026, authorities report more than 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five eastern provinces in about two and a half months, surpassing the worst 2018–2020 wave (roughly 3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths). The 17th outbreak wave was declared on 15 May. Ituri province accounts for about 90% of cases, near borders with South Sudan and Uganda; North Kivu and South Kivu are also affected, amid persistent conflict and M23 activity. Transmission occurs via close contact and body fluids, with funeral rites a key driver; humanitarian teams pursue safe burials despite weak health infrastructure. Uganda has declared its outbreak over but remains at risk from the DRC. Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) plans a vaccine, deemed most likely to succeed by WHO; no vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola virus yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能に…現行株にはワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株エボラが3,532例・1,556死亡と過去最悪の流行を超え、複数州に拡大しワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国の流行終息を宣言済みだが、DRCからのリスクに晒され続けているとの言及あり。シンガポールはワクチン開発企業(Hilleman Laboratories)の所在地であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。スーダン・南スーダンは国境近接の言及のみで発生国としての明確な記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases rise across Delhi-NCR during monsoon: Doctors explain why Swine Flu is spreading
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR records a seasonal rise in H1N1 influenza (swine flu) during the monsoon, with outpatient departments reporting a daily influx of patients. Most infections are mild and managed with supportive care; antivirals may be used when indicated. Common symptoms include high fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches and fatigue; nausea or diarrhea may occur. Transmission is facilitated by humid, cooler monsoon conditions and crowded indoor spaces; no new variant is identified. High-risk groups—65+, children under five, pregnant women, and people with diabetes, heart or lung disease, or weakened immunity—face greater risk. Testing is advised when symptoms persist or worsen; early diagnosis improves outcomes. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking, vaccination for seasonal influenza, avoiding crowded indoor spaces, and staying home when unwell.

triage.headline_ja: デリー首都圏でモンスーン期にH1N1感染例が増加:医師が拡大の理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（インフルエンザ）流行であり、新規変異株もなく重症例の増加や異常性を示す情報もないため、通常の季節性流行として見送り。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の毎年恒例のモンスーン期増加であり、多くが軽症で新規変異株も確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ انتشار غير مسبوق.. أكثر من 3500 إصابة بفيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية خلال أشهر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented spread... more than 3,500 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in recent months.
article.articleSummary: Unprecedented Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 3,532 confirmed infections and 1,556 deaths across five provinces since the seventeenth wave began on May 15. Health authorities note the surge as unparalleled, exceeding the country’s worst epidemic in 2018–2020, which affected about 3,500 people with around 2,300 deaths. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected individuals or their body fluids and causes severe hemorrhagic fever. The current wave is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment available in the DRC for this strain, complicating containment. The outbreak highlights the need for intensified surveillance, rapid laboratory confirmation, and robust public health measures to interrupt transmission and manage cases.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない拡大…コンゴ民主共和国でここ数か月に3,500人以上がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模となる前例のないエボラ流行（3,532例、死者1,556人）が発生し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株が原因であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2018-2020年流行（約3,500例、死者約2,300人）を上回る規模と報告。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、封じ込めが困難な状況。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については本文に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Ebola Worsens Hunger in DRC; Cholera Spreads in Sudan
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) has 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths as of July 30, nearing the 2018–2020 peak and expanding to five DR Congo provinces across 48 health zones. Transmission remains rapid, with cases doubling about every 20 days. The outbreak worsens food insecurity in eastern DRC, where about 5 million people face emergency hunger; 2.7 million in Ebola-affected areas are acutely hungry, including 628,000 in catastrophic hunger. WFP has distributed more than 160,000 hot meals at 17 treatment sites. Uganda declared its Ebola outbreak over on July 29 after 20 cases and 2 deaths, with 15 imported from DRC and 5 locally transmitted; border surveillance and cross-border response continue. In Sudan, cholera has reached four states (West/North Kordofan, South Darfur, Khartoum) with 1,330 cases and 114 deaths by July 10; Tawila, North Darfur reports 1,500+ cases; 40% of health facilities are out of service; 33 million people require humanitarian aid. HIV funding gaps threaten decades of progress: PEPFAR budget falls from $5.85B (2025) to around $2.9B (2026), risking thousands of infections; 28 African countries face debt pressures; PEPFAR supports 40–60% of HIV budgets in Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, and Senegal.

triage.headline_ja: 週次健康アップデート：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが飢餓を悪化させ、スーダンでコレラが拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ(Bundibugyo)は3,360例・1,487死亡で2018-2020年ピークに迫る規模で5州48保健区に拡大しており、倍加期間20日という急速な伝播とウガンダへの越境事例も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ、スーダンのコレラ、ウガンダのエボラ終息宣言、西アフリカ諸国のHIV資金問題を含む複合的な週次アップデート。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（スーダン、ウガンダ、コートジボワール、マリ、セネガルはリスト外）。DRCのエボラ拡大が最も深刻でありPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Welt-Aidskonferenz in Rio: Eine Pandemie kehrt zurück
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World AIDS Conference in Rio de Janeiro: A pandemic returns.
article.articleSummary: At the 26th World AIDS Conference in Rio de Janeiro, attention centers on waning U.S. aid as HIV infections rise. PEPFAR, launched in 2003 by George W. Bush as the world’s largest HIV/AIDS program, faces significant cuts under the Trump administration. A Trump-appointed PEPFAR coordinator, Jeff Graham, displayed an Africa map misplacing Nigeria, Mozambique, Ivory Coast and Malawi, prompting apologies and critiques that AI diplomacy misfired. France cut its Global Fund pledge for 2026–2028 by 58% (to €660 million); Germany reduced contributions by 23% and did not send an official minister. UN-AIDS and KFF data show 2025 funding at $6.2 billion, down 25% from 2024’s $8.3 billion. amfAR reports over 1,700 HIV/AIDS sites closed, with 77,000 fewer children in 22 countries served, including about 31,000 fewer in South Africa. The conference warns that funding cuts threaten a renewed spread of HIV/AIDS.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ世界エイズ会議:パンデミックが再来する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHIV/AIDS対策資金（PEPFAR等)の削減に関する政治的・財政的問題を報じたものであり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクや異常事象を示すものではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リオデジャネイロで開催された世界エイズ会議における国際的なHIV/AIDS資金削減（米国PEPFAR、フランス、ドイツ等）の政治的議論を扱っており、特定国での急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。リオデジャネイロは会議開催地に過ぎず、HIV感染拡大の主題国（南アフリカ、ナイジェリア、モザンビーク、コートジボワール、マラウイ）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ŽENU NA LETOVANJU U GRČKOJ UJEO KRPELJ! 40 dana bila u KOMI, ali tek da čujete ono NAJGORE! Stručnjaci poslali HITNO UPOZORENJE! (FOTO)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A TICK BIT A WOMAN ON VACATION IN GREECE! SHE WAS IN A COMA FOR 40 DAYS, BUT WAIT UNTIL YOU HEAR THE WORST PART! EXPERTS ISSUED AN URGENT WARNING! (PHOTO).
article.articleSummary: British woman Viktoria Stelas contracted tick-borne meningitis during a vacation on Syros island, Greece. She developed memory loss and seizures, spending about 40 days in a coma and roughly six months from hospital admission to completion of treatment at a Liverpool specialist center. She now takes 15–18 daily medications and struggles with memory, unable to recall names, though she can recognise people. Diagnosis was confirmed after 42 days in hospital. Tick-borne meningitis is transmitted by ticks in Europe, Russia, and parts of China and Japan; symptoms typically emerge about a week after a bite and include fatigue, headache, seizures, confusion, and speech difficulties. Vaccination is advised at least a month before travel, but is not provided by the NHS and must be obtained privately. About 3% progress to brain inflammation; 97% have no symptoms or only mild flu-like illness. Prevention includes protective clothing and prompt tick removal; awareness is rising among Liverpool experts.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャ旅行中の女性がダニに噛まれた！40日間昏睡状態に、専門家が緊急警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャでの単発のダニ媒介性髄膜炎（マダニ媒介脳炎）症例であり、対象国での発生ではなく、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はInfluenzaとなっているが実際はダニ媒介性髄膜炎（tick-borne encephalitis）の個別症例。発生地はギリシャ（対象国外）で、患者は英国人女性、治療はリバプールで実施。中国・日本は病原体の分布地域として言及されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू-चिकनगुनिया का अटैक तेज, 4 पॉजिटव आए सामने -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue-Chikungunya attack intensifies; 4 positives reported.
article.articleSummary: In Jabalpur, four dengue-positive cases were reported near IT Park: a man; a woman from Bedaghat; a woman from Dhanvantari Nagar; and a student from the Medical College Girls’ Hostel. Bedaghat and Dhanvantari Nagar residents also tested positive for chikungunya. January–July 2026 totals for Jabalpur district: dengue 29 cases, chikungunya 21 cases. Earlier cases included a 30-year-old man and a 48-year-old man with dengue near the Andhmook Bypass area, and three new chikungunya cases from the same vicinity (42-, 45-, and 56-year-old men) presenting with joint pain and fever. Authorities urge vigilance and prompt medical consultation for fever. Public health actions include larval control in public areas, intensified surveillance around Medical College Hospital Gadha and Dhanvantari Nagar, Dengue Dry Day with weekly fogging, house-to-house larva surveys, and larva clearance in hospital campuses and the Collectorate.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・チクングニア熱の感染拡大、4件の陽性が判明
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域(Jabalpur)における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の局地的な発生報告であり、当局が通常の対策（防疫、幼虫駆除等）を実施している段階で、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はインドの蚊媒介性感染症として季節的に流行しており、地方当局による通常の対応（防疫措置、サーベイランス強化）が実施されている。国際的な懸念や渡航制限の必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: State steps up health surveillance in flood-hit areas
article.articleSummary: Odisha’s health and family welfare department intensified post-flood surveillance in Balasore, Bhadrak, Jajpur, Keonjhar, Kendrapada, Jagatsinghpur and Cuttack, anticipating rises in water- and vector-borne diseases. Medical teams have been deployed, MBBS doctors posted at every primary health centre, and anti-snake venom stocked to address potential snakebites as floodwater recedes. District rapid response teams will report suspected outbreaks of diarrhoea, dysentery, gastroenteritis, typhoid, hepatitis, malaria and dengue; ORS, bleaching powder, water testing and clean water supply are ensured. By July 31, 6,491 of 13,662 reported tube wells were affected and 2,710 disinfected; 357 of 642 piped schemes were affected and 101 restored or disinfected. No water-borne outbreak has been reported yet. Public health advisories urge boiled water, malaria/dengue prevention, sanitation, wearing protective clothing, nets, and disinfection of drinking water; control rooms and awareness campaigns are in place.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、洪水被災地域で健康サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で水系・媒介性疾患のアウトブレイクは報告されておらず、行政による予防的サーベイランス強化の段階であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 洪水後の公衆衛生対応として州政府が予防的措置を実施している段階であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクは未確認。今後の水系感染症・媒介性疾患の発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo outbreak overtakes 2018 DRC epidemic to become world's second-largest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 3,626 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever and the largest on record for the Bundibugyo strain. Detected 77 weeks ago, it surpassed the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak (3,481 cases of Zaire strain); only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (>28,000) was larger. Unlike the 2018–2020 outbreak, there is no licensed vaccine specific to Bundibugyo; response relies on intensive surveillance, contact tracing, rapid isolation, infection prevention, and safe burials, with researchers testing experimental vaccines. Ituri Province accounts for most infections, but transmission has spread to neighboring provinces amid insecurity and attacks on health workers, raising concerns about undercounting as some cases remain outside formal health systems. Uganda contained imported cases and declared its outbreak over after 42 days without new infection; Kenya and South Sudan remain alert. Containment depends on sustained funding, case detection, and community engagement; 77th week.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株エボラ流行、2018年DRC流行を上回り史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で3,626例に達し史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行となっており、ワクチン未承認で治安不安による症例把握困難も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは輸入症例を封じ込め終息宣言済み、ケニア・南スーダンは警戒中だが対象国リスト外のため除外。主要な流行地はDRCイトゥリ州を中心とした地域。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الحجم الحقيقى لتفشى إيبولا أعلى 4 مرات من الأرقام الرسمية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The actual extent of the Ebola outbreak is four times higher than the official figures - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest global outbreak. The World Health Organization says the true scale may be up to four times higher than official figures. The outbreak stems from the Bundibugyo strain, which has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Frontline responders face security risks amid armed groups in eastern Congo, and surveillance is strained by vehicle and staffing shortages and community mistrust. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone recorded 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths. Africa CDC warns a $1.4 billion requirement to contain the outbreak; Congo’s May–August plan has $213.9 million funded of $242.4 million. U.S. travel restrictions and quarantine orders are constraining relief efforts, with Samaritan’s Purse scaling back operations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱流行の実際の規模は公式統計の4倍に上る-Youm7
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行(症例3,532件、死者1,556人)が進行中で、WHOは実数が公式統計の4倍に上る可能性を指摘。ワクチン未承認株であり、治安不安・資金不足も深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の流行(2014-2016年西アフリカ流行)や渡航制限措置の文脈で言及されているのみで、現行の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点、資金不足(1.4億ドルの必要額に対し2.139億ドルのみ確保)が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, epidemia in Congo cresce a velocità eccezionale. Oms: "3.605 casi con 1.587 morti" La Nuova Ferrara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Congo epidemic grows at an extraordinary rate. WHO: "3,605 cases with 1,587 deaths" La Nuova Ferrara.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding rapidly, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, a crude fatality rate of 44%. The most recent full reporting week recorded 567 cases and 296 deaths—the highest weekly totals so far. This is the largest Ebola outbreak ever documented in the DRC. Initially limited to Mongbwalu health zone in Ituri, the epidemic has, in the past two months, spread to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo—now affecting 49 health zones. Ongoing transmission, insecurity, displacement, population mobility, and cross-border movement hinder response and raise regional spread risk. National authorities, with WHO and partners, continue broad response measures but call for substantial expansion of activities and regional preparedness to guide priorities across the Africa region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで異例の速さで流行拡大。WHO：「3,605例、死亡1,587例」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が急速に拡大し、致死率44%、5州49保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大のエボラ流行で、致死率44%、週間報告数が過去最高を更新。治安不安、住民移動、越境移動によりさらなる拡大リスクが高い。国際的な支援拡大が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية الحجم الحقيقى لتفشى إيبولا أعلى 4 مرات من الأرقام الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The true scale of the Ebola outbreak is four times higher than the official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the world’s second-largest, with transmission continuing to outpace containment efforts. Government data released recently show 3,532 reported Ebola cases across the DRC and 1,556 deaths, as of August 1, 2026. The World Health Organization says the true scale is four times higher than official figures, indicating substantial undercounting in reported data. The report notes ongoing spread within the country but provides no details on infection sources or laboratory confirmation. These figures reflect nationwide reporting and highlight the severity of the outbreak in the DRC, emphasizing the gap between official counts and the broader epidemiology as authorities monitor the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱の流行の実際の規模は公式数値の4倍に上る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、WHOが公式統計の過小報告(実際は4倍)を指摘するなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 感染源や検査確認状況など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC registra más de 3.500 casos de ébola en un brote sin precedentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC reports more than 3,500 Ebola cases in an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reach over 3,500 cases in two and a half months, the largest on record. The seventeenth outbreak, declared May 15, has 3,532 infections and 1,556 deaths across five provinces. The World Health Organization reports about 90% of cases are in Ituri province, which borders South Sudan and Uganda. Efforts to curb transmission are hindered by insecurity, violence, and weak health infrastructure in affected areas, with resources deemed insufficient, particularly in Ituri and North and South Kivu. In response, Singapore-based Hellmann Laboratories began developing a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, while an Oxford University–developed experimental vaccine has been administered to a volunteer. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists specifically for this strain. Ebola transmits through direct contact with infected people or their fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで前例のないエボラ流行、症例数3,500人超え
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（症例3,532、死亡1,556）が発生し、治安悪化・医療体制脆弱により制御困難、国境地域での国際拡大リスクもありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境接触国として言及されるが、症例発生国はDRCのみと記載されているため対象国リストにあるDRCのみを列挙。シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点として言及のみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's largest Ebola outbreak now more than 3600 cases
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, DR Congo's 17th Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and declared May 15, 2026, is the country’s largest on record. It has spread from Mongbwalu, Ituri, to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo—now affecting 49 health zones (Wanie-Rukula in Tshopo is the latest). Confirmed cases total 3,605 with 1,587 deaths (44% CFR). Ituri remains the epicenter with 3,176 cases (88.1%) and 1,311 deaths (82.6%), CFR 41.3%. The most affected zones are Bunia (880), Rwampara (627), Mongbwalu (541), Nizi (377), Lita (131), and Nyankunde (114), comprising roughly 84% of provincial cases and 74% of national totals. Public health response, in collaboration with WHO, follows a continental six-month preparedness and response plan spanning emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and essential health services, with funding gaps to be addressed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが3600症例を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、致死率44%、5州49保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにRwanda・Romaniaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Haut-Uélé、Tshopo）での拡大のみが述べられており、これら他国での発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, epidemia in Congo cresce a velocità eccezionale. Oms: "3.605 casi con 1.587 morti" - CN24TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, epidemic in Congo grows at an extraordinary rate. WHO: "3,605 cases with 1,587 deaths" - CN24TV
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%) as of July 30. The latest complete week saw 567 cases and 296 deaths, the highest weekly totals to date. Initially limited to Mongbwalu, Ituri, the epidemic has expanded over two months to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—affecting 49 health zones. Ongoing transmission, insecurity, population movement, and cross-border mobility complicate response; authorities, with WHO support, urge substantial scale-up of control measures and regional preparedness across Africa. In Uganda, the health ministry declared the end of the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak on July 28 after 42 days without local transmission; the last case discharged June 16, and the last imported case discharged July 16 after two negatives, with 42 days of monitoring to confirm interruption. Uganda remains at risk from cross-border transmission from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで感染が異例の速さで拡大。WHO「3,605例、死者1,587人」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率44%のエボラ出血熱が5州・49保健地区に拡大し、週間症例数が過去最多を記録するなど深刻かつ異常な拡大を示しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは同系統の流行終息が宣言されたが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでの越境リスクとして言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا أكبر 4 مرات من الأرقام الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak four times larger than official figures.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo now tallies 3,532 reported cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally and the fastest-spreading on record. The surge follows less than three months since the outbreak began, driven by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain for which no vaccines or approved treatments are available. The African CDC warns the outbreak’s rapid expansion outpaces containment efforts. Response capacity is strained by insecurity in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and funding shortages, with Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates suggesting containment could require about $1.4 billion—three times previous estimates. Karl Sko, Acting Head of the UN World Food Programme, emphasized the urgent need for heightened international attention. The report highlights the ongoing crisis and the need for robust public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱の流行、公式統計の4倍に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大となるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（3,532症例、1,556死亡）が発生し、ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株が原因で国際的懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: 致死率約44%と高く、治安不安と資金不足により対応能力が逼迫。封じ込めには約14億ドルが必要と推定され、国際的な緊急対応が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Ölümcül salgın hızla yayılıyor! Can kaybı 1500'ü geçti, henüz aşısı yok
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly outbreak is spreading rapidly! The death toll has surpassed 1,500; there is no vaccine yet.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant, the fastest-spreading Ebola event on record, with about 3,360 laboratory-confirmed cases across five eastern provinces. Deaths exceed 1,500 (roughly 45% fatality). Declared May 15, the outbreak centers in Ituri, the main hotspot, with transmission raising alarms at WHO. Factors hindering control include security issues, mining activity, and high population density. About two-thirds of deaths occur among people without access to healthcare, and unsafe handling of bodies accelerates spread. There is no approved vaccine yet; vaccine trials begun in July are expected to take roughly four months. International support is urged to accelerate containment, protect health workers, and prevent further case growth.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的な感染症が急速に拡大！死者数は1500人を超え、まだワクチンはない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が過去最速のペースで拡大し、致死率約45%、ワクチン未承認という深刻な状況でWHOも警戒を強めているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による過去最速の拡大、致死率約45%、ワクチン未承認、治安・鉱山活動・人口密度の高さが対策を困難にしている。安全でない遺体処理が感染拡大の一因。国際支援が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola atteint un cap record en nombre de cas d'infections jamais enregistrés à cause de la maladie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola outbreak reaches a record high in the number of infection cases never recorded due to the disease.
article.articleSummary: 3,532 laboratory-confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases and 1,556 deaths were reported as of July 29, 2026 in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, surpassing the 2018–2020 tenth outbreak. The outbreak spans 48 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Ituri accounting for about 90% of cases (28 zones). There are 807 patients in isolation or hospital, and 626 recoveries; the case fatality rate is 44.1% and contact follow-up stands at 78.7%. The provinces reporting the majority of cases are Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, plus a single zone in South Kivu (Miti-Murhesa) under surveillance after 63 days with no new case. Government measures include risk communication, community engagement, entry-point controls, survivor promotion, stigma reduction, and protection of affected populations; no information on infection source or on imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行が過去最多の感染者数記録を更新

article.articleHeadline: اكتمال الاستعدادات لانطلاق الحملة القومية للاستجابة لوباء الدفتيريا - أغسطس 2026 - اخبار السودان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Completion of preparations for the launch of the national campaign to respond to the diphtheria outbreak - August 2026 - Sudan News
article.articleSummary: Sudan announces completion of preparations for a national diphtheria response vaccination campaign as of August 1, 2026. The effort targets about 2,712,304 people aged 5–20 and will be delivered via fixed centers, temporary sites, and mobile teams across multiple states. Phase 1 includes a second round in Damazin (Blue Nile); Haia (Red Sea); Kassala localities (the city, Atbara River area, Halfa, Qurba); Karri locality (Khartoum); Dongola, Daba, Merowe (Northern State); plus a third round in Nile State. Phase 2 covers the first round in Sheikan (North Kordofan); Bahri (Khartoum); and West Kassala and Aruma (Kassala). Campaign windows run Aug 1–6 (Blue Nile, Red Sea, North Kordofan, Nile), Aug 2–7 (Kassala), and Aug 10–15 (Khartoum, Northern State). The diphtheria vaccine is safe, free, and effective after three doses; families should bring vaccination cards for verification. A federal coordination chamber will monitor readiness.

article.articleHeadline: Yunanistan tatilinde kene ısırdı: 42 gün komada kaldı, hala günde 18 ilaç kullanıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tick bite on vacation in Greece: spent 42 days in a coma, still taking 18 medications a day.
article.articleSummary: 51-year-old Victoria Stellas, a Wales resident, developed tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) after a holiday on Siros Island, Greece, in 2019. After returning to the UK, she suffered nocturnal seizures and spent 42 days in a medically induced coma; laboratory confirmation followed. Post-discharge she endures memory loss and epileptic seizures, taking 15–18 medications daily and losing two jobs. NHS guidance urges vaccination at least one month before travel to risk areas, plus protective measures such as long sleeves, DEET, and post-exposure tick checks. TBE is a viral infection seen in parts of Europe, Russia, China, and some areas of Japan; cases are rising globally, though severe disease is rare. Transmission is mainly via infected tick bites, rarely via unpasteurized dairy; not human-to-human. Symptoms typically occur in two stages: an initial flu-like phase, then CNS involvement with severe headache, neck stiffness, cognitive changes, seizures, or coma.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャ休暇中にマダニに刺される：42日間昏睡状態、今も1日18種類の薬を服用
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に発生した個人の症例を紹介する human interest 記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や地域的な流行拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年にギリシャで感染した個人（ウェールズ在住）の体験談であり、中国・日本・ロシアなどはTBEの一般的な流行地域として背景説明で言及されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生事例はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá registra queda de 88,39% nos casos de Covid-19, enquanto influenza segue em alta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá records an 88.39% drop in COVID-19 cases, while influenza continues to rise.
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá records an 88.39% drop in Covid-19 cases in weeks 1–29 of 2026 (Jan 4–Jul 25), with 121 cases (96 residents, 25 from other municipalities) and 5 deaths (2 residents, 3 non-residents). Resident COVID-19 mortality: 0.29/100k. Compared with weeks 1–29 of 2025 (1,043 cases), this is a major decline. Influenza A and B notifications rise to 2,386 cases (1,858 residents, 528 from other municipalities) with 21 influenza-related deaths (16 residents). Relative increase: 74.95% vs 2025, linked to higher circulation, low vaccination coverage, and expanded testing; many reports from private health networks. Influenza vaccination available in 72 Family Health Units for priority groups: elderly ≥60, children 6 months–<6, pregnant, postpartum, health workers, teachers. Children ≤6 years most affected (966 cases); other groups: 15–59 (673), 7–14 (572), ≥60 (175). SRAG: 1,463 hospitalizations (1,043 Cuiabá residents), 120 deaths; COVID-19 SRAG: 27 hospitalizations, 5 deaths; influenza SRAG: 332 hospitalizations, 21 deaths (16 Cuiabá residents).

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ、COVID-19症例が88.39%減少、一方でインフルエンザは増加傾向が続く
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・クイアバ市の定例サーベイランス報告であり、季節性インフルエンザの増加とCOVID-19の減少という予測可能な傾向を示すのみで、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行拡大とCOVID-19の減少を報告する自治体の定例疫学速報。ワクチン接種体制やサーベイランス強化も既に実施されており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情确诊病例超3500例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 3,500 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths (case fatality rate ~44.1%), making it the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. The United Nations notes the outbreak is among the fastest-spreading in history. Transmission has spread to five provinces—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—with 807 patients still in isolation or treatment and 626 recovered. The causative virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV); there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. Africa CDC warns that deaths in the first three months were about five times higher than in comparable past outbreaks, signaling a severe and ongoing public health challenge.

triage.notes: 承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルス(BDBV)株による流行で、致死率約44.1%、5州に拡大し807人が隔離・治療中。国連・Africa CDCも異例の速さと深刻さを警告しており、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : à Kisangani, seule une alerte sur trois est investiguée et le suivi des contacts de Kabondo reste à zéro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: in Kisangani, only one in three alerts is investigated, and Kabondo's contact tracing remains at zero.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak #17; Situation Report No. 077, as of July 30. No new cases that day; cumulative 3,605 cases, 1,587 deaths across 49 of 140 health zones. In Tshopo, 71 alerts, 24 investigated within 24 hours; Nord-Kivu 873/913 alerts investigated (95.6%), Ituri 367/524 (70.0%). Kabondo health zone reports 0% contact tracing, despite one confirmed case and one death. Overall contact tracing: 43 of 65 exposed contacts seen (66.2%), lowest among reporting provinces. Lab concerns: non-conforming samples in Lubunga and Opienge; some samples arrive without investigation forms. Four of ten entry/exit points activated (21.1%). Treatment capacity: province has 20 beds (5% occupancy); Nord-Kivu reported 202 patients in 141 beds (data not updated for four cycles). Vaccination none reported; a candidate vaccine entered Phase 1 on July 24. Risk of urban/river/transboundary spread if extended to Tshopo and Haut-Uélé.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：キサンガニでは警報の3件に1件しか調査されず、カボンドの接触者追跡はゼロのまま
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（累計3,605例、1,587死亡）が継続中であり、接触者追跡・警報調査の不備、都市部・河川・越境拡大のリスクが指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : MSF réhabilite un stade pour compenser un autre occupé par Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: MSF rehabilitates a stadium to compensate for another stadium occupied by Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kasanga-Tuha Stadium in Bungulu, Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, is being rehabilitated by MSF to compensate for the Stade des Sœurs Orantes in Cité Belge, currently occupied by an Ebola Treatment Center. Works are progressing, though hampered by regular rains and machine outages; the initial contract envisaged 14 days to hand over the refurbished facility. The upgrade will bring international-standard dimensions and a modern venue capable of hosting high-level competitions, addressing Beni’s chronic deficit of sporting infrastructure. EUFBE president Nasson Wazi-Wazi welcomes the project as a catalyst for socio-sport development and local engagement. The stadium replacement supports local football ambitions while the Ebola treatment operations continue at the other site.

article.articleHeadline: Bunia : un centre de traitement Ebola enregistre son 101ème patient guéri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia: An Ebola Treatment Center Records Its 101st Recovered Patient - ACP
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) at Centre médical évangélique (CME) in Bunia reports the recovery of its 101st Ebola patient as of August 1, 2026. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) confirmed the milestone, noting that comprehensive care—medical treatment, food support, and psychosocial assistance—was provided upon arrival at the center. The progress is attributed to ground actions by response teams coordinated by INSP Director-General Dr. Dieudonné Mwamba, with 23 Ebola treatment centers currently operational in Ituri. Officials urged remaining in-patients to remain hopeful, as discharged patients are expected today or tomorrow, underscoring that recovery remains possible with continued support. This milestone reflects ongoing Ebola control efforts in Ituri, DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア:エボラ治療センターで101人目の回復患者を記録 - ACP

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 94 cas confirmés, 49 décès et 15 guéris enregistrés à Nia-Nia(médecin chef de zone) - ACP

The response emphasizes rapid reporting of suspected cases and adherence to health measures to curb transmission. No additional details on infection source or imported cases are provided. article.articleHeadline: Congo : l'épidémie d'Ebola s'intensifie à un rythme "exceptionnel", avertit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: the Ebola outbreak is intensifying at an 'exceptional' pace, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating at an 'exceptional' pace. It is now the largest Ebola outbreak reported in the DRC, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality 44%) as of 30 July 2026. Declared on 15 May after delays, the Bundibugyo variant currently has no vaccine or treatment. The epidemic began in Mongbwalu, Ituri, and has spread in the past two months to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The most recent week documented 567 cases and 296 deaths; health-care workers account for 151 infections (44 deaths). The outbreak follows the deadliest DRC Ebola episode (2018–2020) which caused about 2,300 deaths and 3,500 cases. Authorities and partners are scaling up responses, but insecurity, population displacement, and cross-border movements challenge efforts. Uganda reports its outbreak ended, though risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の流行がWHOも警告する『異例』のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率44%・5州に拡大・医療従事者感染多数とWHOが異例の速度で警戒を表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は終息と報告されているが、越境移動によるリスクは残るとされる。DRC国内5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）に拡大中、Bundibugyo変異株にはワクチン・治療法が存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में तेजी से फैल रहा स्वाइन फ्लू (H1N1), जानिए कैसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu (H1N1) spreading rapidly during the monsoon season; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) is spreading rapidly in India during the monsoon season, driven by humidity and temperature shifts that favor transmission. It is a contagious respiratory infection that can spread from infected pigs to humans via coughs and sneezes, and through contact with contaminated surfaces or crowded places. Common symptoms include high fever, dry cough, sore throat, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, nasal congestion, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea. Distinguishing flu from a common cold hinges on higher fever and profound fatigue. Preventive measures: frequent handwashing, wearing masks in crowded areas, avoiding touching the face, maintaining distance from symptomatic individuals, boosting immunity with a healthy diet, and getting the flu vaccine after consulting a doctor. Seek medical care if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or fever persisting 3–4 days. Do not self-medicate; antivirals may be prescribed by a clinician.

article.articleHeadline: Suspected dangerous infectious disease reported in woman returning
article.articleSummary: Suspected dangerous infectious disease case in a woman returning from Uganda is under investigation by Czech health authorities. The patient is being transferred from a hospital in Hradec Králové to the specialized infectious diseases unit at Prague's Bulovka Hospital. Health Ministry spokeswoman Naďa Chattová said the likelihood of confirming infection is very low and there is no risk to the public. Uganda has reported Ebola cases in areas bordering the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the Czech Foreign Ministry advises against travel to the region. In May, Bulovka Hospital admitted an American doctor under an international cooperation programme after concerns of possible Ebola exposure; tests ultimately ruled out the infection.

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo verschärft sich - Wissenschaft - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: Ebola outbreak in the Congo worsens - Science - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleSummary: 1 August 2026: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo widens, becoming the largest on record for the country. The World Health Organization reports 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, with 651 survivors. In the last week, 567 infections and 296 fatalities were recorded. The Bundibugyo variant is involved; there is no approved vaccine yet, though a newly developed vaccine is under trial. The outbreak threatens neighboring countries, prompting calls for expanded, intensified measures to regain control. Security challenges, rebel conflicts, widespread displacement, and public distrust hinder response efforts. Many infections occur outside treatment centers, and traditional burials remain highly infectious, though aid groups provide safer, dignified burial options. Contact tracing remains suboptimal, with fewer than 80% of contacts monitored for three weeks, far short of the 95% target for containment.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病：コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行が悪化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの過去最大規模のエボラ流行であり、死亡率も高く、国際的拡大の懸念や対応の困難さが明確に示されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行。Bundibugyo変異株が関与し、承認済みワクチンなし。治安不安・紛争・住民の不信感が対応を阻害し、接触者追跡率も目標を下回っている。近隣国への拡大リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo verschärft sich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: Ebola outbreak in the Congo worsens.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak worsens: 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, with 651 survivors. In the past week, 567 infections and 296 deaths were reported—the highest weekly totals to date. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is involved; there is no licensed vaccine against this variant yet, though a candidate vaccine is being tested. The outbreak is the largest the country has experienced; the previous record (2018–2020) had 3,317 cases. Experts warn true infections exceed confirmed counts, as many patients do not seek care and deaths are sometimes attributed to other illnesses. Only about 80% of contacts are observed over three weeks, short of the 95% target. Ongoing insecurity, rebel conflict, displacement, and distrust hinder response. Safe and dignified burials are being offered by NGOs; risk of spread to neighboring countries remains.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病:コンゴのエボラ流行が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が悪化しており、致死率が高く、ワクチン未承認の変異株、治安悪化による対応困難、周辺国への拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模の流行（過去最多3,317例を上回る3,605例）、致死率約44%、Bundibugyo型に対するライセンス取得ワクチンが存在せず、接触者追跡率も目標未達で、治安悪化により対応が阻害されている。周辺国への波及リスクが明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO警告：剛果伊波拉疫情異常加劇　創史上最大規模 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying abnormally, the largest on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the largest on record for the country. Declared May 15 in the Ituri province near South Sudan and Uganda, the outbreak has spread to four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, driven by security instability, displacement, and cross-border movement. As of July 30, 2026, the DRC reports 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%), surpassing the 2018–2020 toll. There is no approved vaccine or therapy yet. WHO warns the epidemic is intensifying at an abnormal pace, necessitating a substantial scale-up of medical response. Vaccine development is accelerating: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) is developing a promising vaccine, while Oxford University’s Bundibugyo vaccine has entered clinical trials with the first volunteer dosed last week. Cross-border risk is heightened, including areas controlled by the M23 group.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が異常に激化、史上最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率44%、複数州へ拡大し国境を越えるリスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、南キブ州など）が主題。ウガンダ、スーダンは国境地域として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれず、シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点としての言及のみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: une enquête de terrain fait remonter le début de l'épidémie à janvier, quatre mois avant la déclaration officielle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a field investigation pushes back the start of the outbreak to January, four months before the official declaration.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) marks its 17th outbreak, officially declared May 15, 2026. A field investigation reported by Science on July 30 traces earliest foci to January 2026 in Mongbwalu, Ituri, with over 500 suspected cases before declaration. The non–peer‑reviewed analysis, funded by the World Health Organization, relies on 97 interviews with healthcare workers, community leaders, survivors, relatives of victims, coffin makers and cemetery workers, plus medical records, photos, WhatsApp exchanges and funeral biographies. It shows transmission established before recognition: multiple household chains, deaths among frontline workers, private clinics shutting, and a cemetery with up to 20 burials per day. Thirteen frontline staff died and 42 fell ill before recovery. Delayed alert arises from misattribution of deaths (HIV, TB, mining) and a “culture of secrecy” favoring private clinics. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola; diagnostics were limited. As of July 26, 2026, 3,200 confirmed cases and 1,405 deaths (CFR 43.9%), with spread from Ituri to Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Sud-Kivu. May timeline: alert May 8, declaration May 15; January start remains a revision not yet peer‑reviewed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：現地調査により、流行開始が公式発表の4カ月前の1月に遡ることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 第17次エボラ流行が既に公式宣言され、確定症例3200例・死亡1405例（致死率43.9%）に達し、複数州へ拡大中であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ型）に関する現地調査報道。発生地域として挙げられたTshopo, South Kivu, Nord-Kivu, Ituriは全てDRC国内の州であり、DRCとして一括計上。既に公式流行として認識されている進行中のアウトブレイクであり、続報および既存のRRA更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UNAIDS alerta para risco de ressurgimento da epidemia de HIV no mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNAIDS warns of the risk of a resurgence of the HIV epidemic worldwide.
article.articleSummary: UNAIDS warns that funding cuts and reduced prevention services risk reversing decades of HIV progress, even as AIDS 2026 in Rio de Janeiro spotlights breakthrough prevention tools. The report notes 2025 global new HIV infections at 1.2 million and AIDS-related deaths at 570,000, the lowest in 30 years; since 2010 infections fell 42%, while child infections dropped 69% (300,000 to 93,000). Seven countries cut infections by about 80% since 2010; 11 others achieved the 95-95-95 targets. Yet 21 countries reported rising infections in 2025, about 22% of people living with HIV remain untreated, and roughly half of infected children lack antiretroviral therapy. Official development assistance for HIV fell 23% in 2025; HIV-specific funding declined from $8.8B to $7.3B. Brazil expanded PrEP access (+41%). Two cases of long-term HIV remission were reported after CCR5-donor stem cell transplants, though this approach is not broadly applicable.

triage.headline_ja: UNAIDS、世界的なHIVエピデミック再燃のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症(HIV)に関するUNAIDSの世界的な年次報告記事であり、特定の国における急性アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。資金削減への懸念表明が中心。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロでのAIDS2026会議とグローバルなUNAIDS報告に関する内容で、ブラジル固有のHIVアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、ブラジルはverified_locationsから除外した。HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、EBSの新興感染症探知の対象としては優先度が低い。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo s'intensifie à un rythme "exceptionnel", avertit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying at an 'exceptional' rate, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is expanding at an ‘exceptional’ rate, according to WHO, now the largest and most deadly Ebola event in the country’s history. Declared May 15 with delays, the Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or treatment. The epicenter was Mongbwalu in Ituri, but transmission has spread over two months to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. By 30 July, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality 44%) were reported, with a record 567 cases and 296 deaths in the latest week. The previous major outbreak (2018–2020) involved about 3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths. A WHO‑promising vaccine is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based); separately, Oxford University in the UK is testing a Bundibugyo vaccine using the AstraZeneca platform, with the first-dose administered last week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、WHOが「異例」の速さで拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行（Bundibugyo variant、ワクチン・治療法未確立）が5州に拡大し、致死率44%と深刻。IHR基準を複数満たしPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variantによる過去最大規模の流行で、5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）に拡大。WHOが史上最大・最も致死率の高い流行と警告。ワクチン開発（Hilleman Laboratories, Oxford/AstraZeneca platform）が進行中だが未承認。SingaporeやUKは研究開発拠点として言及されており、発生地域には含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak tops 3,500 cases - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: 3,532 Ebola cases confirmed across five provinces in DR Congo as of 1 August 2026, with 1,556 deaths. The outbreak center is northeastern Ituri, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with detections in North Kivu and South Kivu. This is DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The CME Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, Ituri, handles frontline sampling. Earlier data showed 2,000 confirmed cases on July 15, two months after the outbreak was declared. A vaccine described by the WHO as the most promising will be developed by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore; Oxford University is testing another Bundibugyo vaccine, with the first volunteer dosed last week. Uganda has declared Ebola-free locally this week but remains at risk per the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数3,500件を超える
triage.triage_reason: 5州にまたがり3,532症例・1,556死亡（致死率約44%）と大規模かつ深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、南スーダン・ウガンダ国境地域での発生により国際的拡大リスクも認められるため、フルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン・シンガポールは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは今週ローカルでのエボラ終息を宣言したが、WHOはリスクが残るとしている。承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブジョ株による第17回目のDRCアウトブレイクである点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC s'intensifie à un rythme "exceptionnel", avertit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is intensifying at an exceptionally rapid pace, the WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is intensifying at an exceptional pace, the WHO warns. As of July 30, there were 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%), with a record 567 cases and 296 deaths in the last week. Caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment, the epidemic is the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC, declared May 15. It began in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, and has spread over the past two months to five provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo, in regions with fragile state control and weak health infrastructure. The 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC caused about 2,300 deaths among nearly 3,500 cases. WHO calls for intensified response amid sustained transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、「例外的な」速さで拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による過去最大規模のエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、致死率44%と極めて深刻。IHR基準を複数満たしピックアップ相当。
triage.notes: WHOが対応強化を呼びかけており、2018-2020年流行を上回る過去最大規模のDRCエボラ流行。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株であることが特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Záchranáři převezli na Bulovku ženu s podezřením na vysoce nakažlivou nemoc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paramedics transported a woman suspected of having a highly contagious disease to Bulovka Hospital.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-01, a special biohazard team evacuated a woman suspected of a highly contagious disease from University Hospital Hradec Králové to Bulovka University Hospital in Prague, using a biobox isolation unit to prevent environmental contamination. The patient’s exact diagnosis and health status were not disclosed. She had recently returned from Uganda, a country with documented outbreaks of viral hemorrhagic fevers. The article cites Ebola and Marburg as among the most serious risks in the region, along with Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever and Lassa fever, which can spread through infected animals and, in later stages, by human contact. Czech Foreign Ministry had previously warned against travel to Uganda; Uganda closed the border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo to non-essential travel and imposed mandatory quarantine for returning residents. Bulovka houses a facility equipped for suspected high-risk infections; no laboratory confirmation is reported.

triage.headline_ja: 救急隊員が高致死性感染症の疑いのある女性をブロフカ病院へ搬送
triage.triage_reason: チェコで出血熱疑いの単一症例が発生し隔離対応中だが、診断未確定でウガンダ・DRCなど対象国での確定症例情報はないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダ渡航歴があり、ウガンダはDRCとの国境を非常時渡航に限定し検疫を実施しているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれずDRCでの確定症例情報も記載なし。診断確定情報が出るまで経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 3,500 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s ongoing Ebola outbreak has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, a case-fatality rate of about 44.1%, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. As of July 31, 2026, 807 patients remain in isolation or treatment, with 626 recoveries. The United Nations calls it one of the fastest-spreading outbreaks in history. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral therapy at this time. Africa CDC notes a high mortality burden, with deaths in the first three months five times higher than during comparable periods of past outbreaks, underscoring the ongoing severity of the situation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の確定症例が3,500例を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し3,500例超・死亡率44.1%と重篤で、史上2番目の大規模流行かつ史上最速級の拡大とされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 北キブ州(North Kivu)への言及があるが対象国リストのDRC全体に含まれる。承認されたワクチン・特異的抗ウイルス治療がなく、致死率44.1%と極めて高い。国連・Africa CDCも史上最速級の拡大と警告しており、国際的関与が既に進んでいる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO:lta varoitus ebolasta: Epidemia kiihtyy poikkeuksellisesti Kongossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of Ebola: The outbreak is accelerating unusually in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating unusually, the World Health Organization warns. The epidemic, which began in May, is now the country's largest recorded outbreak. Approximately 3,600 infections and about 1,600 deaths have been reported. WHO calls for a major intensification of health-care actions to control transmission. The United States has barred repatriation flights for its citizens from Congo due to Ebola risk. As of August 1, 2026, it is the most severe Ebola outbreak documented in the country, demanding sustained international and local coordination. The situation remains ongoing, underscoring the need for rapid surveillance and public-health measures to avert further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ熱に警告：コンゴでの流行が異例の速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、感染者約3600人・死者約1600人に達し、WHOが対応強化を要請、米国も渡航制限を実施しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Bipartisan pair of senators urge Rubio to release aid to African women, children at risk of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Senators Murkowski (R‑AK) and Shaheen (D‑NH) urge Rubio to release $608 million in congressionally approved international family‑planning funds and distribute $1.7 million in already purchased supplies for Ebola‑affected women and infants in East Africa. Supplies stored at a facility in Geel, Belgium, could be destroyed if not used. They warn Ebola during pregnancy causes nearly 100% fetal loss and catastrophic maternal hemorrhage, arguing that voluntary family planning and access to clinics can save lives and reduce transmission. They request a humanitarian exception to support UN Population Fund clinics in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). CDC data as of July 29 show the DRC with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths (~44% mortality); Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. The earliest known case was a health worker in Ituri Province; WHO alert on May 5, with Bundibugyo virus confirmed around May 15. US response cost nears $1 billion.

triage.headline_ja: 超党派の上院議員2名、ルビオ国務長官にエボラ感染リスクにあるアフリカの女性・子どもへの支援解放を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,532症例・1,556死亡（致死率約44%）という深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、米国上院議員が人道支援解放を要請するなど社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラ流行に対する米国上院議員の人道支援要請に関する内容。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国・ベルギー・モザンビークは資金拠出・保管場所等の文脈で言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo em alerta: Grande São Paulo amplia vacinação para conter avanço da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles on alert: Greater São Paulo expands vaccination to curb the spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Greater São Paulo launches expanded measles vaccination campaign targeting residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, starting Monday, Aug 3, to curb rising cases. The MMR vaccine will be administered to all in that age range, even if previously vaccinated; the dose zero applies to 6-11 months (not a substitute for the 12- and 15-month doses). Since 2026, the state epidemiological center confirms 15 measles cases: 12 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos; the most recent in Guarulhos involved an unvaccinated child. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and death. State vaccination coverage for first and second doses trails the 95% target at 77.5% and 65.5%, respectively. Travelers from World Cup nations should monitor measles signs. Authorities emphasize vaccination for travelers and reinforce multivaccination and information via the Vacina 100 Dúvidas portal.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹に警戒:サンパウロ首都圏、感染拡大抑制のためワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が継続的に発生し、ワクチン接種率が目標を下回る中で拡大予防接種キャンペーンが実施されており、地域内での感染拡大リスクと行政の対応強化が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における麻疹症例増加とワクチン接種率低下（1回目77.5%、2回目65.5%、目標95%未満）を受けた地域拡大接種キャンペーンの記事。ワールドカップ関連渡航者への注意喚起も含まれるが、国際的拡大の確証情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva número de mortos para 1.587 e confirma 3.605 casos de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises the death toll to 1,587 and confirms 3,605 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,587 Ebola deaths and 3,605 confirmed cases from the outbreak that began May 15 in Ituri and spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. As of July 30, CFR is 44%. About 748 infected are in isolation or hospitalized; 651 are recovering; contact tracing is 75.3%. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, second-largest by infections, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths); the worst was 2014–2016 West Africa (~11,000 deaths, 28,000 infections). It started in Ituri, bordering South Sudan and Uganda; Uganda reported 20 infections total (15 imported from DRC; 2 deaths) and declared Ebola-free on July 28. The strain is Bundibugyo, with 30–50% mortality and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO flags high risk for sub-Saharan Africa, low global risk. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、死者数を1,587人に引き上げ、エボラ感染確認数3,605件を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ流行は死者1,587人・感染3,605件、CFR44%と深刻で、過去2番目の規模かつウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはサブサハラアフリカに対して高リスク、世界的には低リスクと評価。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo amplia proteção contra a poliomielite | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo expands protection against polio | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination in the State of São Paulo, Brazil, expands routine protection with a second IPV booster starting August 3, 2026. The updated schedule includes three IPV doses at 2, 4, and 6 months, plus two boosters at 15 months and 4 years. For children in the 0–6 years 11 months 29 days age group who completed the basic three-dose series, a booster will be given with a six‑month interval after the last dose. A nationwide Multivaccination Campaign runs in 645 municipalities to update vaccination cards for children and adolescents under 15, urging parents to bring the vaccination booklet to verify doses. The goal is 95% vaccination coverage; current coverage was 75.49% up to May 2026. Brazil has been polio-free since 1989 (area free since 1994). All vaccines are available at Basic Health Units across São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: サンポウロ州、ポリオワクチン接種スケジュールを拡充 | TVS+
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における定期ワクチン接種スケジュールの拡充とキャンペーンの案内であり、実際のポリオ症例の発生報告ではない。ブラジルは1989年以降ポリオフリーであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は症例発生ではなくルーチンワクチン接種プログラムの拡充に関する行政広報であるため、対象国リストに該当する感染症イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo s'intensifie à un rythme " exceptionnel ", s'alarme l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying at an 'exceptional' pace, the WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying at an 'exceptional' pace, the World Health Organization said on Saturday, August 1, 2026. The WHO warns of sustained transmission and an alarming acceleration of spread within the DRC, signaling a mounting public health threat. The report highlights heightened transmission dynamics as the outbreak persists, though the excerpt does not provide specific case or death counts. The language signals an urgent call for heightened surveillance, rapid response measures, and international attention to curb further spread. With ongoing transmission localized to the DRC, authorities face challenges in containment and monitoring of new infections as the outbreak continues to evolve.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が「例外的な」速さで拡大、WHOが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ流行の「例外的な」加速を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。続報でのデータ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Campanha nacional alerta para os riscos do VSR e reforça a importância da imunização em gestantes e bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National campaign warns about the risks of RSV and reinforces the importance of vaccination for pregnant women and infants.
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) presents a major risk to Brazilian children under two, driving bronchiolitis and pneumonia with severe outcomes and deaths concentrated in this age group. Brazil’s Sociedade Brasileira de Imunizações launched the campaign “Todos contra o VSR - Proteção desde o Início” to educate pregnant women, the general public, and health professionals. Two protective strategies are emphasized: (1) maternal vaccination against RSV starting at 28 weeks of gestation to transfer antibodies to the fetus, protecting newborns; and (2) monoclonal antibody prophylaxis given to newborns, especially preterm infants and those with risk factors, as recommended by the Unified Health System (SUS). The awareness effort includes medical video lectures, a themed website, social media content, and video testimonials from mothers and clinicians, including Dr. Drauzio Varella, with support from multiple health institutions to underscore vaccination during pregnancy and newborn care as the most effective prevention of severe respiratory disease.

triage.headline_ja: 全国キャンペーンがRSVのリスクについて警鐘を鳴らし、妊婦と乳児への予防接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する予防啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性ウイルスに対する予防啓発キャンペーンの記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de sarampo motiva ampliação da vacinação em todo o Estado a partir de segunda-feira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles alert prompts expansion of vaccination across the state starting Monday
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak triggers expanded vaccination in São Paulo state, Brazil. Authorities report 15 measles cases in the state this year, prompting active case finding and a booster push for children. In line with the Ministry of Health, the government expanded vaccination to people aged 6–59 across 645 municipalities during a multivaccination campaign from August 3 to September 1, 2026. The effort aims to lift coverage of the measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine, currently 77.5% for first dose and 65.5% for second dose, well below the 95% target. Priority areas include the Metropolitan Region, notably the state capital São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. The campaign also updates vaccination records for polio, COVID-19, influenza, yellow fever, hepatitis, and more than 15 other diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹警報を受け、月曜日から州全体でワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹15例発生し、ワクチンカバー率が目標を大きく下回っているため、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあり、政府が大規模な予防接種キャンペーンを実施している。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染力を持ち、ワクチン接種率が目標（95%）を大きく下回っているため、地域拡大の可能性がある。現時点では重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、国内での対応が進められている。

article.articleHeadline: Na Bulovku přivezli ženu po návratu z Ugandy. Má podezření na vysoce nakažlivou nákazu | TN.cz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman who returned from Uganda was brought to Bulovka Hospital. She is suspected of having a highly contagious infection.
article.articleSummary: On Saturday afternoon, a woman who had returned from Uganda was transported to Prague's Bulovka Hospital with suspected highly dangerous infection. Uganda had recently grappled with an Ebola outbreak. Ministry of Health spokesperson Naďa Chattová said the probability of confirmation is very low. The Faculty Hospital Hradec Králové reported standard operations and no public risk. The patient was moved to Bulovka under clearly defined safety measures. Bulovka is a specialized center for dangerous infectious diseases, with procedures practiced in cooperation with hospitals, hygienic services, and rescue services. Previously, in May, Bulovka also hospitalized an American doctor who had contact with Ebola in Congo; he arrived by special flight and, after 21 days in quarantine without symptoms, was released in June.

triage.headline_ja: ブルフカ病院にウガンダ帰国後の女性搬送、高度感染症の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例はチェコ（対象国外）で発生し、確定可能性は低いとされている。ウガンダのエボラ流行は背景情報であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本事例はチェコの病院での疑い例報告であり、確定可能性は低いとされる。ウガンダやコンゴでのエボラ流行は文脈情報として言及されているが、記事の主題は輸入疑い例そのものであり、対象国（DRC, Uganda等）での実際の発生事象を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO varoittaa: Ebolaepidemia Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa kiihtyy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating. As of August 1, 2026, the outbreak has reached about 3,600 cases and 1,600 deaths, the largest recorded Ebola epidemic in the country. The epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda. The virus has spread to four additional provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, where large areas are controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 rebel group, with insecurity increasing transmission risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus lineage, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, though vaccines are under development and testing. WHO has urged substantially intensified health measures on the ground to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が加速
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（約3600症例、1600死亡）が拡大し、複数州へ拡散、武装勢力による治安悪化が対応を困難にしており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境接触地域として言及されているが、感染事例発生国としての明記はなく、対象国リストにも南スーダン・ウガンダ・ルワンダは含まれないため除外。M23反政府勢力による治安悪化が対応の障害となっている点は特筆事項。承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行である点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak surges as cases top 3,200 and deaths hit 1,405
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached about 3,200 confirmed cases and 1,405 deaths by 25 July, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths reported by 31 July. The United Nations warns infections are doubling roughly every 20 days, making it one of the fastest-growing Ebola epidemics. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO and scientists are prioritizing evaluation of candidate vaccines and therapies, including monoclonal antibodies and remdesivir. The epicenter is Bunia in Ituri, where treatment beds are at or above capacity, and spread has reached North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids, placing caregivers at high risk. Challenges include insecurity, poor roads, funding gaps, and the need for more resources and specialized personnel; community engagement remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大、症例数3,200人超、死者1,405人に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、症例数・死者数ともに増加、ワクチン未承認かつ複数州に拡大しているためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: 感染倍加が約20日という異例の速さで進行しており、ブンディブギョ株には承認ワクチン・特異的治療法がないため、資源不足や治安問題も含め国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : Alerte Exceptionnelle de l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: WHO issues an extraordinary alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, 2026 (CFR ~44%), marking the largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded in the country. Declared on May 15, the Bundibugyo variant currently has no vaccine or targeted treatment. Initially limited to Mongbwalu in Ituri, transmission has rapid expanded to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. In the most recent complete week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported. Health workers account for 151 infections and 44 deaths. While national authorities, WHO, and partners are mounting a large-scale response, efforts are deemed insufficient amid insecurity, population mobility, and cross-border movement, raising fears of further spread. Uganda reports an end to its Ebola outbreak, but WHO warns the risk remains elevated in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行：WHOが異例の警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（3,605症例、致死率約44%）が5州に拡大し、WHOが異例警報を発令。国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息が報告されているため対象外。DRCでは治安不安、人口移動、越境移動により感染拡大の懸念が継続している。ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyo株による流行で、医療従事者にも多数の感染・死亡が発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra en RDC : 3 124 morts et seize provinces, quatre décomptes officiels qui ne concordent pas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in the DRC: 3,124 dead across sixteen provinces, four official tallies that do not match.
article.articleSummary: Four official cholera tallies in the DRC do not align. As of 31 July 2026, the WHO reports 106,401 cholera cases and 3,124 deaths since the start of the year, while the 30 June epidemiological update tallies 28,567 cases and 815 deaths to 31 May, a gap of 77,834 cases. Between the two documents, roughly 9,000 new cases per week are implied. The weekly government series generally runs about 1,000–1,600 suspected cases, suggesting 30–45k cases over 30 weeks, not 106k. The epidemic spans 16–21 provinces, with 56 health zones affected; Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu together account for about half of cases, Kinshasa is the epicenter with about 30% per bulletin, and Zongo (Sud-Ubangi) reported 270 suspected in a single week. Most counts are suspected; laboratories confirm only marginally. Data come from WHO, the Congolese WHO office, and MSF's cholera treatment unit in Pakadjuma.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ:16州で3,124人死亡、4つの公式集計が一致せず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で16〜21州に及ぶ大規模コレラ流行が発生し、死者3,124人・症例10万人超と報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と流行の広がりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC全土（Kinshasa、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu、Sud-Ubangi/Zongo等）にわたるコレラ流行を主題としている。Benin（Atakora県）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、無関係と判断し除外した。データソース間（WHO、コンゴ政府週報、MSF）の集計に大きな齟齬があり、実態把握に課題がある点も留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Nationwide Study Tracks Hepatitis B Reactivation and Liver Dysfunction
article.articleSummary: HBV reactivation and liver dysfunction were investigated in Chinese patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treated with infliximab, a TNF-α inhibitor. In a nationwide study across centers, patients with IBD undergoing infliximab were screened for hepatitis B before therapy and monitored with HBV DNA and liver-function tests during treatment. China’s intermediate HBV endemicity, with about 70 million chronic carriers, places many IBD patients at risk of HBV reactivation when immunosuppressed. Baseline serology distinguished active/chronic infection from prior exposure; concurrent immunosuppression and IBD activity were considered as risk modifiers. The investigation characterized HBV‑related liver injury, which can accompany viral replication and rise in liver enzymes, potentially progressing to jaundice or liver failure. Findings support universal HBV screening prior to biologic therapy and antiviral strategies: prophylaxis for HBsAg‑positive patients, and a case-by-case approach for resolved infection, guided by HBV DNA status and immunosuppression level. Emphasizes multidisciplinary HBV safety beyond gastroenterology.

triage.headline_ja: 全国調査：インフリキシマブ治療中のB型肝炎再活性化と肝機能障害を追跡
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生上の突発的アウトブレイクではなく、免疫抑制療法に伴うHBV再活性化に関する臨床研究報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はアウトブレイク events ではなく、既知の慢性HBVキャリアにおける治療関連の再活性化リスクを扱う臨床研究であるため、地域を特定のアウトブレイク発生国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية 3605 حالات مؤكدة لإيبولا من سلالة بونديبوجيو منها 1587 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases of the Bundibugyo strain, with 1,587 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the World Health Organization reports ongoing transmission of Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths. Initially confined to the Mongbwalu Health Zone in Ituri Province, the outbreak has expanded over the past two months to five provinces, including Ituri and the Kivu region, indicating sustained spread beyond initial hotspots. The report highlights rising case and death counts and expanding geographic reach, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance and public health response to the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ確定症例3,605件、うち死亡1,587件
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで5州に拡大し、致死率も高く症例・死亡数が増加しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 当初イトゥリ州モングバワル保健地域に限定されていたが、過去2か月でキブ地域を含む5州に拡大。致死率は約44%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO varoittaa: Ebolaepidemia Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa kiihtyy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating rapidly, urging substantial strengthening of health responses. The epidemic began in May and has become the country’s largest on record, with about 3,600 infections and roughly 1,600 deaths as of August 1, 2026. The epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu. Major towns and large areas are under the influence of the Rwanda-supported M23 rebel group, increasing transmission risk amid insecurity. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment, though vaccines are under development and being tested."}{

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が加速している
triage.triage_reason: WHOが警告するDRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（約3600人感染、1600人死亡）であり、武装勢力による治安不安が拡大リスクを高めている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
