article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo 'intensifying', says WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is intensifying at an 'exceptional' pace and is now the largest Ebola virus disease outbreak recorded in the country. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. As of July 30, WHO reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%). The outbreak center is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu, where areas are controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group. Insecurity, population displacement and cross-border movement complicate response and raise the risk of further spread. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes haemorrhagic fever; the disease has killed more than 15,000 across Africa in 50 years. Vaccines are in development: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) pursuing a Bundibugyo candidate, while Oxford University has begun a trial with a different Bundibugyo vaccine, first dose given last week.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が『激化』とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行で、致死率44%、複数州へ拡大し武装勢力による治安悪化も絡み国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 国境地域（南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）への波及リスクがあるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、M23武装勢力による治安悪化が対応を複雑化させている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 3605 حالة مؤكدة لإيبولا من سلالة بونديبوجيو و1587 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases from the Bundibugyo strain and 1,587 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Ebola Virus Disease, BVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to surge, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths ( CFR ~44%) reported by 30 July 2026. The outbreak started in the Mongabwal o health zone of Ituri Province and has expanded over the past two months to five provinces, affecting 49 health zones. Week 30 recorded the highest weekly cases and deaths to date, reflecting rapid transmission amid insecurity and population displacement that hamstring response efforts. DRC authorities, in collaboration with the World Health Organization, are scaling up control measures, surveillance, and outreach. Across the border, Uganda declared its Ebola outbreak over on 28 July after 42 days without new cases, but remains at risk of imported cases and reintroduction, necessitating continued vigilance and cross-border preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ確定症例3,605件、死者1,587人
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が5州49保健地区に拡大し、致死率約44%と深刻。治安不安と住民移動により対応が困難で、国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間新規症例なしでアウトブレイク終息宣言済みだが、DRCとの国境地帯での再導入リスクが残る。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola outbreak worsens in the Congo and is now biggest ever
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-01, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its largest Ebola outbreak to date. The outbreak has 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, with 651 survivors. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly totals on record. The Bundibugyo variant circulating has no approved vaccine, though a candidate is in trials. WHO urges substantial scaling up of the response, noting that better surveillance and more testing partly explain the rise, but outbreak expansion remains the main driver. Only about 80% of contacts are monitored for three weeks, far below the 95% target. Ongoing security challenges—rebellious conflicts, displaced populations, and distrust—complicate public health efforts and raise cross-border spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが悪化、過去最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、症例・死亡数が急増し、ワクチン未承認、国境を越える拡大リスクもあることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株に承認済みワクチンなし。接触者追跡率が目標(95%)を下回る80%であり、治安不安が対応を阻害。国境を越えた波及リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: नरकटियागंज में मिजल्स के दो मरीज मिले, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट, गांव में शुरू हुआ विशेष अभियान - narkatiaganj measles two positive cases health department alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two measles patients detected in Narkatiaganj; health department on alert; a special campaign launched in the village.
article.articleSummary: Measles detected in Gokhula village, Narkatiaganj block, West Champaran: two confirmed cases, a 13-year-old girl Divya Kumari and a 9-year-old boy Gulshan Kumar, with positive lab results after samples were sent to Patna. Following confirmation, health authorities activated surveillance, conducted a health survey of 204 children aged 9 months to 5 years, and distributed vitamin A. A special measles vaccination campaign has been launched to immunize eligible children; ANMs and other health workers instructed to report suspected cases promptly for testing and treatment. Medical teams are monitoring affected households to prevent spread. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via respiratory droplets; typical symptoms include high fever, dry cough, runny nose, red eyes, Koplik spots, and a spreading rash. Vaccination under the national program is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ナルカティアガンジで麻疹患者2名確認、保健当局が警戒、村で特別対策開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は感染力が強い疾患だが、確認例は2例のみで地域限定的、保健当局が迅速に対応（サーベイランス強化・ワクチン接種キャンペーン）しているため、現時点で国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 西チャンパラン県ナルカティアガンジ地区ゴクラ村での局所的な麻疹症例（2例）。インドでは麻疹は依然として流行性疾患であり、地方レベルでの対応（204名の児童調査、ビタミンA投与、ワクチンキャンペーン）が既に開始されている。続報があれば感染拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: U ženy po návratu z Ugandy hrozí nebezpečná nákaza. U kliniky zasahovali hasiči
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dangerous infection threatens a woman after returning from Uganda. Firefighters intervened at the clinic.
article.articleSummary: In the Hradec Králové Region, firefighters and police cordoned a danger zone around the Infectious Diseases Clinic after a woman returning from Uganda was suspected of carrying a highly contagious infection. She was decontaminated on site, transported in a biobox and on a transport stretcher, and moved to a specialized facility at Prague’s Bulovka University Hospital; the ambulance arrived shortly after 15:00. Public risk was described as very low; hospital operations were not restricted, and the Ministry of Health noted that laboratory confirmation could take days. The case underscores concerns about diseases such as Ebola, Marburg, dengue, and other hemorrhagic fevers. Uganda recently ended its Ebola epidemic after 42 days from the last case (20 infections, 2 deaths); Congo has over 3,500 cases and about 1,556 deaths. Earlier this year, an American doctor at Bulovka with suspected Ebola was quarantined but did not fall ill.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダから帰国した女性に危険な感染症の疑い。診療所で消防隊が出動
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ帰国者にエボラ・マールブルグ等の出血熱感染が疑われ、消防・警察が隔離対応するなど異常性と社会的関心が高く、確定診断待ちのためフルRRAでの経過確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチェコ（ウガンダ帰国者）での疑い症例であり、対象国リストの国（DRC含む）は背景情報として言及されているのみで主題ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。ラボ確定結果待ちの段階であり、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La Organización Mundial de la Salud advierte que la situación del brote de ébola en el Congo está empeorando
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is worsening.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus is worsening, with sustained transmission and a continued rise in cases and deaths. Over the past two months the outbreak has spread to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—and now affects 49 health zones. As of 30 July 2026, total laboratory-confirmed cases reached 3,605 with 1,587 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 44%. In the most recent full reporting week (week 30), 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded, the highest weekly totals to date. Ongoing rapid spread and cross-border movement complicate control, particularly near Uganda, whose outbreak ended on 28 July after 42 days without a new confirmed case. WHO calls for reinforced surveillance, preparedness, and control measures to address persistent transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が悪化していると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)の流行が5州49保健地区に拡大し、致死率約44%、週間症例・死亡数が過去最高を記録するなど深刻化しており、国境を越えた拡大リスクもあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は7月28日に終息(42日間新規症例なし)と報告されており、現在の主要な懸念地域はコンゴ民主共和国。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 3605 حالات مؤكدة لإيبولا من سلالة بونديبوجيو منها 1587 وفاة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases of the Bundibugyo strain, including 1,587 deaths - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: WHO reports an expanding outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (EVD-BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of 30 July 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported, a case fatality rate of about 44%, making it the largest Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC. The epidemic has spread from initial Mambwango in Ituri to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chobo—affecting 49 health zones. The 30th epidemiological week saw a record weekly total of 567 cases and 296 deaths, underscoring rapid transmission. Insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement complicate response and raise geographic spread risk. DRC authorities, with WHO and partners, are implementing wide-ranging control measures but emphasize the need to scale up activity. In Uganda, the outbreak there was declared over on 28 July after 42 days without a locally acquired case; the last imported case was discharged on 16 July after two negative tests. WHO will monitor 42 days from that date to prevent undetected transmission, noting ongoing cross-border risk from neighboring DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:ブンディブジョ株エボラ確定症例3,605件、うち死亡1,587件
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行(致死率約44%)が5州49保健区に拡大し、直近週で症例が急増しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明白であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでは42日間新規症例なしで終息宣言されたが、DRCとの国境を越えた移動により継続的なリスクがあるとWHOが監視中。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola enregistre son pic hebdomadaire le plus élevé, l'OMS souligne un rythme de transmission "exceptionnel"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola records its highest weekly peak, WHO notes an 'exceptional' transmission rate.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (MVB), a form of Ebola, is surging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), now the country’s largest Ebola outbreak. By 30 July 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported in the DRC, including two cases diagnosed in-country and treated in Germany. The outbreak has expanded from Mongbwalu in Ituri to five provinces—Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo—across 49 health zones. Ituri accounts for 88% of cases and 82.6% of deaths (3,176 cases; 1,311 deaths). The most affected zones are Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Lita and Nyankunde. Active transmission persists in 33 of 49 zones (641 cases, 282 deaths in the last seven days). Wanie-Rukula (Tshopo) awaits data harmonization. Healthcare workers: 151 cases, 44 deaths (29% CFR), 68 recoveries. Globally, 3,626 confirmed cases (DRC 3,605; Uganda 20; France 1) and 1,589 deaths; Uganda concluded its outbreak on 28 July, but cross-border risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラが週間最高ピークを記録、WHOは『例外的な』感染速度を指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)流行が進行中で、致死率が高く5州49保健地区に拡大、国際的な症例輸出(ドイツ・フランス・ウガンダ)も発生しているため。
triage.notes: WHOが『例外的な』感染速度と評価。ウガンダの流行は7月28日に終息宣言されたが越境リスクは残る。ドイツ・フランスへの症例輸出は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية وتسجيل آلاف الإصابات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with thousands of infections recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak reported by the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health in multiple eastern provinces amid long-running armed conflict. Epidemiological surveillance confirmed virus spread across several eastern districts. Infections exceeded 3,500 in the past two months, a figure surpassing the total cases recorded from 2018–2020. Health teams are conducting intensive vaccination campaigns and strengthening outbreak investigations to contain clusters and curb transmission among communities. Ebola is among the deadliest viral diseases, having caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades, underscoring the ongoing public health threat on the continent.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が流行、数千人の感染を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(2ヶ月で3500人超、2018-2020年の総数を上回る)が武力紛争地域で発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 武力紛争下でのアウトブレイクであり、ワクチン接種活動を強化中。感染者数が過去のエピソード(2018-2020)を上回っており、深刻度が高い。致死率や死亡者数の詳細情報は本文になく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Morcego encontrado no Pioneiros é 12º caso confirmado para raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bat found in Pioneiros is the 12th confirmed rabies case.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Center for Zoonosis Control (CCZ) confirms the 12th rabies-positive bat case in Campo Grande, Brazil, with the infected animal found in the Pioneiros neighborhood. Since the start of 2026, 772 bats have been collected; 12 confirmed rabies cases indicate ongoing local exposure. Neighborhoods with confirmed cases include Centro (3), Vivendas do Bosque, Santa Fé, Jardim Campo Alto, Pioneiros (2), São Francisco, Jardim Bela Vista, Jardim Ouro Preto, and Vila Nasser. Public guidance emphasizes not touching any bat (dead or alive), isolating it, and contacting CCZ for safe collection and laboratory testing; households should keep pets vaccinated annually. Contact channels: Central (67) 3313-5000; hotlines (67) 2020-1789/1801; after-hours (67) 2020-1794. Physical service location: Av. Filinto Müller, 1601, Vila Ipiranga.

triage.headline_ja: パイオネイロス地区で発見されたコウモリが12例目の狂犬病確定例に
triage.triage_reason: 動物(コウモリ)における狂犬病の局地的サーベイランス結果であり、ヒトへの感染事例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本イベントはコウモリの狂犬病監視報告であり、対象国リスト評価の対象は主にヒト感染症事象を想定。地域自治体(CCZ)による通常の動物サーベイランス活動の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo nicht unter Kontrolle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo is not under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is not under control as of 2026-08-01, with the risk of spread to neighboring countries rising. The WHO reports 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, with 651 recoveries. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were recorded, the highest weekly totals to date. The outbreak is the largest the country has experienced, surpassing the 2018–2020 crisis, which had 3,317 confirmed cases. The WHO calls for a substantial expansion of control measures to bring the outbreak under control amid escalating regional public health threats.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ発生、制御下に至らず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率が高く、周辺国への拡大リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOは対策の大幅な拡大を求めており、2018-2020年の流行を上回る過去最大規模の流行として深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о стремительном распространении вспышки лихорадки Эбола в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports rapid spread of an Ebola fever outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, according to the World Health Organization. As of end-July 2026, the DRC reported 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (44% case fatality), the largest outbreak on record in the country. The epidemic is advancing in regions with unstable governance and severely inadequate health infrastructure. WHO warns transmission is intensifying with a sustained rise in both cases and fatalities. In the latest reporting week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were registered, signaling an exceptionally fast transmission pace. Healthcare workers have been repeatedly affected, with 151 infections and 44 deaths among medical personnel. WHO called for substantial strengthening of response measures to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの急速な拡大を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が急速に拡大し致死率44%と極めて深刻であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHOが過去最大規模と明言し、医療従事者への感染・死亡も多数発生。ガバナンス不安定・医療体制脆弱な地域での拡大であり、国際的な支援強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra primeira morte por dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health records first dengue death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: First dengue death in Mato Grosso do Sul in 2026: an 11-year-old boy from Bonito developed symptoms on June 20 and died eight days later; cause confirmed by the State Health Secretariat in the latest epidemiological bulletin. Two suspected dengue deaths are under investigation. The state reports 4,760 probable dengue cases this year, with 1,828 laboratory confirmations. Vaccination coverage remains low at 44.34% of the target, far from the 90% national goal; Novo Horizonte do Sul, Rio Negro, Angélica, and Figueirão reached or surpassed the target, while Campo Grande stands at 26.14%. Chikungunya cases rise to 12,735 probable, with 9,729 laboratory confirmations. Since January, chikungunya has caused 28 deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul, in Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã and Nioaque.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、2026年初のデング熱死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルにおける季節性の風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡例（デング熱1例確認、チクングニア熱28例）と低いワクチン接種率が続報監視の対象となる。
triage.notes: 州保健局が疫学速報を発行しており行政の関心はあるが、国際的な注目度は低い。デング熱ワクチン接種率が目標(90%)を大きく下回る44.34%である点、チクングニア熱による死亡が28件に上る点は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : dans le Bas-Uélé, où aucun cas n'est recensé, l'INSP déploie des équipes dans trois zones de santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in Bas-Uele, where no case has been reported, the INSP deploys teams in three health zones.
article.articleSummary: Bas-Uélé, Democratic Republic of Congo, reports zero confirmed Ebola cases as of July 30, 2026, but three health zones—Vianda, Poko and Ganga—are receiving national- and WHO-supported preparedness teams to strengthen surveillance, risk communication, infection prevention and control, and field coordination against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. An OMS-INSP-COUSP logistics mission to Buta delivers preventive and treatment supplies to health facilities to boost readiness. Haut-Uélé, adjacent to Bas-Uélé, has 53 confirmed cases and 28 deaths (case fatality 52.8%) across five zones, with six new cases reported on July 30 (4 in Boma Mangbetu, 2 in Isiro, including a re-test). COUSP urges sustaining epicenter interventions while preparing neighboring provinces and activating 23 entry points to curb spread. The 17th outbreak began May 15, 2026 in Mongbwalu, Ituri; Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no vaccine or approved treatment; the first trial dose was given July 24 in Oxford. National totals: 3,605 confirmed cases, 1,587 deaths (44.0%) in 49 of 140 zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:症例ゼロのバス・ウエレ州で、国立公衆衛生研究所(INSP)が3つの保健地域に対応チームを展開
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）は全国で3,605例・1,587死亡（致死率44%）に達し、隣接州への拡大リスクとワクチン・治療薬未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国（バス・ウエレ州、オー・ウエレ州、イトゥリ州）での進行中のエボラ流行に関するもの。英国（オックスフォード）はワクチン臨床試験実施地であり発生地域ではないため除外。中央アフリカ共和国は隣接地として言及されているが確定症例の記載なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le Nord-Kivu affiché à 143,3 % d'occupation, sur une capacité en lits que le rapport dit non actualisée depuis quatre cycles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: North Kivu at 143.3% occupancy, based on a bed capacity that the report says has not been updated in four cycles.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows uneven isolation capacity as of July 30, 2026 (COUSP Situation Report No. 077; released Aug 1). Overall isolation occupancy is 71.3% (748/1,049 beds). Nord-Kivu holds 202 patients in isolation for 141 beds (143.3%), but capacity figures have not been updated for four cycles; 25 confirmed and 177 suspected among those in Nord-Kivu, with 5 confirmed and 48 suspected admitted that day and 67 non-cases discharged. Ituri, accounting for about 88% of cumulative cases, has 523/820 beds occupied (63.8%), with several treatment centers over capacity for confirmed cases (Nizi 322%, Lita 140%, ISTM 107%, Bunia 105%, CME and Fataki 100%). Tshopo at 5.0%; Haut-Uélé at 32.4%. Saturated transit centers for suspects in Ituri (Logo 125%, Kigonze 113%, HGR Kilo 100%). Frontline infections total 137 (41 deaths in Ituri; 11 infections and 3 deaths in Nord-Kivu). No vaccination activity reported; Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo targets Zaïre; July 24 phase 1 trial begun. Global totals: 3,605 confirmed, 1,587 deaths, 651 recoveries across 49 of 140 health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:北キブ州の病床占有率143.3%、4サイクル更新されていない病床数に基づく報告
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行（累計3,605例確定、1,587人死亡）で、複数地域の隔離施設が定員を大幅超過（一部300%超）し、ワクチン（Ervebo）がザイール株用でBundibugyo株には非対応という国際的懸念があるため。

article.articleHeadline: 中国第三批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组抵达刚果（金）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's third batch of Ebola outbreak-response medical experts arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 1 August 2026, the third batch of Ebola outbreak-response medical experts from China arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to reinforce Ebola prevention and control efforts. DRC's health ministry welcomed the team, noting the ongoing and challenging outbreak and continued pressure on surveillance, patient care, and laboratory testing. The arriving experts will build on prior batches to provide technical assistance in epidemiology, health quarantine, clinical treatment, and pathogen laboratory work, collaborating with the DRC health authorities and international partners to strengthen outbreak response and hasten the end of the crisis. The team leader is Yang Xiaocheng; members come from the National Health Commission, General Administration of Customs, Zhejiang University School of Medicine's First Affiliated Hospital, and the China CDC, among others, with practical field anti-epidemic experience.

triage.headline_ja: 中国第三次エボラ対応医療専門家チームがコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクに対し中国が第三陣の専門家チームを派遣していることから、DRCでの流行が依然深刻かつ国際支援を要する状況であることが示されており、フルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は中国からの支援派遣を報じるもので、DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクの継続と監視・患者ケア・検査体制への負荷が示唆されている。詳細な症例数・致死率等の疫学データは本記事には含まれず、続報での確認が必要。中国（Zhejiang含む）は派遣元であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

The update, cited by Interfax from Le Figaro, provides no specific case counts, fatalities, locations, laboratory confirmations, or transmission details in the excerpt. The warning underscores an urgent need for intensified international public health action to contain the epidemic in the DRC. The article does not specify whether cases are imported or exported, nor does it offer granular epidemiological data. This snapshot reflects ongoing concern from global health authorities about Ebola dynamics in the DRC as of 2026-08-01.

article.articleHeadline: केजीएमयू: बारिश में संचारी रोगों के नियंत्रण पर बढ़ते कदम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KGMU: Increasing steps to control communicable diseases during the monsoon.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, Lucknow, India: King George's Medical University (KGMU) Microbiology Department organized a monsoon-focused awareness program under a government communicable disease control drive, titled 'Monsoon Safety—Preventing Communicable Diseases is Our Priority.' The initiative highlights community participation as essential to preventing vector- and waterborne diseases during the monsoon. It notes Aedes mosquitoes—the dengue vectors—breed in clean, standing water, not dirty water, and urges weekly, ten-minute home inspections of water-collection sites (coolers, pots, buckets, overhead tanks, old tires) to eliminate standing water. Dr. Sheetal Verma stresses the critical 24-hour window after fever onset, advising against self-medication, encouraging hydration, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics. The approach emphasizes timely laboratory testing to differentiate dengue, malaria, typhoid, leptospirosis, and viral infections, enabling prompt, appropriate treatment and prevention of complications.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC data: COVID-19 test positivity rate surpasses 20%; infection rates in southern provinces are significantly higher than those in the north — Sing Tao Daily
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains the leading respiratory infection in China, with test positivity exceeding 20% for the first time in the week of July 20–26, 2026, per the China CDC’s National Acute Respiratory Diseases Sentinel Surveillance (Week 30). The rise marks a 4-percentage-point increase from the prior week. Positivity is markedly higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, with infections concentrated in children aged 0–4, adults 15–59, and seniors 60+. Influenza positivity stood at 14.5%, ranking second, up 2.1 points week over week. Officials assess this COVID-19 uptick as a cyclical fluctuation, with transmission intensity comparable to the previous two years. No new variants of significant public health concern have been identified, and the report does not indicate changes in disease severity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センターのデータ：新型コロナウイルス検査陽性率が20%を突破　南部の感染率は北部より顕著に高い―星島日報

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore fever during the monsoon season; the first 24 hours are crucial; KGMU has issued guidance on preventing communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 1, 2026, Lucknow's King George's Medical University (KGMU) Microbiology Department urged the public not to ignore fever during the monsoon and to seek medical evaluation within the first 24 hours. They stressed that Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean, stagnant water, not dirty water, and that spending about 10 minutes weekly checking and removing standing water around homes can substantially reduce dengue risk. Under Uttar Pradesh government's Special Communicable Disease Control and Dastak Campaign, the department organized a monsoon safety program, led by Prof. Vimla Venkatesh, emphasizing community participation. The event featured posters, demonstrations on ORS preparation, mosquito-control measures, and an interactive 'Myth vs Fact' session. Experts highlighted early identification, prudent antibiotic use, antimicrobial resistance, and timely diagnosis to differentiate dengue, malaria, typhoid, leptospirosis, and viral infections, enabling appropriate treatment and preventing complications.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo 'intensifying': WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is intensifying at an 'exceptional' pace, the WHO warned on Aug 1, 2026, the largest recorded Ebola virus disease outbreak in the country. Declared May 15, it is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. As of July 30, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths were reported, a case fatality rate of about 44%. The outbreak centers on the north-eastern Ituri province near South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu, areas partly controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 group. Insecurity, population displacement, mobility, and cross-border movement complicate response and raise risk of further spread. Vaccines are in development: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) described as most promising, and Oxford University is testing another candidate; a first volunteer received the first dose last week.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が『激化』：WHO
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44%で3,600例超・1,500人超の死亡を伴うDRコンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ紛争地域での対応困難という国際的拡大リスクが高い状況。
triage.notes: 南スーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが記事本文では国境近接の文脈のみで、実際の症例発生国としてはDRCのみが確認されている。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、M23紛争地域での対応が困難な点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: 3.532 κρούσματα και 1.556 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest globally by confirmed infections. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. The outbreak began less than three months ago and has been detected across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo. The case fatality rate among confirmed cases is 44.1% (1,556/3,532). Of identified patients, 807 remain in isolation or in hospital, and 626 have recovered. The World Health Organization warns the true scale could be up to four times higher due to surveillance gaps and access challenges; 80% of new Ituri cases have no known contact. Africa CDC estimates about $1.4 billion is needed to fund treatment centers, lab surveillance, safe burials, and community outreach, triple initial estimates.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱：3,532症例、1,556人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%、5州に拡大し3ヶ月未満で3,532症例・1,556死亡と急拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行のため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: WHOはサーベイランスの不備等により実際の症例数は報告の最大4倍に上る可能性があると警告。Africa CDCは対応に約14億ドルの資金が必要と推計。

article.articleHeadline: RDC se enfrenta ya al brote de ébola más grande de la historia del...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC is already facing the largest Ebola outbreak in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared in mid-May is the largest in the country’s history, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths. The outbreak is escalating, with a record weekly total of 567 cases and 296 deaths, driven by insecurity, displacement, population mobility, and cross-border movement. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine. It surpasses the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,317 cases). The WHO urges an immediate, substantial expansion of response activities. Transmission spans 49 health zones across five provinces, notably Ituri in the north, which accounts for 3,176 cases (88%) and 1,311 deaths (82.6%). Of the zones affected, 33 remain active with recent cases in the last seven days. Healthcare workers report 151 cases (44 deaths; 68 recoveries). Hunger is rising in the region, with nearly 10 million facing food insecurity; Ituri has 1.9 million in severe insecurity, and over 2.65 million in affected zones are acutely food insecure, including 628,000 in emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、同国史上最大のエボラ出血熱流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行（確定3,605例、死亡1,587例）が拡大中で、承認ワクチンがなく、越境移動によるさらなる拡大リスクとWHOによる対応拡大要請があるためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola se intensifica a 'ritmo excepcional' en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic intensifies at an 'exceptional pace' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies at an 'exceptional pace,' centered in Ituri province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda, which accounts for about 90% of cases. The virus is also present in four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, where territory is controlled by the M23 rebel group backed by Rwanda. As of 30 July, 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported across five provinces (44% case fatality). Declared May 15, this is the 17th outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo variant with no vaccine or treatment available yet. The week with the most detailed figures recorded 567 cases and 296 deaths. Healthcare workers are affected (151 infections, 44 deaths). Insecurity and cross-border movement hinder response; Uganda has declared the end of its outbreak, but risk persists. Vaccines: Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories’ candidate shows promise, and an Oxford University–developed vaccine is in early UK trials.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : la Dynamique Judith Suminwa Tuluka assainit le marché central - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: the Judith Suminwa Tuluka Dynamic sanitizes the central market - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 1 August 2026 in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Dynamique Judith Suminwa Tuluka (DYJUSTU/Tshopo) organized a sweeping, cleaning, and disinfection of the central market’s toilets to bolster hygiene and Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention at this high-traffic trading hub. The objective, stated by DYJUSTU/Tshopo coordinator François Maindi, was to curb Ebola transmission by sanitizing public spaces and raising awareness that cleanliness is a civic duty and a key preventive measure. Market managers welcomed the initiative, noting improved sanitary conditions for traders, buyers, and workers. The activity aligns with President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo’s broader sanitation agenda. DYJUSTU/Tshopo, market staff, and volunteers mobilized around a shared aim: maintain a healthy environment and support Ebola prevention efforts in Kisangani.

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola outbreak worsens in the Congo and is now biggest ever
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has escalated to the largest on record, with 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths; 651 people have survived. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly counts to date. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine exists, though a new vaccine trial is under way. The surge is attributed largely to expanded outbreak reach and better surveillance and testing, though only about 80% of contacts are being monitored for the full three weeks, short of the 95% target. Security challenges including rebel conflicts, large displacement, and distrust hinder response; many patients never reach treatment centers, and burial practices keep the virus highly infectious after death. Cross-border spread risk remains.

article.articleHeadline: O femeie a intrat în comă timp de 42 de zile, după ce a fost mușcată de o căpușă într-o vacanță din Grecia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman fell into a coma for 42 days after being bitten by a tick during a vacation in Greece.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) caused a 42-day coma in Victoria Stellas, a 51-year-old British woman born in Greece, after a bite on Syros during a 2019 visit. Initial flu-like symptoms progressed to nocturnal seizures; she was hospitalized and, after MRI, transported to Walton Centre in Liverpool where she was induced into a coma. She spent about six months in hospital; memory loss and seizures persist, leading to loss of employment and ongoing daily difficulties, requiring 15–18 daily medications. TBE is a viral encephalitis spread by ticks in Europe, Russia, and parts of China and Japan. Early symptoms mimic flu within a week of bite; severe cases may cause seizures, confusion, speech problems, or partial paralysis. NHS recommends vaccination for travelers to endemic areas at least one month before travel. About 3% of tick bites progress to brain infection; no antiviral treatment exists, care is supportive.

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго началась минимум в январе -- за четыре месяца до её официального объявления -- исследование
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo began as early as January—four months before its official announcement—according to a study.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo likely began by January 2026 near the mining town of Mongbvalu in Ituri province, per a Science study cited by Reuters. Based on interviews with 97 stakeholders (nurses, doctors, community leaders, recovered patients, relatives of the deceased, coffin makers, graveyard workers) and review of photos, WhatsApp messages, medical records, and funeral biographies, researchers identified over 500 suspected cases from mid-January to May 15, when the Africa CDC formally announced the outbreak. A transmission chain started with a 50-year-old woman (designated 'A'), who died January 25 after hematemesis; her mother died six days later; her husband survived. The outbreak has reached 3,532 cases nationwide, the second-largest in history; only West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (28,616) was larger. MSF epidemiologist Armand Sprecher notes early response focused on treatment centers, with underdeveloped contact tracing and safe burials, partly due to limited staff, while health facilities risk amplifying transmission when cases go undetected.

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo se intensifica, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with the WHO warning of exceptional transmission. In the latest week, 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded. The focus is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, accounting for about 90% of cases; the virus is also present in four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, where much territory is controlled by the M23 rebel group backed by Rwanda. The seventeenth outbreak, declared May 15, is due to the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. As of July 30, 2026, 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths across five provinces, CFR 44%. Health workers: 151 infections, 44 deaths. Insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement complicate response and raise spread risk. Uganda has declared the outbreak over, but risk persists. triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な伝播、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、CFR44%・ワクチン未整備の変異株による大規模流行でありWHOも警告していることからフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、北・南キブ州等5州）での流行拡大が主題。ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済みで対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。M23反乱軍による治安悪化と越境移動が拡大リスクを高めている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Inter/ Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie s'aggrave avec plus de 3.500 cas confirmés et 1.500 décès (Média)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Inter/ Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak worsens with more than 3,500 confirmed cases and 1,500 deaths (Media)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths as of 31 July 2026. Declared on 15 May, the epidemic now spans five eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. About 807 patients are currently isolated or receiving treatment, with 626 reported recoveries. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya calls the outbreak among the fastest-growing in recent memory and says it is not yet under control. In Ituri, the main hotspot, more than 80% of new cases are not linked to identified contacts, complicating tracing and containment. Most deaths occur in communities rather than treatment centers, signaling ongoing challenges in early detection and patient management. Health authorities continue response operations to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワール-AIP/インター/ RDCにおけるエボラ出血熱:感染者3,500人以上、死者1,500人以上に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大しており（3,532症例、1,556死亡）、Africa CDCも制御下にないと発言。国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 5つの東部州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、チョポ）にまたがる大規模流行。イトゥリでは新規症例の80%以上が接触者追跡不能で封じ込めが困難。Africa CDCが制御不能と警告しており、フルRRAへの移行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: ci risiamo: in cina c'è una nuova ondata di covid - a giugno sono stati registrati quasi ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Here we go again: in China there is a new wave of COVID-19 — in June almost ....
article.articleSummary: Mainland China recorded about 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases in June 2026, including 130 severe cases and one death in a patient with preexisting conditions, per China CDC. In the 13–19 July 2026 week, 16.3% of respiratory samples from ambulatory patients with influenza‑like illness tested positive for SARS‑CoV‑2, surpassing influenza (12.6%) as the leading respiratory pathogen; enteroviruses reached 6.8%. The prevailing lineage is NB.1.8.1, an Omicron‑related variant, classified by WHO as under monitoring since May 2025. Most infections are mild, with overall levels lower than the prior peak. Authorities warn against assuming heat halts transmission; COVID-19 lacks simple seasonality and can rise in both winter and summer with new variants, population immunity, and behaviors. Italian health authorities urge vigilance: reduce contacts, ventilate interiors, and consider masking in crowded indoor settings if fever, cough, or sore throat appear.

triage.headline_ja: またか:中国で新たなCOVID-19の波 ― 6月にはほぼ8万人の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 中国で季節性のCOVID-19流行が継続しているが、変異株NB.1.8.1は既知のオミクロン系統でWHOの監視下にあり、重症化率・死亡率も低く新規性は乏しい。ただし呼吸器病原体としての優位性や継続的な感染拡大があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID波であり、既知の変異株NB.1.8.1(オミクロン系統)によるもの。重症例・死亡は少数。イタリア国内向けの一般的な注意喚起記事であり、国際的な緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذّر: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو خرج عن سيطرتنا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola outbreak in Congo has gotten out of our control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, central Africa, is out of control as of 2026-08-01. The outbreak is the largest in the country’s history. In the past week, 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly total since the outbreak began. Laboratory-confirmed cases total 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The previous record was the 2018–2020 outbreak with 3,317 confirmed cases. The World Health Organization notes a complex security situation; the rising numbers reflect improved surveillance and expanded laboratory testing.

triage.headline_ja: 「WHO警告：コンゴのエボラ流行は制御不能に」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行で、死亡者数・症例数が急増し制御不能とWHOが表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模の流行、致死率約44%（1587/3605）と高く、治安状況の複雑さが対応を困難にしている。国際的な支援・介入が急務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго се разраства и е по-мащабна от всякога
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading and is larger in scale than ever before.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest on record, with spread across Central Africa heightening cross-border risk. In the past week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported. WHO records total laboratory-confirmed cases at 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved vaccine exists; a new vaccine is in clinical trials. While improved epidemiological surveillance and increased laboratory testing contribute to higher detected numbers, health authorities say the outbreak is expanding. Contact tracing covers up to 80% of contacts over three weeks; 95% is the target. Ongoing security challenges—clashes between insurgent groups, large displacements, and deep public distrust—complicate response and raise the risk of spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が拡大、過去最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率が高く、承認済みワクチンがない変異株が原因であり、国境を越えた拡大リスクとセキュリティ上の対応困難も伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンがないBundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による流行で、致死率約44%（1,587/3,605）と高い。武装勢力の衝突や住民の大規模避難、対応への不信感が拡大リスクを高めている。周辺国への越境リスクが明記されているが、具体的な渡航・貿易制限措置については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tödliches Virus: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo verschärft sich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus: Ebola outbreak in the Congo intensifies.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows 3,605 confirmed infections and 1,587 deaths across five provinces, according to the World Health Organization in Geneva. The Bundibugyo variant is responsible for this outbreak, described as the largest Ebola outbreak in the country's history. Ongoing conflict-related security challenges, displacement, and cross-border movements complicate countermeasures and raise the risk of regional spread. Uganda, a neighbor, declared its outbreak over after 42 days with no new locally acquired cases. There is no licensed vaccine yet; a vaccine is still in development, so containment relies on isolating patients and interrupting transmission chains. Ebola virus disease transmits via direct contact with body fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever. In Africa over the past five decades, more than 15,000 people have died from the disease.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルス：コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、致死率が高く、国境を越えた拡大リスクや紛争による対応困難が確認されているためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息が宣言されたため対象国リストに含まれず除外。ワクチンが未承認である点、紛争による対応困難が拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democràtica del Congo ja pateix el brot d'Ebola més greu de la seva història
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is already experiencing the worst Ebola outbreak in its history.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared in mid-May, is the worst on record. WHO reports 1,587 deaths and 3,605 cases. This week: 567 cases and 296 deaths—the highest weekly totals since the outbreak began. The virus is Bundibugyo lineage, for which no vaccine is approved. It has spread across 49 health zones in five provinces, with 33 zones still transmitting. Ituri province accounts for 88% of cases (3,176) and 82.6% of deaths (1,311). Health workers account for 151 infections, 44 deaths and 68 recoveries. The WHO calls for an immediate, substantial emergency response. The UN warns nearly 10 million people face hunger in the north and east, including 1.9 million in Ituri; over 2.65 million in affected zones have acute food insecurity, more than 628,000 in emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最悪のエボラ出血熱の流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模の致死的アウトブレイク（症例3,605・死亡1,587）でワクチン未承認株が5州49保健区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統でワクチン未承認、食料不安（栄養失調による免疫低下等）も懸念材料として言及されている。WHOが緊急かつ大規模な対応を要請している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din RD Congo se intensifică într-un ritm "excepţional", avertizează OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo is intensifying at an 'exceptional' pace, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak intensifies at an 'exceptional' pace, WHO warns, urging a strengthened response. This outbreak—the largest Ebola epidemic reported in the DRC—is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain) with no vaccine or treatment available yet. As of 30 July, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%) across five provinces: Ituri (including Mongbwalu), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; previously limited to Mongbwalu in Ituri. The latest week recorded a record 567 cases and 296 deaths, signaling ongoing rapid transmission. Healthcare workers comprise 151 infections, 44 deaths. Cross-border movement and insecurity complicate response efforts. Uganda has declared Ebola over, but re-emergence risk remains. Promising vaccine development: Hilleman Laboratories (headquartered in Singapore) will develop an Ebola vaccine; Oxford University’s Bundibugyo vaccine (using the same tech as AZ COVID-19) has begun human dosing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が「異例」の速さで拡大、WHOが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が急拡大しており、致死率約44%、医療従事者感染や国境を越えた移動も報告されるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Izbruh ebole v Kongu se širi in je zdaj največji doslej

It is now the largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s history. Despite weeks of containment efforts, transmission continues to escalate, signaling significant challenges for public health authorities and international partners. The statement underscores the severity of the situation, though the article does not provide current case counts or fatalities. The focus remains on the outbreak's expansion and its status as the largest Ebola event to date in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大、過去最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が制御不能で拡大中と発表しており、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: スイス（ジュネーブ）はWHO本部の所在地であり発生地域ではないため除外。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Cina, picco di casi Covid: primo posto tra infezioni respiratorie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China, peak of COVID-19 cases: first among respiratory infections.
article.articleSummary: July 2026 in China marks a resurgence of COVID-19 as the leading respiratory syndrome. The weekly SARS-CoV-2 positivity among symptomatic patients rose from 16.3% (July 13–19) to 20.3% (week of July 20), with higher rates in southern provinces. The most affected age group is 15–59 years. The Chinese CDC reports most patients have mild symptoms and viral activity at moderate levels after the uptick. The circulating lineage is NB.1.8.1. COVID-19 is described as a common respiratory disease with one or two annual waves. The current rise is viewed as a normal fluctuation; elderly and chronically ill remain at higher risk for severe disease, though targeted therapies are available. No variants posing significant public health risk have been detected, and healthcare services have not been overwhelmed. Virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco warns this shows SARS-CoV-2 remains globally circulating, warranting vigilance rather than alarm.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でCOVID-19感染がピーク、呼吸器感染症の中で首位に
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な変動として説明されており、症状は軽症が大半で医療逼迫もなく、新規の懸念すべき変異株も検出されていないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 中国CDCは大半が軽症で医療体制も逼迫していないと報告。ウイルス学者は警戒は呼びかけるものの、通常の季節的変動と見ている。新規変異株NB.1.8.1は公衆衛生上の重大リスクとはされていない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 1521 حالة وتحذيرات أممية من خطر الامتداد الإقليمي | أهل مصر

article.articleSummary: 1,521 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of August 1, 2026, with continued transmission in affected regions. The report emphasizes immediate international intervention to bolster outbreak response, funding, and logistics to prevent cross-border spread and stabilize regional health security.

article.articleHeadline: CG News: एक्शन में कलेक्टर: मलेरिया की रोकथाम के लिए जिला स्तरीय अफसरों को उतारा फील्ड में, खुद कर रहे मॉनिटरिंग | CG News: Collector in action district-level officials deployed to the field for malaria prevention; personally monitoring the situation.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CG News: Collector in Action: District-level officials deployed to the field for malaria prevention; personally monitoring the situation.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak in villages of the Lorami development block in Mungeli district, Chhattisgarh, near the Achnakmar Tiger Reserve (ATR) area, has triggered a district-wide control and treatment drive led by District Collector Kundan Kumar. Administrative and health teams are inspecting Tilaiidbara, Bahoud, Sarasdol, Jamunahi, Atiyakhhar and Rajk villages, ensuring timely treatment and strengthened surveillance. Several patients are being treated in health centers; ongoing monitoring aims to prevent further spread. The health department has launched house-to-house fever screening with health workers and mitanin workers. Rapid Diagnostic (RD) kits and malaria drugs are stocked and distributed to frontline workers for on-the-spot testing and treatment. The Collector directed field presence of all district officials to ensure service availability and rapid assistance. Public guidance emphasizes long sleeves, bed nets, sanitation, boiled water. A control room for other seasonal illnesses is in place to ensure continuous monitoring and quick response.

triage.headline_ja: CGニュース：コレクター陣頭指揮 マラリア対策のため郡レベルの職員を現場に配置、自ら監視

article.articleHeadline: El Congo se enfrenta ya al brote de ébola más grande de la historia del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo is now facing the largest Ebola outbreak in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its largest Ebola outbreak on record, declared mid-May and driven by the Bundibugyo strain (no vaccine approved). triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン未承認)が5州49保健地区に拡大し3,605例・1,587死亡を記録、医療従事者感染や治安不安・住民移動により国際拡大リスクも高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو خارج عن السيطرة

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza en el Congo y alarma a países vecinos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in Congo and alarms neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: On 30 July 2026, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 3,605 confirmed infections and 1,587 deaths (case fatality 44%), with 567 new cases and 296 deaths in the past week. The northeast Ituri province, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, is the epicenter, housing about 90% of cases; outbreaks also in North and South Kivu, where the armed group M23 hampered access. Health workers infected: 151 infections and 44 deaths. This is Congo's seventeenth Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccines or commercial treatments exist yet. Per WHO, insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement raise regional spread risk; neighboring Uganda has declared the outbreak over within its borders as of Tuesday, but regional risk remains high. Trials: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) developing an immunogen candidate; University of Oxford initiating human trials of another vaccine in the UK.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が拡大し、隣国に警戒感

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : flambée sans précédent en RDC avec plus de 3.500 cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Unprecedented outbreak in the DRC with more than 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates in the eastern provinces. Since official declaration on May 15, 2026, 3,532 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported across five provinces, with 1,556 deaths, in about two and a half months. The current epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment, and it concentrates in Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, which accounts for roughly 90% of cases per WHO. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever, is transmitted via contact with bodily fluids and is fueled by funeral rites and fragile health infrastructures. Humanitarian workers are attempting safe burials amid strong public mistrust, while authorities struggle to contain the outbreak in a region plagued by ongoing conflict and armed groups.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない大流行、感染者3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし)が5州で3,532例・1,556人死亡と急拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による前例のない規模の流行。南スーダン・ウガンダ国境地帯(イツリ州)で90%の症例が集中し、紛争地域での対応困難、越境拡大リスクが高い。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 infections rise in China but remain moderate; no new pathogens detected: China CDC
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections rise in China but remain moderate; weekly respiratory sampling in sentinel hospitals shows COVID-19 at 20.3% positivity among influenza-like illness cases, up 4 percentage points week-on-week, with NB.1.8.1 as the predominant lineage. Southern provinces report higher positivity than northern regions; age 15–59 has the highest rate. Influenza activity remains low, dominated by influenza B (Victoria) and influenza A(H3N2) with roughly equal shares; higher positives observed in patients aged 4 and older. Since COVID-19 is under Class B management, epidemics occur in waves annually; current rise is a periodic fluctuation with intensity similar to past two years. China CDC surveillance shows only known pathogens; no unknown or new pathogens detected.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でCOVID-19感染者が増加も程度は中等度、新規病原体は検出されず：中国疾病予防管理センター
triage.triage_reason: 既知の病原体による季節的な変動であり、中国CDCも新規病原体なしと明言しているため、異常性・重大性ともに低い。
triage.notes: 中国CDCは今回の増加を過去2年と同程度の周期的変動と説明しており、新規・未知病原体は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ предупредили о стремительном распространении Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spreading rapidly; WHO calls it the largest on record in the country. It began on 15 May due to a new Bundibugyo strain; there is no certified vaccine yet. As of 30 July, 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported, yielding a case-fatality rate exceeding 40%. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, adjoining South Sudan and Uganda, raising cross-border transmission concerns and underscoring regional coordination needs. WHO warns that transmission is intensifying, with sustained spread and a continued rise in cases and deaths. The most promising vaccine candidate is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories, a Singaporean company, as response measures are expanded to strengthen health systems and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率40%超・症例数3,600人超という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国境を越えた拡大懸念（南スーダン・ウガンダ隣接）とWHOによる公式警告があるためIHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Sudan、Singaporeが含まれるが、記事本文では越境拡大の懸念やワクチン開発企業の言及に留まり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。UgandaとSudanは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Singaporeも実際の発生国ではなくワクチン開発企業の所在地であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в Конго се разраства и е по-мащабна от всякога
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is expanding and larger in scale than ever before.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the largest the country has faced, with expanding transmission and rising cross-border risk in Central Africa as of 1 August 2026. In the past week, WHO reports 567 new cases and 296 deaths, pushing lab-confirmed cases to 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine yet, though a new vaccine is in clinical trials. Apparent case counts reflect improved surveillance and testing, but authorities warn the outbreak is widening. Contact tracing reaches about 80% of contacts over three weeks; target is 95%. Security challenges, including clashes between insurgent groups, hundreds of thousands displaced, and deep public distrust, complicate containment. Cross-border spread remains a key concern, underscoring the need for larger proactive public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大し、過去最大規模に達している
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大しており、致死率が高く越境拡大リスクもあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチンがなく、治安不安（武装勢力衝突、住民避難、不信感）が対応を阻害している。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる過去最大級の流行で、越境拡大への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DBD Jadi Ancaman Anak Sepanjang Tahun, Dokter Ingatkan Orangtua Tak Lengah Saat Tahun Ajaran Baru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Becomes a Year-Round Threat to Children, Doctors Warn Parents Not to Let Their Guard Down at the Start of the New School Year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Indonesia is a year-round threat to children, with mortality data showing the highest deaths among ages 5–14; in 2025, 59% of dengue fatalities occurred in 0–14-year-olds, while those aged 15–44 accounted for the largest share of cases (42%). Dengue is not seasonal; Aedes aegypti bites mainly in morning and late afternoon, so transmission persists year-round, including during dry seasons when standing water is not cleared. The virus has four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); infection with one serotype does not protect against others and reinfection can raise the risk of severe dengue. Intra-household transmission is common; about 45% of household members become infected, with 75% asymptomatic. There is no specific cure; early detection and medical care reduce severity. Prevention requires comprehensive measures at home and school (3M Plus). Indonesia’s 2024 dengue burden was about Rp9 trillion, including Rp3.5 trillion direct costs and Rp1.8 trillion lost income.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱は子どもにとって一年中の脅威、新学年の始まりに親の油断禁物と医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで風土病化しているデング熱に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常な流行や急増を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の突発的アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、デング熱が通年の脅威であることを一般啓発する内容。既知の風土病であり新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز موجة 2018
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses the 2018 outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is raging in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak now surpassing the 2018–2020 wave. Authorities report 3,532 infections and 1,556 deaths across five provinces in about two and a half months since the May 15 start. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. The epicenter is Ituri province on the northeast border with South Sudan and Uganda, accounting for roughly 90% of cases; ongoing conflict and violence by armed groups hinder response. Four other eastern provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, are affected, with M23 forces controlling capitals and large areas with backing from Rwanda. Uganda has declared an end to its outbreak, but WHO cautions ongoing cross-border risk. Vaccination efforts include Hilleman Laboratories’ Singapore-based vaccine development and an Oxford University candidate using coronavirus vaccine technology, which began with a first-dose administration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、2018年の流行を上回る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模（感染3,532人、死亡1,556人）で拡大し、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争地域での対応困難と越境リスクが指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSouth Sudan, Rwanda, Uganda, Singaporeが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo verschärft sich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo intensifies.
article.articleSummary: An intensified Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) represents the largest on record for the country. The Bundibugyo variant, for which no licensed vaccine exists, is driving the crisis, with the WHO reporting 3,605 lab-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, and 651 survivors as of August 1, 2026. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were counted, reflecting expanding transmission despite weeks of response efforts. The outbreak risk to neighboring countries has grown. Ebola is zoonotic, with animal-to-human transmission from wildlife such as bats. Security constraints, rebel activity, mass displacement, and public mistrust hinder case finding and treatment; only up to about 80% of contacts are observed for three weeks, though 95% is the target. Burial practices remain hazardous. Early tracing suggests the outbreak may have started as far back as January, with Mongbwalu as an initial epicenter; a novel vaccine trial is underway.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大しており、認可ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株による高い致死率、近隣国への拡大リスク、治安・社会的要因による対応の困難さが確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模の流行とされ、致死率も高く、近隣国への拡大リスクが指摘されている。ワクチン治験が進行中だが、治安不安・住民移動・埋葬慣習が対応を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC se enfrenta ya al brote de ébola más grande de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC is already facing the largest Ebola outbreak in its history.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: The Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of 1 August 2026, with 567 new cases and 296 deaths reported this week. The Bundibugyo strain drives the largest RDC outbreak since declaration in mid-May, and there is no approved vaccine. Ituri province in the north accounts for 3,176 cases (88%) and 1,311 deaths (82.6%), with transmission active in 33 of 49 health zones across five provinces. Healthcare workers total 151 infections (44 deaths, 68 recoveries). The outbreak is worsened by insecurity, displacement, and population mobility, including cross-border movement. The World Food Programme warns nearly 10 million people in the north and east face hunger; Ituri has 1.9 million in critical food insecurity, and over 2.65 million in affected zones face acute insecurity, 628,000 in emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに直面
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行(3,605例、死亡1,587例)で、承認済みワクチンなし、国境を越えた人の移動もあり国際拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(約44%)、医療従事者の感染も多数発生。治安不安・人口移動・食料不安が流行悪化要因として指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Izbruh ebole v Kongu se širi in je zdaj največji doslej
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is spreading and is now the largest to date.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the largest in the country’s history and is spreading to neighboring nations. WHO in Geneva reports 567 new infections and 296 deaths in the last week, with total laboratory-confirmed cases exceeding 3,600 and deaths over 1,580. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy; a novel vaccine is currently in trial. Experts warn that true case numbers are likely higher due to underreporting and limited access to care, and unsafe burial practices raise transmission risk. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever, transmitted by direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids. Strengthened control measures and humanitarian support are urgently needed to curb spread and protect families and communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大し、これまでで最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、近隣諸国へも拡大しつつあり、致死率も高く国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっているため。
triage.notes: WHOジュネーブは報告拠点であり発生地域ではないため除外。近隣国への拡大が言及されているが具体的な国名は記事中に明記されていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、埋葬慣行によるリスクも指摘されており、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus: DR Congo cases worsen, top 3,600, deaths 1,587
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of 30 July. Spread across five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo—within 49 health zones, originating in Mongbwalu, Ituri. In epidemiological week 30, 567 confirmed cases and 296 deaths were reported, signaling rapid expansion and sustained transmission. Response is hampered by insecurity and displacement; WHO and partners have intensified surveillance and contact tracing, but resources must scale up. Uganda declared its Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak over on 28 July after 42 days without a locally transmitted case; last locally transmitted patient discharged 16 June. Nigeria remains on alert for importation risk, with authorities urging surveillance, screening at entry points and rapid isolation. Bundibugyo virus disease currently has no licensed vaccine or approved targeted therapy, underscoring reliance on detection and strong public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：コンゴ民主共和国の症例悪化、3,600人超、死者1,587人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例3,605人・死者1,587人に達する大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが5州49保健区に拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬もなく国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの伝播歴、ナイジェリアが警戒中）もあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間の症例なしでアウトブレイク終息を宣言済み、ナイジェリアは輸入リスクへの警戒段階であり実際の発生国ではないため、対象国リストにも該当しないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率が高く(約44%)、insecurity/displacementにより対応が困難な状況が続いている点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情加劇　世衛：病例和死亡數續增
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies; WHO says cases and deaths continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies with rising cases and deaths. World Health Organization data as of July 30 show 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate around 44%. The outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by Bundibugyo virus strain and currently lacks approved vaccines or therapies. The epicenter is Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, with spread to several neighboring provinces. The 2018–2020 outbreak remains the country’s largest on record, with about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths. WHO warns transmission is expanding, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance, infection prevention, and community engagement to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ流行が悪化　WHO：症例数・死亡者数が増加続く
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44%の大規模エボラ流行が拡大中で、承認されたワクチン・治療薬が不在なため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが症例・死亡数の増加を公式警告しており、承認ワクチン・治療薬の不在から流行制御の困難さが示唆される。近隣州への拡大も報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" : تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية "خرج عن السيطرة"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has gotten out of control.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization says the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control and is the largest on record for the country, with rising cross-border transmission risk to neighbouring states. In the past week, 567 infections and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly tally since the outbreak began. Cumulatively, laboratory-confirmed cases total 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The earlier 2018–2020 outbreak recorded 3,317 confirmed cases. The surge reflects wider transmission, though improved surveillance and testing contribute to higher counts. Only about 80% of contacts are followed for three weeks; control requires about 95%. Security challenges, armed conflict, mass displacement, and deep public mistrust of health authorities hinder response efforts and complicate containment and potential cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:「コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は制御不能になった」
triage.triage_reason: WHOが制御不能と表明し、症例数・死亡者数が過去最大規模で越境拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: コンタクトトレーシングの追跡率が80%と目標の95%に届かず、武装紛争や住民の不信感が対応を阻害しているため、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola outbreak worsens in Congo and is now biggest ever
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest the country has ever experienced, driven by the Bundibugyo variant with no approved vaccine; a vaccine trial is underway. As of the latest weekly update, laboratory-confirmed cases total 3,605 and deaths 1,587, with 651 survivors. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly totals to date. The previous biggest outbreak (2018–2020) had 3,317 confirmed cases. The outbreak began in January or earlier and was only identified months later; Mongbwalu is cited as an early epicentre. Transmission is zoonotic (bats) and sustained human-to-human spread, raising cross-border spread risk to neighboring countries. Response is hampered by insecurity, few reach treatment centers, and only 80% of contacts are monitored; safe burials are being organized. WHO calls for substantial scaling up of response and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が悪化、過去最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が過去最大規模となり、承認ワクチンがなく、致死率・新規感染者数も増加傾向で国境を越えた拡大リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による流行で承認ワクチンなし。治安悪化により対応が困難、接触者追跡率も80%に留まる。WHOは対応・サーベイランスの大幅拡充を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Slabe novice, eden najsmrtonosnejših virusov ni pod nadzorom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bad news, one of the deadliest viruses is not under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains uncontrolled and now threatens neighboring countries, per WHO. In the past week, 567 infections and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly toll to date; lab-confirmed cases exceed 3,600 with more than 1,580 deaths. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment yet, though a newly developed vaccine is being tested. Experts suspect underreporting; many patients do not seek care, and burial practices can drive transmission, though humanitarian groups are enabling safe, dignified burials with protective gear. Ebola virus disease is a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever transmitted via contact with infected people or bodily fluids. The DR Congo's 2018–2020 outbreak previously marked the largest with 3,317 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 悪いニュース、最も致死率の高いウイルスの一つが制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱がWHOにより制御不能と報告され、致死率の高い感染症の急増（週間567感染・296死亡）と近隣国への拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認、過小報告の疑い、近隣国への拡大脅威が指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يخرج عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spirals out of control.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control and the largest ever seen there. As of 1 August 2026, lab-confirmed cases stand at 3,605 with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries; last week alone recorded 567 new infections and 296 deaths—the highest weekly total since the outbreak started. Only about 80% of contacts are being followed for three weeks, well short of the 95% target needed to curb transmission. Security challenges, ongoing clashes with armed groups, and hundreds of thousands displaced hinder surveillance, vaccination, and rapid response, while deep public mistrust complicates outreach. The DRC has experienced multiple outbreaks, including the 2018–2020 surge in North Kivu and Ituri (3,317 cases, >2,200 deaths). Vaccination campaigns previously aided control, but continued instability remains a major barrier, elevating cross-border spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「制御不能」「史上最大規模」と警告し、致死率の高い大規模流行（症例3,605、死者1,587）が継続中で、武装勢力による治安悪化と国境を越えた拡大リスクが指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行との報道であり、治安悪化・接触者追跡率不足（80%<95%目標）・国境を越える拡大リスクが強調されている。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo es ya el más grande de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo is already the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing the largest Ebola outbreak on record, declared mid-May, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Nearly 1,600 deaths and over 3,600 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported. The WHO warns the outbreak is intensifying, driven largely by population displacements amid insecurity. In the latest week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded. The outbreak spans 49 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri in the north accounting for 88% of confirmed cases (3,176) and 82.6% of deaths (1,311). Of the affected zones, 33 remain active with new cases reported in the last seven days. More than 2.65 million people face acute food insecurity, including over 628,000 in emergency, per WFP. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, and this outbreak exceeds the previous Congo outbreak (2018–2020) of 3,317 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は既に史上最大規模となっている
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者・症例数が急増しており、ワクチン未承認かつ人口移動により国際拡大リスクもあることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンが未承認であり、治安不安による人口移動が流行拡大を助長している点が重大。WFPによる食料不安の深刻化も社会的懸念材料。
