article.articleHeadline: Rekordméretű ebolajárvány tombol a Kongói Demokratikus Köztársaságban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record-breaking Ebola outbreak raging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the record Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The May 2026 start has produced 3,605 confirmed infections and 1,587 deaths (44% fatality). The northeast Ituri province is the epicenter, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread into North Kivu and South Kivu, including areas under M23 control. Uganda reports 20 infections and France one case; two DRC patients were treated in Germany. No licensed vaccine or targeted therapy exists for Bundibugyo; several candidates are in development, including a Singapore-developed vaccine and a UK-led trial. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids. The outbreak is intensified by conflict, displacement, and cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的規模のエボラ流行が猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44%・感染者3,605人という大規模流行で、国際的な症例輸出（ウガンダ、フランス、ドイツ）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（M23支配地域を含む）での流行拡大により対応が困難化。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、国際支援の必要性が高い。ウガンダ・フランス・ドイツへの症例輸出があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないか、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Une troisième équipe chinoise d'experts médicaux arrive en RDC pour appuyer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Third Chinese Team of Medical Experts Arrives in the DRC to Support the Ebola Response.
article.articleSummary: Third Chinese team of medical experts arrives in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to support the Ebola response. Luku Maleyo Marius, representative of the Congolese Ministry of Health, welcomed the team at the airport and said the Ebola situation in the DRC remains complex, with response operations under strong pressure. The arriving experts will provide substantial support in epidemiological surveillance, patient management, and laboratory analyses to bolster outbreak response. The DRC expressed readiness to deepen cooperation with China to jointly strengthen response capabilities. Yang Xiaochen, head of the third team, said it will build on the work of the first two teams, deliver technical assistance based on concrete needs, and enhance exchanges with Congolese health authorities and international partners. The experts aim to help end the current Ebola outbreak in the DRC as quickly as possible.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の医療専門家チーム、エボラ対応支援のため第3陣がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が続くDRCで対応が「強い圧力下」にあるとされ、中国から3度目の専門家派遣が行われるなど国際支援が継続的に必要とされており、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 中国は支援チームを派遣しているのみで、感染発生国はDRCのみと判断し、Chinaはverified_locationsから除外した。既存の継続中アウトブレイクの続報であり新規シグナルではないが、対応の逼迫度が示唆されるためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Admn reviews preparedness, lists steps to check dengue outbreak - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: District administration reviews dengue-outbreak preparedness under the National Dengue Control Programme, outlining steps to contain dengue and related chikungunya. Officials direct intensified surveillance in identified hotspots and expand preventive activities ahead of the peak dengue season to curb transmission. Civil Surgeon Dr Rashmi Vij underscored that preventing mosquito breeding remains the most effective control, urging departments to prevent water accumulation and strictly implement dengue-prevention guidelines. Public awareness campaigns on cleanliness, regular checks of water storage containers, and elimination of breeding sites in homes, offices, and public places were endorsed. District Epidemiologist Dr Harjot Kaur stressed inter-departmental coordination, while residents were urged to cooperate with the administration.

triage.headline_ja: 行政、デング熱アウトブレイク阻止に向けた準備状況を確認し対策を列挙
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に対する行政の通常の予防的準備活動を報じたものであり、異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・パンジャブ州アムリトサルにおける季節性デング熱・チクングニアの予防対策準備に関する行政報道であり、具体的な症例数や重症度データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, nel dossier mai rivelato la vera storia del virus in Italia | Libero Quotidiano.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID, in the never-revealed dossier, the true story of the virus in Italy | Libero Quotidiano.it
article.articleSummary: January 2020 marked the arrival of COVID-19 in Italy, but Libero Quotidiano’s ongoing dossier argues the country was ill-prepared. The series draws on documents and testimonies from the Parliament’s Covid commission. It cites a national pandemic plan last updated in 2006 and notes EU guidance to refresh it every three years, which Italy failed to do under ministers Beatrice Lorenzin (2013–2018) and Giulia Grillo (2018–2019) and later Roberto Speranza. Experts like Giuseppe Ippolito urged applying the plan’s method to a coronavirus threat. The report alleges masks were sent to China while Italian hospitals faced shortages, and a pre-lockdown meeting was not formally recorded. On January 13, ENAC signed a Memorandum with the People’s Republic of China to expand air links to 164 weekly flights (108 immediate). Paola De Micheli boasted of Europe’s highest China flight count. The series aims to illuminate responsibility and missed opportunities in the pandemic’s early phase.

triage.headline_ja: COVID、これまで明かされなかったドッシエに記されたイタリアにおけるウイルスの真実
triage.triage_reason: 2020年当時のイタリアの新型コロナ対応に関する政治的検証・歴史的報道記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントのシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年当時のパンデミック対応の不備を検証する調査報道であり、現在の感染症発生を示すものではない。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれず、中国への言及も航空便協定の文脈のみで疾病発生とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о крупнейшей вспышке Эболы в истории ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports the largest Ebola outbreak in the history of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of July 30, 2026, the DRC has 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,587 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 44%. In the most recent full reporting week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly totals of the outbreak—indicating ongoing rapid expansion. The outbreak, the 17th in DRC history, began on May 15 in eastern DRC and adjacent Uganda, and has affected three provinces within the DRC. WHO notes that transmission is spreading at an exceptionally fast pace and the outbreak continues to intensify.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国史上最大のエボラ流行を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率44%・急速な拡大を伴うDRC史上最大のエボラ流行であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事はDRC史上最大の流行（17回目のアウトブレイク）であり、致死率44%、直近週で567新規症例・296死亡と急速拡大している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde estadual intensifica ações para prevenir transmissão de arboviroses com a chegada do El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Department Intensifies Actions to Prevent Transmission of Arboviruses with the Arrival of El Niño
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state health authorities intensify arbovirus prevention (dengue, chikungunya, Zika) amid El Niño–driven risk. SES-RJ is boosting surveillance and vector-control with municipalities to curb transmission of Aedes aegypti–borne diseases. Climate forecasts from WMO and Inmet anticipate El Niño to be moderate–strong in the second half of 2026, creating favorable conditions for mosquito proliferation with higher temperatures (roughly 30–32°C) and rainfall; Aedes eggs endure dry spells. A Brazilian study links El Niño thresholds (temp >23.3°C and rainfall >153 mm) to increased dengue infestation. Prevention emphasizes winter readiness: weekly interior/yard checks, elimination of standing water, repellent use, long sleeves, screens, and bed nets, especially for children, the elderly, and pregnant women. By 23 July 2026, Rio had 6,382 probable dengue cases (476 hospitalizations; 4 deaths under investigation; 4 deaths confirmed) and 2,460 probable chikungunya cases (40 hospitalizations; no deaths). No confirmed Zika cases.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州保健局、エルニーニョ到来に伴いアルボウイルス感染症の伝播予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱は例年の風土病流行であり、本記事はエルニーニョに備えた予防的対策強化を報じる内容。死亡例や入院例はあるが規模として突出した異常事態とは言えず、社会的関心の高まりも明確ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロ州における季節性アルボウイルス（デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱）対策強化の記事。デング熱6,382例（入院476、死亡確認4）、チクングニア熱2,460例（入院40、死亡0）と具体的な数値報告あるが、ブラジルの風土病として例年発生する規模の範囲内と考えられる。エルニーニョによる今後の拡大予測が含まれるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சலைக் கட்டுப்படுத்த வேண்டும்: ஜி.கே. வாசன்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever must be controlled: G.K. Vasan.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, the central government warns that eight states including Tamil Nadu have detected circulation of four dengue virus serotypes (DENV 1–4). In light of this, the Tamil Nadu government is urged to issue official medical guidelines for dengue protection, intensify public awareness campaigns, and establish 24/7 fever treatment centers in all government hospitals. Authorities should implement upstream and downstream measures to curb transmission from rural to urban areas, with a focus on comprehensive vector-control and community outreach from villages to metropolitan centers. G. K. Vasan called for sustained, coordinated dengue outbreak prevention and management, underscoring the need for robust public health readiness across Tamil Nadu and neighboring states.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱を抑制すべき：G.K.ヴァサン氏
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナードゥ州を含む8州でデング4血清型の同時流行が報告されているが、具体的な患者数・死亡数等の重症度データがなく、政治家による対策要請の記事にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節性に発生する疾患であり、本記事は地方政治家による対策強化の呼びかけが主体。4血清型同時検出という点はやや注視すべきだが、重症度や患者数などの定量データが不足しているためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱感染3600人　コンゴ、過去最大の流行に　WHO「現状では封じ込め困難」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 3,600 people infected with Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the largest outbreak on record; WHO says containment is difficult at present.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 3,605 Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the country’s largest outbreak on record and surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. There have been 1,587 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 44%. In the most recent week, the outbreak recorded its highest weekly totals for both infections and deaths. The outbreak has spread across five provinces, with eastern-region conflict between government forces and armed groups hampering healthcare delivery and limiting contact tracing. No approved vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak; development is underway but practical timelines are unclear. WHO, in coordination with local authorities, is scaling up the response, but at the current pace containment is difficult.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱感染3600人　コンゴ、過去最大の流行に　WHO「現状では封じ込め困難」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（3,605例、致死率約44%）が発生し、WHOも封じ込め困難と表明。ワクチン未承認・紛争による対応阻害もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンが未承認である点、紛争地域での対応困難が拡大リスクを高めている。国際的な支援拡大の動向を要フォロー。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ признала вспышку Эболы в ДР Конго крупнейшей в истории страны
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recognizes the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo as the largest in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the largest ever recorded, according to WHO on 1 August 2026. As of 30 July 2026, there are 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%). In the latest reporting week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were registered, underscoring rapid spread and a deteriorating situation. Since 15 May, DR Congo has endured its 17th Ebola outbreak, affecting three provinces and crossing into neighboring Uganda. WHO warns the true case count may be double the officially confirmed figures. The outbreak's trajectory remains highly concerning, with ongoing transmission and a need for intensified surveillance and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を同国史上最大規模と認定
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最大規模と認定したエボラ流行であり、致死率44%・急速な拡大・ウガンダへの越境が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。実際の症例数は公式発表の倍に上る可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": تصاعد تفشي فيروس بونديبوغيو في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Escalating Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to escalate, with sustained transmission, expanding geographic reach, and rising deaths. By 30 July 2026, WHO notes 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 fatalities. The previous week recorded the highest weekly burden to date, with 567 cases and 296 deaths, signaling unprecedented velocity of spread. Insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement hinder response efforts and heighten transmission risk. National authorities, WHO, and partners are implementing broad countermeasures, but call for a substantial expansion of operations across multiple sectors to curb spread. Bundibugyo virus is one of the Ebola virus species, causing Bundibugyo virus disease, a viral hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョウイルス感染症の流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルス病流行が急速に拡大し、致死率・感染速度ともに深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすため、フルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 3,605例・死亡1,587例（致死率約44%）、直近週で567例・296死亡と過去最大の週間負荷を記録。治安悪化・住民移動が対応を阻害し、国境を越えた拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ назвала крупнейшей нынешнюю вспышку Эболы в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO named the largest current Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) becomes the largest on record. As of 30 July 2026, WHO reports 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,587 deaths, a 44% overall case fatality. In the most recent full epidemiological week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded, signaling an exceptionally rapid spread. The 17th outbreak began 15 May 2026 in eastern DRC and in Uganda, affecting three Congolese provinces. WHO Ebola Response Director Abdirahman Mahamud noted that in the first month the outbreak surpassed all previous ones. The region faces risk of health-system collapse; authorities must keep health facilities supplied with water and electricity. Current case fatality exceeds 25%. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with blood and bodily fluids, with high mortality varying by strain and care available.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCで発生中のエボラ流行を「過去最大」と発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最大規模と認定した致死率44%の急拡大中エボラ流行であり、IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。医療システム崩壊のリスクが指摘されており、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi Kongom: SZO upozorava na najveću epidemiju u historiji zemlje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Congo: WHO warns of the largest epidemic in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus-driven Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest in the country’s history, with ongoing spread to neighboring states flagged by the World Health Organization (WHO). In the last week, 567 new laboratory-confirmed cases and 296 deaths were reported, taking totals to over 3,600 confirmed cases and more than 1,580 deaths. The agency notes that rises reflect both enhanced surveillance and real transmission. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though a new vaccine is under testing. Traditional funeral rites pose high transmission risk, as families can be exposed during preparation of the deceased. Humanitarian groups are supporting safe, dignified burials with protective equipment. Ebola hemorrhagic fever is highly infectious with substantial mortality, transmitted by direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大：WHOが同国史上最大の流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行（3,600例超、死者1,580人超）が進行中で、近隣国への拡大が懸念されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが近隣国への拡大を警告しているが、具体的な拡大先国名は記事中に明示されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、伝統的葬儀慣習が感染拡大要因となっている点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Η επιδημία Έμπολα είναι η χειρότερη στην ιστορία της χώρας, σύμφωνα με τον ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The Ebola epidemic is the worst in the country's history, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the nation's worst outbreak to date. As of July 30, 2026, WHO reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%). The outbreak has surpassed 2018 and 2020 peaks (≈3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths). The virus shows ongoing, sustained transmission, with the last week recording the largest totals yet: 567 new cases and 296 deaths. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; health workers provide supportive care. The epicenter is Ituri Province, with North and South Kivu also affected. Large areas there are controlled by militias with Rwanda-backed support. These conditions heighten the risk of geographic spread, and cross-border movement between countries complicates containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行はWHOによれば同国史上最悪のものである
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（3,605症例、致死率約44%）が継続的な伝播を示しており、国際的拡大リスクと介入の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、武装勢力支配地域や国境をまたぐ人の移動が封じ込めを困難にしている。ルワンダは発生地域として言及されているが、記事の主題は一貫してDRCであり、ルワンダでの発生は確認されていないため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola crece a un 'ritmo inusual' en el Congo: OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak grows at an 'unusual rate' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak—the 17th—driven by Bundibugyo variant is expanding at an exceptional rate, with 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths across five provinces as of July 30, 2026; case fatality about 44%. Ituri province, near borders with South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for roughly 90% of cases; other affected provinces include North Kivu and South Kivu, where parts are controlled by the M23 armed group. Transmission continues, including 151 health-care worker infections (44 deaths). Insecurity, population displacement, mobility, and cross-border movement hinder response and raise spillover risk; Uganda declared its Ebola outbreak over, but risk persists. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo yet. A promising vaccine is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore, and a separate Oxford University vaccine has begun dosing volunteers in the United Kingdom.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が『異例のペース』で拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44％、5州に拡大、医療従事者感染や国境を越える拡散リスクがあり、WHOが『異例のペース』と表現した重大なエボラ流行であるため。
triage.notes: スーダン、ウガンダ、シンガポール、英国は治療薬・ワクチン開発やリスク波及の文脈で言及されているが、実際の流行発生国はDRCのみ。ワクチン・治療薬未確立で公衆衛生上の脅威が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、感染３６００人　コンゴ、過去最大の流行に：東京新聞デジタル
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever, 3,600 infections; Congo's largest outbreak on record
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the World Health Organization announced that Ebola virus disease infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 3,605, the highest on record, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Deaths total 1,587, for a case-fatality rate of about 44%. The outbreak has spread to five provinces in the eastern and central regions. The pace of transmission is accelerating, with the most recent week recording the largest number of cases and deaths to date, underscoring the challenge of containment. There is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak; vaccine development is underway but practical availability remains uncertain. Ongoing conflict between government forces and armed groups in the east is hampering medical activities and contact tracing, complicating surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、感染3,600人 コンゴ、過去最大の流行に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、致死率約44%、5州に拡大、承認済みワクチンがなく紛争が対応を妨げているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 過去最大規模の流行で、Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチンがなく、紛争地域での対応困難という要素がリスクを高めている。WHOの正式発表に基づく情報であり信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、感染3600人　コンゴ、過去最大の流行に
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever: 3,600 people infected; Congo's worst outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire) has reached 3,605 reported cases and 1,587 deaths as of August 1, 2026, according to the World Health Organization. The outbreak is the largest on record in the DRC, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic, with a case fatality rate of about 44%. In the most recent week, it produced the highest weekly counts of both infections and deaths to date. The outbreak has spread across five provinces, with ongoing conflict in the eastern region between government forces and armed groups hampering medical activities. WHO, in collaboration with local authorities, is expanding the response, but officials warn that, at the current pace, containment will be difficult.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、感染3600人　コンゴ、過去最大の流行に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、致死率約44%、5州に拡大、紛争が対応を阻害しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 過去最大規模の流行であり、致死率が高く、紛争地域での医療活動阻害により封じ込めが困難とWHOが警告している。フルRRAへの移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من تسارع انتشار أحد أخطر فيروسات الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of accelerating spread of one of the deadliest Ebola viruses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns of accelerating spread of Bundibugyo virus Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. One of the deadliest Ebola virus types currently circulating in Africa, the outbreak continues with ongoing transmission, rising infections and deaths, and expanding geographic spread. As of 30 July 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported. Containment efforts are hindered by security and humanitarian challenges, limiting response activities and access to affected areas. Geographic spread widening and ongoing transmission occur amid security and humanitarian constraints that impede surveillance, data collection, and containment operations within affected provinces and border areas.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、コンゴ民主共和国で最も危険なエボラウイルス型の一つの拡大加速を警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(Bundibugyoウイルス)の大規模流行で症例3,605件・死亡1,587件と甚大な公衆衛生影響があり、地理的拡大と治安・人道上の制約による対応困難も確認されるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に警告を発しており、致死率の高いエボラ株の流行拡大、治安・人道上の制約による対応困難が報告されている。国際的な支援ニーズが高いと推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Lebbra, cresce l'allerta in Florida: perché una malattia antichissima sta tornando sotto i riflettori
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leprosy, alarm grows in Florida: why an ancient disease is returning to the spotlight.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen's disease) cases are rising in Florida but not an emergency, with 2025: 36 cases (27 locally acquired); by July 2026, 17 new cases, mostly in central Florida along I-4 and Brevard County. Transmission via Mycobacterium leprae occurs mainly through prolonged contact with an untreated person and respiratory secretions; casual contact is unlikely. The nine-banded armadillo is a known natural reservoir, but many recent patients report no armadillo contact or travel to endemic countries, prompting UF and the National Hansen's Disease Program to investigate environmental exposure and soil. Worldwide, WHO reports >170,000 new cases in 2024, with about 80% in India, Brazil, Indonesia; Europe reports imported cases. MDT introduced in the 1980s cures most if diagnosed early. Stigma and late diagnosis remain challenges; early treatment renders patients non-contagious; the true emergency is disability from late diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病、フロリダで警戒高まる：なぜ古代からの疾患が再び注目を集めているのか
triage.triage_reason: 米国フロリダ州でのハンセン病症例増加に関する内容だが対象国外の事象であり、緊急性は低いと記事内でも明言されている。世界的な症例数は言及されているが対象国での新規イベントとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はフロリダ州（米国）における事例が主題であり、インド・ブラジル・インドネシアはWHOの世界統計上の言及に過ぎず、当該国での具体的な発生事象ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: l'épidémie actuelle d'Ebola devient la plus importante jamais enregistrée (OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the current Ebola outbreak becomes the largest ever recorded (WHO).
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is the largest on record in the country, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. The WHO reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%). Initially confined to Mongbwalu health zone in Ituri Province, the outbreak has expanded over the past two months to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Health-care worker infections total 151 with 44 deaths. Insecurity, population movements, and cross-border mobility hinder surveillance and response, and attacks on health facilities raise the risk of undetected transmission. The WHO regards the risk as very high in the DRC, calling for substantial strengthening of surveillance, screening, clinical management, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and logistics to outpace spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:現在のエボラ流行は過去最大規模に(WHO)
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRC史上最大規模と評価するエボラ流行で、致死率約44%、5州49保健地区に拡大し、医療従事者感染も多数発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の該当が明確なためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOはDRC国内リスクを非常に高いと評価。治安不安、住民移動、医療施設への攻撃が監視・対応を妨げており、国境を越えた拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebolautbruddet i Kongo er nå det største noensinne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo is now the largest ever.
article.articleSummary: 1,587 people have died in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak that the WHO now calls the largest in the country's history. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus and lacking approved vaccines or treatments, is concentrated in eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Despite weeks of response efforts, the outbreak is not only uncontrolled but worsening, according to the WHO, which urged a substantial upscaling of emergency aid to curb transmission. Initial cases were identified in mid-May, though transmission may have started earlier before detection. Ebola, a highly contagious viral disease, carries a high mortality. In recent large outbreaks, about half of those infected have died.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ流行は史上最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、死者1,587人、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOが緊急支援の大幅拡充を要請しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによる株で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が既存のZaire株流行と異なる重要な特徴。イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من صعوبة السيطرة على تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو وسط تصاعد الإصابات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization warns of the difficulty in containing an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as cases rise.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening as cases rise. Response teams operate under difficult conditions with restricted access to affected areas due to security and logistical challenges, increasing transmission risk and hindering surveillance and treatment. Media reports quoted officials describing the situation as 'out of control' in some outbreak foci, though this was not an official nationwide declaration. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe illness with high mortality. Containment relies on rapid case detection, isolation, contact tracing, and provision of medical care and vaccines. The DRC has a long Ebola history, notably the 2018 outbreak that caused thousands of infections and deaths before containment efforts succeeded.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱感染拡大に伴い制御困難と警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ流行の制御困難を警告し、症例増加・治安上の対応制限が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 『制御不能』という表現は一部関係者の発言であり、公式な全国的宣言ではない点に留意。具体的な症例数・致死率・地域名などの詳細情報は本文に不足。

article.articleHeadline: V Česku hospitalizovali ženu, ktorá mala po návrate z Ugandy príznaky infekcie - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman who had symptoms of an infection after returning from Uganda was hospitalized in the Czech Republic.
article.articleSummary: An adult woman returning from Uganda to the Czech Republic was hospitalized with fever and transported in a specialized biobox from Hradec Králové to the Infectious Diseases Clinic at Prague’s Bulovka hospital. She is being evaluated for a highly dangerous infectious disease, including Ebola hemorrhagic fever; the Czech Ministry of Health says the chance of a confirmed infection is low and there is no public risk. She toured Uganda as a tourist, visiting areas about 700 kilometres from the Ebola epicenter and mostly staying in national parks during an organized trip, with no contact with locals. Some samples have been sent to the Berlin Koch Institute for testing; results could be known on Sunday morning. The Czech Foreign Ministry warns against travel to border areas of Uganda with the Democratic Republic of Congo due to Ebola cases.

article.articleHeadline: Эбола выходит из-под контроля: в Конго более 3,5 тысячи зараженных
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Out of Control: More than 3,500 Infected in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases since May, with 1,556 deaths. The northeast Ituri province is the epicenter, where armed conflict, poverty, and unsafe burials hinder containment. This is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic in DRC (about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths). The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The situation is highlighted by the World Food Programme’s interim head, Karl Skau. The ongoing trajectory underscores persistent response challenges in conflict-affected areas. This event marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能に：コンゴで感染者3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大速度を持つエボラ流行であり、致死率も高く、ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyo株による大規模流行のため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 3,532例の確定患者、1,556人の死亡（致死率約44%）。2018-2020年流行を上回る史上最速の拡大速度。武力紛争、貧困、危険な埋葬慣行が封じ込めを妨げている。承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、WFPも懸念を表明。DRC史上17番目のエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo se torna o maior da história do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo becomes the largest in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has become the largest in the country’s history, spreading across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. As of July 30, a total of 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths were reported, up 13% in both metrics from the prior week. The crude fatality rate is about 44%, reflecting continued severity despite improved surveillance and case identification. In the last full reporting week, 567 new confirmed cases and 296 deaths marked the highest weekly totals since the outbreak began, with sustained rapid transmission. Initial transmission in Mongbwalu health zone (Ituri) expanded to 49 health zones. Response faces political instability, displacement, and substantial cross-border movement, hindering containment. Uganda declared its Bundibugyo outbreak ended on July 28, but remains at risk of imported cases; WHO urged enhanced vigilance and preparedness across Africa.

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has intensified into the largest Ebola outbreak recorded in the country. As of July 30, 2026, the DRC reported 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ratio 44%). The outbreak has spread from Mongbwalu Health Zone in Ituri Province to five provinces – North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo – spanning 49 health zones with sustained transmission. Epidemiological week 30 marked the highest weekly activity to date: 567 new cases and 296 deaths. Insecurity, displacement, population mobility and cross-border movements are complicating response and raising the risk of further spread. Authorities, WHO and partners are scaling up interventions; a regional Africa-wide preparedness framework guides action and neighboring countries bolster surveillance. Uganda on July 28 declared the end of its Bundibyo virus disease outbreak after 42 days without local transmission, but vigilance remains due to cross-border risk.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria: Preventable killer we must no longer ignore, By Nosimot Soneye
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, remains a preventable killer. Transmission is mainly dusk to dawn, with mother-to-child transmission possible. Globally, malaria kills over 600,000 annually, with Africa bearing 94% of cases and 95% of deaths; about 75% of deaths are in children under five. Symptoms include fever, chills and weakness. The World Malaria Report 2025, released ahead of 2026 World Malaria Day, estimates 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024. Nigeria is among the most affected, alongside DRC, Ethiopia, Mozambique and Uganda, accounting for over half of the global burden. The 2026 World Malaria Day theme, Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must, highlights vaccines, next-generation nets and improved medicines, while drug resistance, climate change, crises and funding gaps threaten progress. Since 2000, interventions have prevented about 2.3 billion cases and saved about 14 million lives; diagnosis by microscopy or rapid tests, followed by ACT, remains essential. In Ogun State, Governor Dapo Abiodun has sustained malaria-prevention interventions and expanded access to healthcare.

article.articleHeadline: El ébola suma más de 1.500 muertos en este país africano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola toll tops more than 1,500 deaths in this African country.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, 2026, a 44% case fatality rate. It is the largest outbreak recorded in the country, spreading across five provinces and 49 health zones. In epidemiological week 30, 567 cases and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly totals to date. Uganda declared the end of its Ebola outbreak on July 28, 2026. The World Health Organization, in collaboration with national authorities, calls for a substantial intensification of response activities to control the outbreak. Key figures underscore escalating transmission and the need for enhanced coordinated public health measures to suppress spread across affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has intensified into the country’s largest Ebola outbreak on record. As of July 30, 2026, the DRC reported 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ratio 44%). The outbreak expanded from Mongbwalu Health Zone in Ituri Province to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo—affecting 49 health zones with sustained transmission and rising infections and deaths nationwide. In epidemiological week 30, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded, the highest weekly figures to date. Insecurity, displacement, mobility and cross-border movements hinder response efforts and raise transmission risk. National authorities, WHO and partners are scaling up interventions under a regional Africa-wide preparedness framework. Uganda declared the end of its Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak on July 28 after 42 days without locally transmitted confirmed cases, but vigilance remains due to cross-border risk.

article.articleHeadline: SZO: Ebola u Kongu van kontrole, opasnost od širenja na susjedne zemlje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola in the Congo out of control, danger of spreading to neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control, with growing risk of cross-border spread per the World Health Organization. The current outbreak is the largest the DRC has ever experienced. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly toll to date. WHO estimates total laboratory-confirmed cases at 3,605 with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The prior largest outbreak occurred from 2018-2020, with 3,317 confirmed cases. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, for which there is no approved vaccine yet; research is under way to develop one. The findings underscore the urgent need to boost surveillance, contact tracing, and cross-border preparedness to deter regional spread.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les points d'entrée et de contrôle, un rempart contre la propagation du virus ( (Dr Théophile Ponde) - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: entry points and checkpoints, a bulwark against the spread of the virus (Dr Théophile Ponde) - Le Potentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is being countered by a network of 60 entry-and-control points along major roads, borders, ports, and Bunia airport to screen mobility, detect suspected cases, and direct them to care. Led by Dr Théophile Ponde, the strategy targets Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu to monitor travelers and other transmission vectors. Since activation, 264 suspected cases have been identified and referred for clinical evaluation; authorities have also intercepted corpses transported by motorcycles to ensure safe handling. Security challenges persist in some areas, though Muzibala near Bunia remains operational 24/7 with rotating teams. Cross-border surveillance with Uganda emphasizes enhanced monitoring under International Health Regulations rather than border closures, with transboundary meetings to harmonize surveillance. At Bunia’s Murongo airport, thermal cameras and QR-based passenger registration accelerate investigations and strengthen entry-point surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：入国・検問ポイントがウイルス拡散への防波堤に（テオフィル・ポンデ医師）- ルポタンシエル
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、264件の疑い例確認、国境を跨ぐ監視体制強化など公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う事案のため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州（ブニア、ロンガロ空港等）でのエボラ対応体制の詳細を報告。ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境監視協力の対象として言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos protrūkis KDR - didžiausias per visą istoriją
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC - the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest in history. The World Health Organization (WHO) reports last week saw 567 new infections and 296 deaths, with laboratory-confirmed cases reaching 3,605 and deaths 1,587; about 651 patients have recovered. The outbreak is linked to the Bandibado strain, for which no vaccine has yet been confirmed; a newly developed vaccine candidate is undergoing trials. While improved surveillance and laboratory capacity contribute to higher counts, transmission continues. Only up to 80% of contacts are tracked for three weeks; experts say 95% is needed. Security remains precarious due to rebel conflict and mass displacement, with widespread public distrust. Many cases do not reach treatment centers, and burial practices pose transmission risks. The outbreak began in January or earlier; Mongbvalu is cited as an early epicenter. Ebola spreads from animals such as bats to humans.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が大流行 - 史上最大の規模
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、死亡者数・感染者数が非常に多く、追跡率も不十分でヒト-ヒト感染が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが報告する史上最大規模のエボラ流行。ワクチン未確定の新変異株（Bandibado株）、治安不安、接触者追跡率不足（最大80%、必要とされる95%未達）など、拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: China's third medical expert team arrives in DR Congo to support Ebola response
article.articleSummary: On Aug. 1, 2026, in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, China's third medical expert team arrived to bolster Ebola response efforts. The delegation will support epidemic surveillance, patient treatment and laboratory testing as the Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains severe and response pressures persist. Luku Maleyo Marius, a DRC health ministry representative, welcomed the team at the airport and emphasized the ongoing severity of the situation and the need for strengthened cooperation. Yang Xiaochen, head of the third team, said the group would build on the work of the first two teams, continuing to provide technical assistance aligned with practical response needs and deepening exchanges with DRC health authorities and international partners. The aim is to contribute Chinese expertise to bringing the current Ebola outbreak to an early end.

article.articleHeadline: சாலையோரத்தில் கோழிக் கழிவுகள்: தொற்றுநோய் பரவும் அபாயம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roadside chicken droppings: risk of spreading infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, residents of Sayalkudi in Ramanathapuram district report a health risk from poultry waste dumped along the Kamuthi-Pullanthai bypass road. Slaughterhouse workers are alleged to be disposing chicken droppings on the roadside, producing a strong odour and attracting waste along the roadway. Public concerns say this practice could facilitate the transmission of infectious diseases to pedestrians, including students, children, and the elderly who pass through the area. The report notes locals have raised complaints about odors and potential health hazards, but provides no detail on laboratory confirmation, specific diseases, or infection sources. No official response or public health interventions are described in the article. The issue underscores the need for proper waste disposal to prevent community exposure near roadside settlements.

article.articleHeadline: Current Ebola outbreak largest ever recorded in DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus becomes the nation’s largest on record with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%), surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic of 3,317 cases. Originating in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, the outbreak has expanded over two months to 49 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Health workers have been hard hit, with 151 infections and 44 deaths among staff. Insecurity, population displacement, high mobility and cross-border movements hamper surveillance and response, and attacks on health facilities restrict access, raising transmission risk. WHO assesses the national outbreak risk as very high and calls for substantial expansion of surveillance, testing, clinical care, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and logistics to curb spread.

article.articleHeadline: Wabak Ebola di Congo bertambah buruk, catat rekod baharu - WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo worsens, sets a new record - WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) worsens, marking the largest on record. WHO reports 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, with 651 recoveries to date. In the last week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded, the highest weekly totals so far. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no licensed vaccine exists; clinical trials of a newly developed vaccine are underway. Some of the surge reflects improved surveillance and testing, but officials say transmission is widening. Only about 80% of infected individuals are monitored for three weeks, well below the 95% target. Public health workers face safety challenges from insurgent conflict, mass displacement, and deep-seated distrust among communities.

article.articleHeadline: Água suja, lama e entulho elevam risco de doenças após temporais na Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dirty water, mud and debris increase the risk of disease after storms in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Storms in Campo Grande leave mud, debris, and sewage after flooding, raising disease risk and demanding careful cleanup. Avoid direct contact with contaminated areas, eliminate standing water, and seek medical care if fever, body aches, or malaise appear. Post-rain conditions favor Aedes mosquitoes, increasing dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risk. Floodwaters also bring waste and sewage into homes, enabling exposure to contaminated food and diseases such as leptospirosis, cholera, hepatitis, and typhoid fever. During cleanup, wear boots, gloves, and long sleeves; inspect footwear, clothing, and dark corners before handling; remove debris and food remnants to deter rats and insects. Keep water and food sealed and discard items damaged by floods. After rains, snakes, scorpions, spiders, and rodents may enter residences; do not capture or kill them—leave the area and contact authorities. For minor wounds, wash with soap and water and monitor for infection; seek care if fever or severe symptoms occur.

article.articleHeadline: 新冠感染迎来小高峰，多数不发烧！医生紧急提醒：出现这6个信号_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 infections reach a small peak; most people don’t have a fever! Doctors urgently remind: watch for these six warning signs.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections in China reached a mid-epidemic level in Week 29, 2026. SARS-CoV-2 positivity among influenza-like illness sentinel hospital visits rose to 16.3%, higher in southern provinces, with ages 15–59 showing the highest positivity. Fever is not required for infection; many patients present with sore throat, dry cough, nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, and fatigue, sometimes with normal temperatures. Early symptoms can resemble a cold, risking delayed testing and isolation. Do not rely on flu antivirals—oseltamivir or baloxavir are ineffective against SARS-CoV-2. COVID-19 antivirals are prescription-only and require clinician oversight due to drug interactions, especially ritonavir-containing regimens; alternatives include Azvudine and other domestics. High-risk groups (≥60 years, hypertension, diabetes, COPD, obesity, smoking, immunocompromise) should start antiviral therapy within 48 hours of onset to reduce progression and mortality. Six warning signs require urgent medical care: persistent chest tightness or dyspnea at rest, SpO2 <94%, altered mental status, unstable BP/HR, reduced urine output, or deterioration of chronic diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染が小さなピークを迎え、多くの人は発熱なし！医師が緊急に注意喚起：この6つのサインに注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19流行の通常の増加を報じる健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 既知のSARS-CoV-2の季節性流行に関する国内向け医療啓発記事であり、新規性や重症度の急増を示す証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS alerte sur une épidémie hors de contrôle et un risque de propagation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO warns of an out-of-control outbreak and a risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak overview: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described by the World Health Organization as out of control, marking the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the country with a rising risk of spread to neighboring states. Over the past week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported, the highest weekly toll since the outbreak began. The cumulative total stands at 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases, including 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The WHO urges a massive scale-up of outbreak response operations to curb transmission and mitigate impact, highlighting the urgency of enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, vaccination, and treatment efforts to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOが制御不能な流行拡大リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「制御不能」「史上最大規模」と警告し、致死率も高く周辺国への拡大リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行とされ、週間新規症例567件・死亡296件と急増。累計3,605例、死亡1,587例、致死率高く、WHOは大規模な対応強化を要請。周辺国への拡大リスクも明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den kritik uyarı: Ebola salgını kontrolden çıkarak endişe verici boyutlara ulaştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues a critical warning: The Ebola outbreak has spiraled out of control and reached alarming proportions.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spiraled out of control, with confirmed cases reaching 3,532 and deaths 1,556. According to the DRC Health Ministry, since the May 15 declaration the outbreak has produced 1,556 deaths and 626 recoveries, with 807 people under isolation. The eastern Ituri Province cluster prompted the declaration on May 15, and the WHO followed by declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The current outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there are no approved therapeutics or vaccines. The WHO cautions containment is not achievable at present and urges international vigilance and a coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによる重大警告：エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能となり、深刻な事態に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEIC宣言済みで、症例数・死亡者数が多く制御不能とWHOが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済み、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行。WHOが国際的な警戒と協調対応を要請している重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: В Нью-Йорке выявлен первый случай заражения редким вирусом Бурбон - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of infection with the rare Bourbon virus detected in New York - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: First case of Bourbon virus infection detected in New York, marking the virus’s presence in the Northeast; there is no vaccine and no specific treatment. Bourbon virus, named after Bourbon County, Kansas, where it was first identified in 2014, has sickened six people in the United States with at least two deaths; doctors acknowledge other infections may have gone undetected. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, skin irritation/rash, headache, nausea, and muscle pains; laboratory confirmation is hindered by the lack of specialized tests. Transmission is via dog ticks, and Stony Brook Medicine notes high tick numbers in the Northeast, including New York, with the dog tick described as aggressive and present in about 20 states. Separately, reports say a U.S. citizen contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with CDC coordinating to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ニューヨークで希少なブルボンウイルス感染の初症例確認 - Vesti.ru
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はニューヨークでのブルボンウイルス感染（対象国外）だが、同記事内でコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における米国人のエボラ出血熱感染とCDCの対応が言及されており、深刻な公衆衛生上のリスクと国際的拡大の懸念があるためフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 記事本文の主眼は米国ニューヨークでのブルボンウイルス感染事例（対象国外のため評価対象外）。DRCでのエボラ感染例は簡潔な言及のみで詳細情報（発生規模、感染経路、地域拡大状況等）が不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid despenca 88% em Cuiabá, mas casos de gripe disparam quase 75%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 plunges 88% in Cuiabá, but flu cases surge nearly 75%.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases in Cuiabá, Brazil, declined 88.4% in 2026 (Jan 4–Jul 25), with 121 confirmed cases and five deaths (96 residents of Cuiabá, 25 from other municipalities). The previous year’s period recorded 1,043 cases. Influenza A and B notifications surged 74.95, totaling 2,386 cases (1,858 Cuiabá residents, 528 from other municipalities) and 21 deaths (16 residents). The rise follows greater circulation of respiratory viruses this season, low vaccination coverage, and expanded testing in 2026; many reports originate from private health networks. Influenza affected most: children ≤6 years (966 cases), then ages 15–59 (673), 7–14 (572), and 60+ (175). Between epidemiological weeks 1–29, 1,463 SRAG cases (1,043 in Cuiabá). COVID-19 caused 27 SRAG hospitalizations and 5 deaths; influenza caused 332 hospitalizations and 21 deaths, mainly in those >60. Flu vaccination is available at 72 Family Health Units for prioritized groups; symptomatic individuals should seek care if worsening.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバでCOVID-19が88%減少、一方でインフルエンザ症例は約75%急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19減少・インフルエンザ増加）に関する通常の疫学サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・クイアバ市の季節性インフルエンザとCOVID-19の疫学動向に関する定例報告。ワクチン接種体制も整備されており、地域内で管理可能な状況。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、これは通常の季節性サーベイランスであり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго се влошува и е најлошата досега
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is worsening and is the worst to date.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the worst in the country’s history, according to the World Health Organization. As of August 1, 2026, lab-confirmed cases reach 3,605 with 1,587 deaths and 651 survivors. In the past week, 567 infections and 296 deaths were reported, marking the highest weekly totals to date. The ongoing outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine and whose clinical trials are underway. Frontline medical staff operate under dangerous security conditions amid clashes with rebel groups, while hundreds of thousands are displaced and communities show deep mistrust. The UN agency warns that the risk of cross-border spread to neighboring countries is rising.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が悪化、過去最悪の状況に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行と表明し、確定症例3,605人・死者1,587人、直近週で過去最多の感染・死亡数を記録。承認ワクチンがない変異株、治安悪化、越境拡大リスクの指摘があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンがないBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、治安悪化・住民の不信感・大規模避難民の存在が対応をさらに困難にしている。WHOは近隣国への越境拡大リスクを警告しており、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠阳性率超20%"，最新情况公布_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 positivity rate exceeds 20%; latest updates announced.
article.articleSummary: Week 30, 2026 China CDC sentinel respiratory‑disease surveillance (July 20–26) shows COVID‑19 positivity as the leading infection among influenza‑like illness outpatients at 20.3%, with influenza viruses at 14.5% and enteroviruses at 5.9%. Among hospitalized SARI cases, SARS‑CoV‑2 positivity is 9.5%, influenza 6.4%, and human bocavirus 4.3%. Geographically, southern provinces (Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Chongqing, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan) report higher positivity than northern provinces (Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Henan, Tibet, Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, Xinjiang, Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps). Age patterns show COVID‑19 positivity highest in 0–4, 15–59, and 60+ groups; influenza positivity highest in 5–14 years. SARI pathogens include Mycoplasma pneumoniae and SARS‑CoV‑2. The dominant SARS‑CoV‑2 NB.1.8.1 lineage shows no new pathogens or high‑risk variants; no major public health disruption. Public guidance emphasizes masking, hygiene, vaccination, and prompt care when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ陽性率20%超え、最新状況発表
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCの定期的な呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザ等）の季節的動向を示すのみで、新規変異株や重大な公衆衛生上の混乱は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 定例のサーベイランス報告であり、記事内でも「新規病原体や高リスク変異株なし、主要な公衆衛生上の混乱なし」と明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: ワクチン、秋にも大規模臨床　対エボラ、コンゴで流行 -- 国際組織：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine against Ebola to undergo large-scale clinical trials by autumn; Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) worsens, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths reported as of July 29, and Uganda neighboring the outbreak. An experimental Bundibugyo vaccine in early clinical trials could move to large-scale efficacy testing as early as September–October this autumn, according to CEPI CEO Richard Hatchett. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for this strain yet. CEPI, established to hasten rapid vaccine development, aims to raise $2.5 billion for its 2027–2031 five-year strategy. Over 30 countries contribute; Japan ranks as the second-largest donor after Germany. The article notes shrinking foreign aid from major powers amid rising defense spending, warning that outbreaks affect economies and national security and urging infectious-disease preparedness as a security issue.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン、秋にも大規模臨床　対エボラ、コンゴで流行 -- 国際組織：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が拡大しており、致死率が高く承認済みワクチン・治療薬もないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、実際の症例発生国としての明記はないため対象国リストには含めていない（ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれない）。日本・ドイツはCEPIへの資金拠出国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Multivacinação começa segunda-feira com foco no sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Multivaccination begins Monday with a focus on Measles.
article.articleSummary: Barretos, São Paulo, Brazil launches a multivaccination campaign from Monday, August 3, through August 31, at all Basic Health Units (8 a.m.–4 p.m.), prioritizing measles vaccination. Adults may also have their vaccination cards updated. The municipal Epidemiological Surveillance coordinator, Rodrigo Barros, warns of the return of measles to Brazil and to São Paulo, noting most cases occur in unvaccinated people and urging up-to-date records. The campaign centers on the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) triple viral vaccine as its main focus. In the state, 15 measles cases have been confirmed in 2026 as of July 30, including a child with no vaccination history. The Health Ministry targets 95% coverage for two doses of the MMR vaccine. A special vaccination day on Saturday, August 1, at Zequinha Amêndola UBS focused on updates and influenza vaccination, with vaccines available to everyone from six months, though coverage remains low in risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹に焦点を当てた複合ワクチン接種、月曜日から開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が確認され予防接種キャンペーンが実施されているが、症例数は限定的で深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 州内で2026年に15例の麻疹症例が確認されており、未接種者への予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。国際的拡大や深刻な影響を示す証拠はないため、続報を注視するレベル。

article.articleHeadline: মুখ থেকে রক্ত, হেমারেজিক ডেঙ্গুর বেশে শহরে হঠাৎ হানা ভাইভ্যাক্স ম্যালেরিয়ার! যুবকের প্রাণ বাঁচাল এম আর বাঙ্গুর
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bleeding from the mouth, vivax malaria strikes the city masquerading as dengue hemorrhagic fever! A young man's life was saved by MR Bangur.
article.articleSummary: In Kolkata’s Tollygunge, at MR Bangur Hospital, a 19-year-old man with three to four days of fever and seizures arrived on June 9 with bleeding from the mouth, initially resembling dengue hemorrhagic fever. Dengue tests were negative; blood smear showed Plasmodium vivax parasites, confirming vivax malaria. Mild liver enzyme rise and slightly low albumin accompanied a marked drop in platelets, mimicking dengue. Because of the severe presentation, clinicians started artesunate immediately, instead of the usual quinine for vivax malaria, and the patient survived. Over the last three months, six vivax malaria admissions at Bangur have underscored that vivax can be serious; some cases had brain involvement, and one middle-aged patient died. Health officials warn that this year malaria—not dengue or covid—poses a public health concern. Dr. Soumitra Ghosh notes bleeding can occur in vivax malaria but is rare.

triage.headline_ja: 口からの出血、デング出血熱を装った突然のバイバックスマラリア発症！MRバングール病院が若者の命を救う
triage.triage_reason: コルカタの一病院における重症バイバックス型マラリアの症例報告であり、3か月間で6例（うち1名死亡）と限定的だが、デング様症状での誤診や重症化傾向がみられ、続報の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 単一病院（コルカタ、MRバングール病院）における症例報告であり、地域全体への拡大や公的機関の対応状況は不明。デング熱との誤診リスクおよびマラリアの重症化傾向を示す事例として今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli nabiera tempa. Liczba ofiar wzrosła do 1556
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is gaining momentum. The death toll has risen to 1,556.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-01, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths. This outbreak is the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that infected over 28,000 people and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Transmission is occurring in regions where medical and preventive activities are often limited. Ebola is a severe, highly contagious disease; infection occurs primarily through direct contact with the blood, secretions, or excreta of a sick person, and can spread via contaminated objects. Source: Polska Agencja Prasowa via Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が加速。死者数は1,556人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,532症例・1,556死亡に達し、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行と報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、今回の発生地域ではないため除外した。
