article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie s'intensifie à un rythme "exceptionnel", 3 605 cas dont 1 587 décès recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak is intensifying at an "exceptional" pace, 3,605 cases including 1,587 deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is accelerating at an exceptional pace. By July 30, 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality 44%) were reported, with a record 567 cases and 296 deaths in the latest week. Declared May 15, the outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine or treatment exists. It began in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, and has spread over two months to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The WHO warns insecurity, displacement, mobility, and cross-border movement hinder response and raise spread risk. Uganda has declared the end of its Ebola outbreak, but regional risk remains. Two vaccine efforts are underway: a vaccine described by WHO as the most promising, to be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based), and an Oxford University (UK) candidate using the AstraZeneca platform; the first volunteer received the dose last week.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDRCで拡大：流行が「例外的」なペースで激化、3,605例中1,587例死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44%の大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブジョ株が原因であり、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が非常に高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国のエボラ流行終息を宣言したが記事の主題ではなく、地域的リスクとして言及されているのみ。シンガポール・英国はワクチン開発拠点として言及されているだけで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Actual brote de ébola es el más grande registrado en RDC, informa OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak is the largest on record in the DRC, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest on record, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak that had 3,317 cases. As of Aug 1, 2026, 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,587 deaths (44% case fatality) are attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak began in Mongbwalu health zone, Ituri province, and has spread to 49 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Healthcare workers account for 151 infections and 44 deaths. Ongoing security challenges, population displacement, high mobility, and cross-border movement hinder surveillance and response; attacks on facilities further limit access to care. The WHO assesses domestic risk as very high and calls for substantial expansion of surveillance, testing, clinical care, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and logistics to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行は、WHOによるとDRCで記録上最大規模
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WHOも国内リスクを非常に高いと評価しているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）、49保健区域に拡大、致死率44%、医療従事者感染多数、治安悪化・人口移動により対応困難。WHOは国内リスクを非常に高いと評価し、国際支援の拡大を要請。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يخرج عن السيطرة وخطر انتقاله يتصاعد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in Congo is spiraling out of control, and the risk of its transmission is rising.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spiraling out of control, with the risk of cross-border transmission rising. The current outbreak is the largest in the country’s history, recording 567 new cases and 296 deaths in the past week, bringing total confirmed cases to 3,605 and deaths to 1,587; 651 recoveries. The rise is linked to wider virus spread and improved surveillance and testing, but response teams can only trace about 80% of contacts, insufficient to halt transmission. Ongoing security and humanitarian challenges—armed conflict, displacement, and limited access to some patients—likely push the true case count higher than reported, complicating containment and raising concerns for neighboring nations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ流行が制御不能に陥り、感染拡大のリスクが上昇している
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ史上最大のエボラ流行が制御不能と警告しており、致死率が高く越境拡大のリスクも指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 武力紛争や人道危機により実際の症例数は報告より多い可能性があり、接触者追跡率も約80%と不十分。近隣国への拡大リスクが懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Where DR Congo failed in containing the virus, Uganda succeeds
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri, centered on Bunia, has become the second-worst on record with official deaths exceeding 1,500 since it was declared in May; true fatalities are likely higher. The outbreak strain is Bundibugyo, and the virus is spreading faster than in previous events, complicating surveillance and response in DR Congo where insecurity and logistical bottlenecks hinder containment. In neighboring Uganda, the situation is markedly better: 20 cases and 2 deaths, with 15 infections imported from DR Congo. Uganda discharged the last patient from Mulago hospital two weeks ago. Authorities credit preparedness and swift measures—activation of a treatment centre, border closure, and quarantine of more than 6,000 contacts for 21 days—facilitating rapid containment after cases were detected post-DR Congo’s publicisation of multiple infections. Lessons from past outbreaks underpin Uganda’s approach, including a cited 2011 case in Luwero illustrating strict isolation and PPE. Cross-border movement and M23-affected areas in DR Congo complicate surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：コンゴ民主共和国が封じ込めに失敗した一方、ウガンダは成功
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は史上2番目の規模で死者1500人超、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染（20症例、輸入症例15件）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる流行地はDRC・イトゥリ州ブニアである。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشى إيبولا في الكونغو يخرج عن السيطرة |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control as of August 2, 2026, the largest on record, with cross-border spillover risk. Laboratory-confirmed cases reach 3,605; deaths 1,587; recoveries 651. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths—the highest weekly totals since the start. The outbreak surpasses the 2018–2020 event (3,317 cases). WHO cites improved surveillance and testing, but attributes the rise mainly to wider transmission. About 80% of contacts are followed for three weeks; experts say 95% is needed for effective control. WHO calls for a major expansion of response activities to curb spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行が制御不能な状況にあり、国境を越えた拡散リスクがWHOにより指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行（症例数3,605、死亡1,587）、週間新規感染・死亡数が過去最高を記録。接触者追跡率が目標の95%に達せず（現状約80%）、WHOは対応強化と国境を越えた拡散防止のための支援拡大を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠流感夾擊丨30多歲港男外遊返港染新冠甲流一度命危 醫生教7招預防自保
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 and Influenza A Strike: A Hong Kong man in his 30s who returned from overseas contracted both illnesses and was critically ill at one point; doctor shares seven self-protection tips.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 and Influenza A activity rising in Hong Kong. An imported case from overseas involved a man in his 30s who was confirmed to have co-infection with SARS-CoV-2 and Influenza A, progressing to severe asthma and acute respiratory failure requiring artificial lung support and ICU care; he recovered after about a week. Over the past four weeks, Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection recorded 45 severe adult COVID-19 cases (including 7 deaths); about 80% were 65+, and over 90% had chronic illnesses, with all not having a COVID-19 booster in the last six months. In June, two severe pediatric cases occurred, both unvaccinated. Symptoms for COVID-19 and flu overlap (fever, headache, sore throat, cough); home rapid antigen tests can yield results within 24 hours to guide early antiviral decisions. High-risk groups are urged to consider vaccination; activity may peak in 1–2 weeks and persist for 6–8 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナとインフル『甲流』のダブルパンチ丨海外渡航歴のある30代香港人男性が新型コロナと甲型インフルエンザに感染し一時重篤に　医師が予防策7項目を伝授
triage.triage_reason: 香港でCOVID-19とインフルエンザAの重症例・死亡例が報告され、重症度・持続的な曝露・流行しやすさの基準に該当し、当局・メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ活動増加に関する香港衛生当局の報告。個別重症例と統計データ（過去4週間で重症45例、死亡7例）が含まれるが、異常性・国際的拡大の兆候は認められず、既知の季節性パターンの範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 南市新增一例登革熱境外移入病例 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan City reports one new imported dengue fever case | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: One new imported dengue fever case was reported in Tainan City on July 30: a Taiwanese woman in Yongkang District (Liuhe Li) who traveled to Vietnam from June 23–29 and returned July 29. She developed fever July 28; after arrival at Kaohsiung Airport, an NS1 test was negative, but hospital PCR on July 30 confirmed dengue infection, the fifth imported case in Tainan. The Dengue Prevention Center promptly deployed fogging, environmental cleanup, vector density surveys, and health education to prevent spread. Nationally, Taiwan has 108 dengue cases as of July 31: 7 locally transmitted and 101 imported, with Indonesia the most common source, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. Travelers are advised to use protective measures and seek care if fever develops after travel, noting travel history to physicians. Ongoing surveillance shows over 500,000 Aedes eggs collected; 56,175 households inspected; 6,822 standing-water containers found; 120 positive; 31,430 people educated.

triage.headline_ja: 南市で新たに1例のデング熱境外移入症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入症例1例の通常サーベイランス報告であり、対象国での発生事例ではない。国際的拡大リスクや異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（対象国リスト外）。ベトナムは患者の渡航先として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 18 tonnes de matériel pour renforcer la riposte à l'hôpital de Bunia (Ambassadeur du Maroc) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 18 metric tonnes of equipment to bolster the response at Bunia hospital (Morocco's ambassador) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to unfold in the eastern regions, with more than 3,000 cases and 1,437 deaths across five provinces since its May 2026 declaration. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain. In Bunia, Ituri Province, a Level-2 hospital has been reinforced and transformed into an Ebola treatment center through a Moroccan aid package comprising 18 tonnes of medical equipment, three doctors, and four health professionals. The assistance was announced during Morocco’s commemoration of King Mohammed VI’s throne anniversary, reflecting solidarity and bilateral cooperation. The DRC has experienced its 17th Ebola outbreak. These measures aim to strengthen patient care and clinical management at Bunia to support the regional response in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:モロッコ大使、ブニア病院の対応強化へ18トンの資材を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（5州、3000例超、死者1437人）に関する継続報道であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確なためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はモロッコによる人道支援活動を主眼としているが、背景として進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（DRC、第17次流行）の深刻さを示す情報を含むため、継続監視・フル評価が妥当。モロッコは支援提供国であり発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Where DR Congo failed in containing the virus, Uganda succeeds
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern DR Congo is the second-worst outbreak on record, with official deaths surpassing 1,500 since the May declaration and authorities warning the virus is spreading faster than in previous outbreaks. Uganda presents a contrasting picture: the last patient was released from Mulago hospital two weeks ago, and the country has recorded only 20 cases and two deaths. WHO Uganda chief Dr Kasonde Mwinga credits preparedness and prior experience for the relatively low toll. DR Congo has had 17 Ebola outbreaks since discovery, while Uganda has faced nine since 2000. A historic 2011 case in Luwero prompted rapid isolation and PPE, with a blood sample later confirming Ebola. Uganda’s first known case this time was a DR Congo man who crossed the border for treatment; Mulago activated an Ebola treatment centre with stock on hand and an emergency team ready to receive patients in one day.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国はウイルス封じ込めに失敗、ウガンダは成功
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ流行は史上2番目の規模で死者1,500人超、感染拡大速度も過去の流行より速く、既に国境を越えてウガンダへの伝播も確認されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダの対比が主題だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでは2026年5月の宣言以降、死者1,500人超で史上2番目の規模の流行となり、感染拡大速度が過去の流行より速いと当局が警告している。既にウガンダへの越境感染例も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يخرج عن السيطرة وخطر انتقاله يتصاعد - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Congo is out of control and the risk of its transmission is rising.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, with rising risk of cross-border transmission. The current outbreak is the largest in the country's history, reporting 567 new cases and 296 deaths in the past week, bringing confirmed infections to 3,605 and deaths to 1,587, with 651 recoveries. The rise in cases is attributed to wider virus spread and expanded surveillance and testing. However, response teams can trace only about 80% of contacts, a rate deemed insufficient to curb transmission. Efforts face security and humanitarian hurdles, including armed conflict, displacement, and access barriers that prevent some patients from reaching treatment centers, suggesting the true case count may be higher than reported. The situation underscores ongoing risk of regional spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能に陥り、感染拡大のリスクが高まっている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が制御不能で、国境を越えた拡大リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが史上最大規模のエボラ流行と警告。接触者追跡率は約80%にとどまり、武力紛争や避難民の存在が対応を困難にしている。実際の症例数は報告より多い可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Ada Penambahan Kasus Campak, Tapi Dinkes Kota Cirebon Belum Bisa Cabut Status KLB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are no new measles cases, but the Cirebon City Health Office cannot yet lift the outbreak status.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak status persists in Cirebon City, Indonesia, despite no new cases reported in 10 days. Lifting the KLB requires epidemiological criteria: at least 28 consecutive days without new cases (two incubation periods) and any new cases must not be epidemiologically linked to previous ones. Current evaluation still shows two linked cases from transmission among siblings, preventing cancellation of the outbreak status. Decision made via cross-sector review with camat, lurah, hospitals, Education Department, Religion Ministry, and Bappeda. Immunization coverage as of June 2026 is 34%, well below the first-half target of 47.5%, and far from the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity to halt transmission and protect infants not yet eligible for vaccination. The KLB has been in place since February 20, 2026 and will remain until criteria are met.

triage.headline_ja: 新規麻疹症例なしも、チレボン市保健局はアウトブレイク（KLB）指定を解除できず
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・チレボン市で麻疹アウトブレイクが継続中だが新規症例はなく、地域限定の状況。ただし予防接種率が34%と著しく低く、今後の流行拡大の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 予防接種率が目標(47.5%)や集団免疫閾値(95%)を大きく下回っており、今後の症例増加リスクに注意が必要。現時点では地域内での対応が続けられている。

article.articleHeadline: Mật phục nhiều ngày, chặn 35 tấn heo nhiễm chất cấm chuẩn bị vào TPHCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Undercover for several days, 35 tons of pigs contaminated with banned substances bound for Ho Chi Minh City were intercepted.
article.articleSummary: 35 tons of pigs contaminated with banned substances bound for Ho Chi Minh City were intercepted after covert overnight surveillance. Three lots, totaling 280 animals, tested positive for Beta-agonists—Salbutamol and Clenbuterol—with one lot also infected by African swine fever virus. All animals were culled. The shipments were destined for a Ho Chi Minh City slaughterhouse, highlighting risks of disease spread and food-safety violations during transport. Authorities emphasized the complex supply chains and the need for strict checks at city gates. In the first half of 2026, inspections of more than 14,000 food-producing facilities led to numerous violations and fines exceeding 11 billion VND, with 26 cases prosecuted for counterfeit or unsafe foods. The “Tick Green Responsibility” program expands to markets, schools, hospitals, industrial zones, and e-commerce to improve traceability. A separate incident involved nearly 200 ducks from Dong Nai to Ho Chi Minh City without a veterinary certificate.

triage.headline_ja: 数日間の張り込みの末、禁止物質に汚染された豚35トンをホーチミン市搬入前に摘発
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、本記事は違法薬物混入豚肉の摘発という食品安全・取締り事案が主題であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ASFはベトナムで既に流行が確認されている動物疾病であり、本件は密輸・違法薬物混入豚の摘発という規制執行活動が主題。人への健康被害は報告されておらず、フルRRAへの移行は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τα κρούσματα ξεπέρασαν τα 3.500, η επιδημία στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cases surpassed 3,500; outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of August 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 3,532 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths in roughly two and a half months, with total cases surpassing 3,500. The outbreak centers in Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with about 90% of cases, and has reached North Kivu and South Kivu, whose capitals are controlled by the M23 movement. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; funerals drive spread, and violence and weak infrastructure hinder response, including attacks by the ADF in Ituri. Uganda has declared its Ebola outbreak over, though the WHO warns ongoing risk. A WHO-promoted vaccine candidate will be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore); last week a first volunteer received an Oxford University vaccine using the same platform as AstraZeneca’s COVID shot.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：症例数が3,500人を超える、コンゴ民主共和国での流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で承認ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱が拡大し、致死率約44%、3,500例超・死亡1,556人に達しており、紛争地域での対応困難も重なり国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息宣言済みだが、WHOは引き続きリスクを警告。コンゴ以外のスーダン・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン開発（Hilleman Laboratories、Oxford大学）の動きあり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola Outbreak In DR Congo Spiralling Out Of Control, Risk Of Transmission Escalating
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak remains out of control, becoming the largest Ebola outbreak ever reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 30 July 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported, a crude case fatality ratio of 44%. In the most recent complete reporting week (epidemiological week 30), 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly totals to date. The rapid transmission is complicated by insecurity, population displacement and mobility, and cross-border movements, increasing the risk of transmission to neighboring countries and challenging containment and response operations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に陥り、感染拡大のリスクが高まっている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が制御不能となり、致死率44%、週単位の症例・死亡数が過去最多を更新。国境を越えた感染拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に「制御不能」と表明しており、史上最大規模のDRCエボラ流行。治安悪化・人口移動により近隣国への越境感染リスクが高い状況。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Epidemija ebole u Kongu se pogoršava i najgora je dosad | 6yka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening and the worst to date | 6yka.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening and the worst on record, with WHO warning of deeper complexity and cross-border spillover risk. In the past week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported, the largest weekly totals since the start of the epidemic. Laboratory-confirmed cases total 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine exists, while candidate vaccines remain in clinical trials. Health workers face intensified challenges beyond clinical care, as insecurity from armed groups, ongoing conflict, and mass internal displacement impede response efforts and fuel distrust in authorities. The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the epicenter, with heightened concern about transmission to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は悪化し、これまでで最悪の状況に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の過去最大規模の週間感染者・死亡者数を記録し、承認ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo型による流行拡大、武力紛争による対応困難、越境拡大リスクが確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 承認ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、武力紛争・住民避難が対応を著しく困難にしている。近隣国への越境拡大が懸念されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: વિશ્વ હિપેટાઈટિસ દિનની ઉજવણી: જામનગરમાં ઇટ્રામાં 150 યુજી-પીજી સ્કોર્લસને હિપેટાઈટિસ બી-સી અંગે વિસ્તૃત માહિતી આપી
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Hepatitis Day celebration: In Jamnagar, 150 UG-PG scholars were given detailed information about Hepatitis B and C in the IT room.
article.articleSummary: World Hepatitis Day was celebrated in Jamnagar by the municipal health department under the theme 'Let's Break It Down' at ITRA, informing approximately 150 undergraduate and postgraduate scholars about Hepatitis B and C in the IT room. Dr. Hareshkumar Gori and city health officer Dr. Palak Ganatra guided the program with support from ITRA's director. Prof. Ami Trivedi, General Medicine and MTC-NVHVP nodal officer, delivered detailed information on Hepatitis B and C—types, symptoms, prevention, vaccination importance, and government-funded free treatment and services. Dean Dr. Nandini Desai attended. IEC materials were displayed to promote awareness in simple language, with Lions Club members also participating. The session noted Hepatitis A and E spread mainly through contaminated water or food, typically causing short-term illness that resolves with proper care. The aim was public awareness, timely diagnosis and treatment, and encouragement of healthy lifestyles.

triage.headline_ja: 世界肝炎デーの祝典：ジャムナガルのITRAで150名の学部生・大学院生にB型・C型肝炎について詳細説明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、世界肝炎デーの啓発イベント・教育活動に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界肝炎デーの啓発活動報告であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱の感染3600人超　コンゴ民主、過去最大の流行に
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever infections exceed 3,600; the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its largest outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths, WHO reports as of 2 August 2026, making it the largest outbreak on record and surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. The eastern DRC outbreak is spreading rapidly across five provinces; ongoing conflict between government forces and insurgent groups is hampering medical responses and contact tracing. The case fatality rate stands at about 44%. There is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving this outbreak; vaccine development is underway but practical deployment remains uncertain. The WHO emphasizes strengthened response coordination with local authorities, but containment remains challenging at the current pace. No details on symptoms or infection sources are provided beyond the strain name and geographic scope.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染3600人超　コンゴ民主、過去最大の流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44%、過去最大規模の流行で5州に拡大し、紛争により対応が困難となっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、紛争地域での対応困難、過去最大規模である点から高リスクと判断。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo tốc độ lây lan dịch Ebola 'khác thường' ở CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of unusually rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading unusually rapidly, per WHO on August 1, 2026. The current outbreak, the largest recorded in the DRC, began May 15 and is caused by Ebola virus Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. By July 30, 2026, 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths were confirmed (approximate 44% fatality). The epicenter is Ituri Province in northeast DRC near borders with South Sudan and Uganda; the outbreak has spread to four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, areas with substantial territory under M23 armed movement control. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. WHO warns the outbreak will remain complex as transmission chains have not yet been broken and calls for intensified international response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の「異常な」感染拡大速度を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率約44%、複数州へ拡大、WHOが異常な速度での感染拡大を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: エピセンターはイトゥリ州で対象国リストに含まれないが、記事の主題はDRC全体の流行であり、南キブ州を含むDRC国内での拡大が中心。ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境近接地域として言及されているが、感染発生は確認されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠卷土重来 大陆医生：急诊室都挤爆了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 resurges; doctors in Mainland China: Emergency rooms are packed.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in Mainland China as SARS-CoV-2 positivity climbs above 20% in national sentinel acute respiratory disease surveillance for July 20–26, with the NB.1.8.1 lineage remaining the dominant strain. Among influenza-like illness samples, COVID-19 positivity is 20.3% and influenza 14.5%; infection positivity is highest in ages 0–4, 15–59, and 60+. Over three weeks, emergency department COVID-19 positivity nearly doubled from 9.6% to 20.3%. Official data may undercount due to opacity. Reports from Liaoning indicate concentrated outbreaks with rising antiviral use; social media from Shanghai, Hangzhou, Shanxi, Beijing describe renewed infections and household spread. A July 29 Zhengzhou case, a 36-year-old man, began with cold symptoms and developed fulminant myocarditis, surviving after 20 days in intensive care. By late July, doctors in Shandong and elsewhere reported crowded ERs and bed shortages.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス感染症が再流行、中国本土の医師：救急外来はパンク状態
triage.triage_reason: 中国本土で新型コロナ陽性率が急上昇（9.6%→20.3%）し、重症例や救急外来の逼迫が報告されており、WPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 公式データの透明性に懸念があるとの記述あり。劇症型心筋炎の重症例が1例報告されている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、感染３６００人　コンゴ、過去最大の流行に：中日新聞Web
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease, 3,600 infections; Congo faces its largest outbreak on record: Chunichi Shimbun Web
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, the World Health Organization reports Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totaling 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths, marking the largest outbreak on record in the country and surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. The case fatality rate is about 44%. In the past week, the outbreak recorded its highest weekly counts for both infections and deaths. The outbreak has spread to five eastern provinces, where ongoing conflict between government forces and armed groups constrains medical activities. WHO is assisting and urging a substantial expansion of response capacity, but officials warn that containment remains challenging at the current pace.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、感染3,600人 コンゴ、過去最大の流行に：中日新聞Web
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行(3,605例、致死率44%)が発生し、5州に拡大、武力紛争により対応が制約されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 紛争地域での流行拡大により対応能力の大幅拡充が必要とWHOが要請しており、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le nombre de contacts non vus a doublé en onze jours, de 1 988 à 4 408
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the number of unseen contacts has doubled in eleven days, from 1,988 to 4,408.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a widening gap in follow-up despite ongoing transmission. By 30 July 2026, 17,863 contacts are under follow-up with 13,455 seen, leaving 4,408 not seen—a floor estimate based on zones reporting data; stock rose from 10,519 on 19 July. Across 49 of 140 affected health zones, Ituri accounts for 11,638 contacts (8,781 seen, 75.5%), and Nord-Kivu about 5,700 (roughly 74.7% seen); Haut-Uélé 458 (80.6%), Tshopo 66.2% (43/65); Kabondo Kisangani 0%; Sud-Kivu follow-up closed. In Ituri, Mahagi, Kambala and Boga report 0%; Nyankunde 12.7%, Bunia 22% data reported. Since the outbreak began on 15 May 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases have been recorded. The COUSP notes weak, declining follow-up, risking uninterrupted transmission, with calls to strengthen RECO community relays, supervision, and investigate the follow-up drop.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：追跡できていない接触者数が11日間で1,988人から4,408人に倍増
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例3,605件に達するエボラ流行が継続中で、接触者追跡の悪化により感染拡大リスクが高まっているため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にイタリア・ロンバルディア州が含まれているが、記事本文はDRC国内の接触者追跡状況のみを扱っており、イタリアでの発生や関連は記載がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ausbruch des Bundibugyo-Virus eskaliert in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Bundibugyo virus outbreak escalates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak escalates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 30 July 2026, the World Health Organization reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths. Transmission continues, with rising case counts and fatalities and expanding geographic spread, signaling a growing health emergency. In the past week, 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly totals since the outbreak began, indicating an unprecedented speed of spread. Factors impeding response include insecurity, population displacement, and cross-border movement. National authorities, WHO and partners are implementing extensive outbreak-control measures, but there is a need to scale up activities across sectors to curb transmission. Bundibugyo virus is a type of Ebola virus that causes Bundibugyo virus disease, a viral hemorrhagic illness.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョウイルスの発生が拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ属(ブンディブギョウウイルス)による大規模な致死性アウトブレイクで、症例・死亡数が急増し地理的拡大も認められ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く(1587/3605≒44%)、直近1週間の症例・死亡数が過去最多となっており、国境を越えた人の移動や治安悪化が対応の障害となっている。WHOはすでに公式報告を出しており、国際的な支援拡大の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares DR Congo's Ebola outbreak worst on record
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo strain) is the largest outbreak ever recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda. Declared May 15, 2026, it is described as intensifying with sustained transmission. As of July 30, 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%). The past week saw a record high with 567 cases and 296 deaths. Insecurity, population displacement and cross-border movement hamper response; a substantial scale-up of operations is underway by national authorities, WHO and partners. Across the border, Uganda declared the end of its Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak on July 28 after 42 days without a locally transmitted case; the most recent imported case was discharged July 16 after two negative tests, with 42 days of monitoring to prevent missed transmission chains. Ongoing vigilance for cross-border transmission remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行を「記録上最悪」と宣言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行（3,605症例、死亡1,587例、致死率44%）が発生し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間ローカル感染なしで流行終息を宣言済みだが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。スーダンも記事中で言及されているが対象国外かつ本文中で流行発生国として明示されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Latest WHO Updates on Ebola in DRC Shows 3605 Infections, 1587 Deaths and Fatality Ratio Reaching 44 Percent
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,605 infections and 1,587 deaths as of 30 July 2026, a 44% case fatality ratio. It is the country’s largest Ebola outbreak, expanding from Mongbwalu in Ituri Province to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for 88% of cases and 82.6% of deaths. In epidemiological week 30, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported, driven largely by transmission, despite some increases from enhanced surveillance. So far, 17,863 contacts are being monitored; 151 healthcare workers have been infected with 44 deaths. Insecurity, attacks on facilities, displacement and cross-border movement hinder control. Uganda has declared its outbreak over (28 July) but remains at risk for imports. WHO calls for major scale-up in surveillance, testing, care, IPC, contact tracing, logistics and community engagement ahead of the 18 August IHR Emergency Committee meeting.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによるDRCのエボラ最新報告：感染3605件、死亡1587件、致死率44%に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、致死率44%、49保健地域に拡大、医療従事者感染、越境移動リスクがあり、IHR緊急委員会が開催予定であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国のアウトブレイク終息を宣言済み（7月28日）だが越境輸入リスクは残る。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。8月18日のIHR緊急委員会会合の結果を要注視。
